overview.en: The lumbar vertebrae, sacrum and pelvis, the disc, facet joints and ligaments, ten muscles in layers with origin, insertion, course, action and nerve, and the thoracolumbar fascia.
overview.zh: 腰椎、骶骨与骨盆，椎间盘、关节突关节与韧带，分层的 10 块肌肉（每块写明起点、止点、走行、动作和神经），以及胸腰筋膜。

text.en: The lumbar spine normally has five lumbar vertebrae, numbered from above down: the L1 vertebra, the L2 vertebra, the L3 vertebra, the L4 vertebra and the L5 vertebra (L1–L5). They lie between the twelve thoracic vertebrae and the sacrum and are the largest vertebrae of the column, built mainly to bear the weight of the upper body, and they become progressively larger from L1 to L5. A lumbar vertebra is recognised partly by what it lacks: it has no transverse foramina, which mark the cervical vertebrae, and no costal facets, which mark the thoracic vertebrae. Here L stands for lumbar and the number names a bone: the L4 vertebra is a bone, whereas the L4 spinal nerve is a nerve, and the two are described separately.
text.zh: 腰段脊柱正常有五块腰椎，自上而下依次为第 1 腰椎、第 2 腰椎、第 3 腰椎、第 4 腰椎和第 5 腰椎（L1–L5）。它们位于十二块胸椎与骶骨之间，是脊柱中最大的椎骨，主要承受上半身的重量；从第 1 腰椎到第 5 腰椎逐渐增大。辨认腰椎的一个办法是看它缺少什么：它没有颈椎特有的横突孔，也没有胸椎特有的肋凹。这里 L 表示腰部，数字指的是骨：第 4 腰椎是骨，第 4 腰神经是神经，两者分开描述。

text.en: The L1 vertebra is the uppermost and smallest lumbar vertebra. It lies roughly in line with the anterior end of the ninth rib, at the transpyloric plane, and the medial and lateral arcuate ligaments attach to its transverse processes. The L5 vertebra is the atypical lumbar vertebra at the lumbosacral junction and usually the largest vertebra of the column, with the largest body and transverse processes of all vertebrae, because it carries the weight of the entire upper body. Its body is much deeper in front than behind, which contributes to the lumbosacral angle. Its spinous process is smaller, its inferior articular processes are set wider apart and face almost anteriorly where they meet the sacrum, and its thick transverse processes arise from both the body and the pedicles. The iliolumbar ligament runs from the L5 transverse process to the ilium, and L5 is the most common level of spondylolysis and of spondylolisthesis.
text.zh: 第 1 腰椎是最上方、也是最小的腰椎。它大致与第 9 肋前端平齐，位于幽门平面；内侧弓状韧带和外侧弓状韧带附着于其横突。第 5 腰椎是位于腰骶连接处的非典型腰椎，通常是全脊柱最大的椎骨，其椎体和横突在全部椎骨中最大，因为它承受整个上半身的重量。它的椎体前部远高于后部，这是形成腰骶角的原因之一。它的棘突较小，两侧下关节突间距较宽，与骶骨相接处几乎朝向正前方；粗厚的横突同时起自椎体和椎弓根。髂腰韧带由第 5 腰椎横突连至髂骨；第 5 腰椎也是椎弓峡部裂和腰椎滑脱最常见的节段。

text.en: Above the lumbar spine lie the T12 vertebra and the twelfth rib. The T12 vertebra is the last thoracic vertebra; with T11 it is transitional in form and partly resembles the lumbar vertebrae below. It is normally the last rib-bearing vertebra, so on imaging the lumbar levels can be numbered by presuming that the last rib-bearing vertebra is T12; ribs occasionally also arise from L1 (lumbar ribs). The twelfth rib (12th rib) is one of the two pairs of floating ribs: it has no direct or indirect anterior attachment to the sternum, and its cartilage tends to end within the abdominal musculature. It is an atypical rib, short and without a neck or tubercle, and its head has a single facet, so it articulates with only one vertebra, its own T12 vertebra. Its length often varies.
text.zh: 腰椎上方是第 12 胸椎和第 12 肋。第 12 胸椎是最后一个胸椎；它与第 11 胸椎一样形态具有过渡性，部分类似其下方的腰椎。它通常是最后一个带肋的椎骨，因此影像学上可推定最后一个带肋椎骨为第 12 胸椎来确定腰椎序数；偶尔第 1 腰椎也会发出肋（腰肋）。第 12 肋是两对浮肋之一：前端与胸骨没有直接或间接的连接，其肋软骨往往终止于腹壁肌肉之中。它属于非典型肋，短小，无肋颈和肋结节，肋头只有一个关节面，因而只与一个椎骨，即相应的第 12 胸椎相关节。其长度常有变异。

text.en: Below the lumbar spine lie the sacrum, the coccyx and, on each side, the hip bone. The sacrum is an inverted triangular bone formed by fusion of the five sacral vertebrae (one source says sometimes six); fusion begins around puberty and is completed by about 25 to 30 years of age. Its base articulates with the body of L5 and the L5–S1 disc at the lumbosacral joint, its ear-shaped auricular surfaces articulate with the ilia at the sacroiliac joints, and its lower end articulates with the coccyx. On its front, the upper anterior surface of S1 projects forward as the sacral promontory; on its back, the median sacral crest runs down the midline and four pairs of posterior sacral foramina open onto the posterior surface. The sacral canal continues the vertebral canal and ends at the sacral hiatus, at about the level of the fourth sacral foramina, and the dura mater extends down to about S2. The coccyx (tailbone) is a small triangular bone of usually four coccygeal vertebrae, which are variably fused (sources give three to five); it meets the apex of the sacrum at the fibrocartilaginous sacrococcygeal joint, where only minor passive flexion and extension occur. The ilium is the part of the hip bone that articulates with the sacrum. Its upper margin, the iliac crest, runs from the anterior superior iliac spine to the posterior superior iliac spine (PSIS), and the iliac crests and the posterior superior iliac spines are the main palpable bony points used to estimate lumbar and sacral levels.
text.zh: 腰椎下方是骶骨、尾骨以及两侧的髋骨。骶骨呈倒三角形，由五块骶椎融合而成（有资料说有时为六块）；融合约在青春期开始，至 25 至 30 岁左右完成。骶骨底与第 5 腰椎椎体及 L5–S1 椎间盘构成腰骶关节，两侧形似耳廓的耳状面与髂骨构成骶髂关节，下端与尾骨相关节。骶骨前面，第 1 骶椎前面上部向前突出，形成骶骨岬；骶骨后面，骶正中嵴沿正中线下行，四对骶后孔开口于后面。骶管是椎管的延续，下端开口为骶管裂孔，约平第 4 骶孔；硬脊膜向下延伸至约第 2 骶椎平面。尾骨是由通常四块尾椎构成的小三角形骨，各尾椎有不同程度的融合（各资料记载为三至五块）；它通过纤维软骨性的骶尾关节与骶骨尖相连，此处只有轻微的被动屈伸。髂骨是髋骨中与骶骨相关节的部分。其上缘即髂嵴，自髂前上棘延伸至髂后上棘；两侧髂嵴和髂后上棘是体表推断腰椎、骶椎平面时最常用的可触及骨性标志。

text.en: Seen from the side, the lumbar spine is convex anteriorly and concave posteriorly; this normal curve is the lumbar lordosis. It is a secondary curvature that develops after birth, when the child learns to stand upright. It is produced mainly by the wedge-shaped lumbar discs, which are taller in front and thinner behind, and it brings the mass of the upper body over the pelvis. An exaggerated lumbar lordosis (swayback) is accompanied by anterior tilting of the pelvis. It appears temporarily in late pregnancy and resolves after childbirth, and abdominal obesity can cause it in either sex; both can cause back pain because they change the line of gravity.
text.zh: 从侧面观察，腰段脊柱向前凸、向后凹，这一正常弯曲称为腰椎前凸。它是继发性弯曲，在出生后儿童学会站立时形成。腰椎前凸主要由前高后低的楔形腰椎间盘形成，它使上半身的重量移至骨盆上方。腰椎前凸过度（俗称“摇摆背”）伴有骨盆前倾。它可在妊娠晚期暂时出现，分娩后消退；腹部肥胖在男女两性中都可引起前凸过度；两者都因重力线改变而可导致背痛。

text.en: The supracristal line, also called the intercristal line, Tuffier's line or Jacoby's line, is a horizontal line joining the highest points of the two iliac crests. It is usually taught as crossing the L4 spinous process, and it is the surface guide for lumbar puncture and for counting lumbar levels. Treat it as approximate: published descriptions range from the L3–L4 interspace to the L4–L5 disc, and on radiographs the line most often crosses the L4 body or its inferior endplate in men and the L5 body or its superior endplate in women. Sources do not agree on the sex difference, since one clinical manual places the palpated line at L3 in some women.
text.zh: 嵴上线又称髂嵴间线、图菲耶线或雅各比线，是连接两侧髂嵴最高点的水平线。通常教作平第 4 腰椎棘突，是腰椎穿刺和数腰椎节段的体表标志。它只能当作近似平面：各资料给出的位置从 L3–L4 间隙到 L4–L5 椎间盘不等；在 X 线片上，男性多经过第 4 腰椎椎体或其下终板，女性多经过第 5 腰椎椎体或其上终板。男女差异的说法并不一致，有一本临床手册写触诊时部分女性平第 3 腰椎。

text.en: Further down, the posterior superior iliac spines lie at the level of S2, about 4 cm lateral to the S2 spinous process, and are often marked by skin dimples (the dimples of Venus).
text.zh: 再往下，两侧髂后上棘平第 2 骶椎，位于第 2 骶椎棘突外侧约 4 cm 处，常在皮肤上形成小凹（维纳斯窝）。

text.en: There are normally five lumbar vertebrae, but four or six can occur as anatomical variants. A lumbosacral transitional vertebra can be thought of as a sacralized L5 or a lumbarized S1, with any degree of transition from partial to complete fusion. In sacralization the transverse processes of L5 are broadened and may form a false joint (pseudoarticulation) with, or fuse to, the sacral ala on one or both sides, leaving four rib-free lumbar-type vertebrae. In lumbarization the first and second sacral segments fail to fuse, a disc and facet joints are present at S1–S2, and there are six rib-free lumbar-type vertebrae. Its association with low back pain (Bertolotti syndrome) remains controversial. Transitional segments make level counting unreliable and can lead to operations or procedures at the wrong level. Levels can be numbered by presuming that the last rib-bearing vertebra is T12 or by using the iliolumbar ligament, which arises from L5, but a transitional vertebra can make either method lead to the wrong level, so the numbering used must be stated explicitly. Disorders that normally affect L5 will then affect L4 (with sacralization) or L6 (with lumbarization).
text.zh: 正常有五块腰椎，但作为解剖变异也可出现四块或六块。腰骶移行椎可视为第 5 腰椎骶化或第 1 骶椎腰化，移行程度可从部分融合到完全融合不等。腰椎骶化时，第 5 腰椎横突增宽，可在一侧或两侧与骶骨翼形成假关节或融合，只剩四个无肋的腰椎样椎骨。骶椎腰化时，第 1、第 2 骶椎节段未融合，S1–S2 之间有椎间盘和关节突关节，出现六个无肋的腰椎样椎骨。移行椎与下腰痛（贝尔托洛蒂综合征）的关系仍有争议。移行椎使节段计数不可靠，可导致在错误节段施行手术或操作。计数时可推定最后一个带肋椎骨为第 12 胸椎，或借助起自第 5 腰椎的髂腰韧带，但存在移行椎时两种方法都可能定错节段，因此必须明确说明所采用的计数方法。此时通常累及第 5 腰椎的病变，在腰椎骶化时会累及第 4 腰椎，在骶椎腰化时会累及第 6 腰椎。

text.en: A typical lumbar vertebra has a large, kidney-shaped vertebral body in front: wider from side to side than from front to back, convex in front, flattened behind and thicker anteriorly than posteriorly. Two short, thick pedicles project directly backward from the upper half of the body and connect it to the posterior elements; from L1 to L5 they widen from about 9 mm to about 18 mm, and their angle in the axial plane increases from about 10° to 20°. The broad, short laminae meet in the midline, and the short, thick, hatchet-shaped spinous process projects almost horizontally backward from their junction. The long, slender transverse processes project laterally; they are horizontal at L1–L3, incline slightly upward at L4–L5 and each corresponds to a rib (its costal element). The superior articular process carries a vertical, concave facet that faces posteromedially, and the inferior articular process projects downward with a convex facet that faces anterolaterally, so the processes of adjacent vertebrae interlock (some sources simply say medially and laterally).
text.zh: 典型腰椎前方是大的肾形椎体：横径大于前后径，前面凸隆、后面平坦，前部厚于后部。一对短而粗的椎弓根自椎体上半部直接向后伸出，连接椎体与后部结构；从第 1 腰椎到第 5 腰椎，椎弓根宽度由约 9 mm 增至约 18 mm，在水平面上的角度由约 10° 增至 20°。宽而短的椎板在中线汇合，短、厚而呈斧形的棘突自汇合处几乎水平地伸向后方。细长的横突向两侧伸出；第 1 至第 3 腰椎的横突呈水平位，第 4、第 5 腰椎的横突略向上倾斜，每个横突在形态上相当于肋（即其肋突部分）。上关节突的关节面垂直而凹陷，朝向后内侧；下关节突向下伸出，关节面凸隆，朝向前外侧，使相邻椎骨的关节突相互交锁（有资料只说朝内和朝外）。

text.en: Two small tubercles are characteristic of lumbar vertebrae: the mammillary process on the back of each superior articular process, which gives attachment to multifidus and the intertransversarii, and the accessory process on the back of the root of each transverse process, which gives attachment to longissimus and the intertransversarii. The pars interarticularis is the part of the vertebral arch between the superior and inferior articular processes and, on axial images, lies at the junction of the pedicle and lamina; it is prone to stress fracture (spondylolysis), most often at L5. The lumbar vertebral foramen is triangular, smaller than in the cervical vertebrae but larger than in the thoracic vertebrae, and the stacked foramina form the vertebral canal. The canal holds the end of the spinal cord, the conus medullaris, usually at about the L1–L2 vertebral level (one source gives about T12–L1, and between people the level ranges from the middle third of T11 to the middle third of L3), and below it the cauda equina, the lumbar, sacral and coccygeal nerve roots that continue downward before they exit. Between the pedicles of adjacent vertebrae is the intervertebral foramen, through which a spinal nerve leaves the canal; the vertebral body and disc lie at its front and the facet joint and its capsule at its back, and herniated disc material can compress its contents.
text.zh: 腰椎有两个特征性的小结节：乳突位于每个上关节突的后面，为多裂肌和横突间肌提供附着；副突位于每个横突根部的后面，为最长肌和横突间肌提供附着。椎弓峡部是椎弓位于上、下关节突之间的部分，在横断面图像上位于椎弓根与椎板交界处；它容易发生应力性骨折（椎弓峡部裂），最常见于第 5 腰椎。腰椎椎孔呈三角形，比颈椎椎孔小而比胸椎椎孔大，各椎孔连成椎管。椎管内有脊髓末端，即脊髓圆锥，通常约平第 1–2 腰椎（有资料给出约 T12–L1，个体之间范围从第 11 胸椎椎体中 1/3 至第 3 腰椎椎体中 1/3）；其下为马尾，即继续下行、尚未穿出的腰、骶、尾神经根。相邻椎骨的椎弓根之间是椎间孔，脊神经经此离开椎管；椎体和椎间盘位于其前方，关节突关节及其关节囊位于其后方；突出的椎间盘组织可压迫孔内结构。
1.2 椎间盘、关节突关节与韧带

text.en: Each pair of adjacent lumbar vertebrae is joined in front by the intervertebral disc between the two vertebral bodies and behind by the left and right zygapophyseal joints between the articular processes. The two vertebrae with these joints and the ligaments between them form a motion segment, such as L4–L5. The disc is a fibrocartilaginous joint that absorbs shock and allows only slight movement at each level. The facet joints guide that movement: their interlocking, roughly sagittal surfaces allow a good range of flexion and extension but limit twisting (axial rotation), and they stabilise the segment against translation. The ligaments limit movement in different directions: the anterior longitudinal ligament in front of the bodies is the main restraint to extension; the posterior longitudinal ligament, the ligamentum flavum and the interspinous and supraspinous ligaments behind help limit flexion; the intertransverse ligaments limit side bending; and the iliolumbar ligament ties L5 to the ilium. Levels name bones and discs, not nerves: a herniated L4–L5 disc usually affects the L5 nerve root rather than the L4 nerve root.
text.zh: 相邻两个腰椎在前方由两椎体之间的椎间盘相连，在后方由左右两个关节突关节相连。这两个椎骨连同这些关节及其间的韧带构成一个运动节段，例如 L4–L5。椎间盘是纤维软骨连结，起减震作用，每个节段只允许轻微活动。关节突关节引导这种活动：其相互交锁、大致位于矢状面的关节面允许较大范围的屈伸运动，但限制扭转（轴向旋转），并稳定运动节段，防止平移。各条韧带分别限制不同方向的活动：椎体前方的前纵韧带是限制伸展的主要结构；后方的后纵韧带、黄韧带、棘间韧带和棘上韧带协助限制屈曲；横突间韧带限制侧屈；髂腰韧带把第 5 腰椎系于髂骨。节段名称指的是骨和椎间盘，而不是神经：L4–L5 椎间盘突出通常累及 L5 神经根，而不是 L4 神经根。

rows.en: Intervertebral disc
rows.zh: 椎间盘

rows.en: The intervertebral disc is a fibrocartilaginous joint (an intervertebral symphysis) between adjacent vertebral bodies, made of an outer annulus fibrosus and an inner nucleus pulposus, which is covered above and below by cartilaginous endplates. Lumbar discs are thicker than cervical or thoracic discs, about 7–10 mm thick and about 4 cm in anteroposterior diameter, and they are wedge-shaped (taller in front), which contributes most to the lumbar lordosis. The disc is the shock-absorbing system between the vertebral bodies and allows only slight movement at each level; its soft, deformable structure lets the vertebrae translate, tilt, rock and compress on one another. It has no blood supply: most sources describe nutrients diffusing to it from the endplates, while one says they are absorbed from the circulating blood by osmosis. Its nerve fibres are mainly confined to the outer lamellae, and it is supplied by the sinuvertebral nerve. Because the nucleus absorbs water and loses it under compression, a person is slightly taller after a night's rest than at the end of the day, and the discs become thinner with age.
rows.zh: 椎间盘是相邻椎体之间的纤维软骨连结（椎间联合），由外周的纤维环和中央的髓核构成，髓核的上、下方覆以软骨终板。腰椎间盘比颈椎和胸椎的椎间盘厚，厚约 7–10 mm，前后径约 4 cm，并呈前高后低的楔形，是形成腰椎前凸的主要因素。椎间盘是椎体之间的减震系统，每个节段只允许轻微活动；其柔软而可变形的结构使相邻椎骨之间能够平移、倾斜、摆动和受压。它没有血液供应：多数资料描述营养物质经终板弥散而来，也有资料说是经渗透作用从循环血液中吸收。其神经纤维主要局限于外层板层，由窦椎神经支配。由于髓核吸收水分、受压时又失去水分，人经过一夜休息后的身高略高于一天结束时；随着年龄增长，椎间盘会变薄。

rows.en: Annulus fibrosus
rows.zh: 纤维环

rows.en: The annulus fibrosus is the tough outer ring of the disc, made of about 15–25 concentric lamellae of type I collagen and fibrocartilage (one source gives 15–20). Within each lamella the fibres run obliquely, at about 60° to the vertical axis (another source describes a 30° angle between the vertebral bodies), and the fibre direction alternates from one lamella to the next. Its inner part blends gradually with the nucleus pulposus, and its peripheral fibres anchor the disc to the vertebrae and merge in front and behind with the longitudinal ligaments. It contains the gel-like nucleus; its posterolateral part is the weakest region, and when that part fails, nuclear material can herniate.
rows.zh: 纤维环是椎间盘坚韧的外环，由约 15–25 层以 Ⅰ 型胶原和纤维软骨构成的同心板层组成（另有资料记载为 15–20 层）。每一板层内的纤维斜行，与垂直轴约成 60°（另有资料描述为在椎体之间约成 30°），相邻板层的纤维方向交替相反。纤维环内层逐渐移行为髓核，外周纤维把椎间盘锚定于椎骨，并在前、后方与纵韧带融合。它包裹凝胶状的髓核；其后外侧部是最薄弱的区域，这一部分一旦破裂，髓核组织即可突出。

rows.en: Nucleus pulposus
rows.zh: 髓核

rows.en: The nucleus pulposus is the gelatinous centre of the disc: a highly hydrated gel (more than 80% water) containing aggrecan, a meshwork of loosely connected collagen fibrils and scattered cells, many of which are derived from the embryonic notochord. It is surrounded by the annulus fibrosus and covered above and below by the cartilaginous endplates. It acts as the disc's shock absorber and permits only a very limited range of movement between vertebrae. When the annulus weakens, nuclear material can be forced out through it (disc herniation) and compress nerve roots; this usually happens posterolaterally, where the annulus is weakest and is not reinforced by the posterior longitudinal ligament.
rows.zh: 髓核是椎间盘中央的胶状组织，为高度含水（含水量超过 80%）、含聚集蛋白聚糖的凝胶，其中有疏松连接的胶原纤维网和散在的细胞，这些细胞多数来源于胚胎期的脊索。髓核周围为纤维环，上、下方覆以软骨终板。它起减震作用，并只允许相邻椎骨之间极小范围的活动。纤维环变弱时，髓核组织可被挤出（椎间盘突出），压迫神经根；突出通常发生在后外侧，因为此处纤维环最薄弱，且没有后纵韧带加强。

rows.en: Vertebral endplate
rows.zh: 椎体终板

rows.en: The vertebral endplate is the interface between a vertebral body and the adjacent disc, made of an epiphyseal bony ring at the periphery and a cartilaginous layer, usually less than 1 mm thick, centrally; the cartilaginous layer is related to both the nucleus pulposus and the annulus fibrosus. Sources differ on where it belongs: Radiopaedia says it is now generally considered part of the vertebral body, although it was historically grouped with the disc, and the figure labels it with the vertebral body; Kenhub's account of the disc describes the nucleus as sandwiched between cartilage endplates. Its capillaries are small branches of the interosseous arteries of the vertebral body, which arise from the segmental arteries. Because the disc is avascular, nutrients and oxygen diffuse to it from the endplate, which therefore has an important role in disc nutrition; the endplate also contributes to shock absorption and strengthens the intervertebral disc joint.
rows.zh: 椎体终板是椎体与相邻椎间盘之间的界面，周边为骺环（骨性环），中央为一层通常不足 1 mm 厚的软骨层；软骨层与髓核和纤维环均相邻。各资料对其归属看法不一：Radiopaedia 认为终板目前一般被视为椎体的一部分，虽然过去曾把它归入椎间盘，图中也把终板标在椎体上；Kenhub 在描述椎间盘时则说髓核夹在上下软骨终板之间。终板的毛细血管是椎体骨内动脉的细小分支，骨内动脉发自节段动脉。由于椎间盘无血管，营养物质和氧气由终板弥散至椎间盘，因此终板在椎间盘营养中起重要作用；终板还参与减震，并加强椎间盘连结。

rows.en: Zygapophyseal (facet) joint
rows.zh: 关节突关节

rows.en: Each zygapophyseal (facet) joint is a plane synovial joint between the inferior articular process of one vertebra and the superior articular process of the vertebra below, enclosed by a thin, loose fibrous capsule; the ligamentum flavum covers the front of the joint. In the lumbar region the joint surfaces are curved and lie roughly in the sagittal plane (other sources call them oblique and cylindrical, or nearly vertical): the concave superior facets face posteromedially and the convex inferior facets face anterolaterally, so adjacent processes interlock. This arrangement permits flexion, extension and some lateral flexion but strongly limits axial rotation (one source still lists rotation among the lumbar movements), and it stabilises the motion segment against translation and excessive rotation and flexion. The facet joints are reported to carry about 33% of the dynamic compressive load and 35% of the static load. Pain sensation from the capsule and synovial folds is carried by the medial branch of the dorsal ramus, and each medial branch supplies the joint at its own level and the joint below; this pattern matters when medial branch blocks and radiofrequency ablation are performed. One source also names the sinuvertebral nerve.
rows.zh: 每个关节突关节是上位椎骨下关节突与下位椎骨上关节突之间的平面滑膜关节，外有薄而松弛的纤维关节囊；黄韧带覆盖关节的前面。腰段关节面弯曲，大致位于矢状面（另有资料描述为斜向的圆柱面，或近乎垂直）：凹陷的上关节面朝向后内侧，凸隆的下关节面朝向前外侧，使相邻关节突相互交锁。这种排列允许屈、伸和一定程度的侧屈，但明显限制轴向旋转（有一个资料仍把旋转列为腰椎动作），并稳定运动节段，防止平移以及过度的旋转和屈曲。据报道，关节突关节约承担动态压缩负荷的 33% 和静态负荷的 35%。关节囊和滑膜皱襞的痛觉由脊神经后支的内侧支传导，每条内侧支支配本节段的关节及其下一个关节；进行内侧支阻滞和射频消融时，这一规律十分重要。另有一个资料还提到窦椎神经。

rows.en: Lumbosacral joint
rows.zh: 腰骶关节

rows.en: The lumbosacral joint is the junction between L5 and the sacrum: the L5–S1 intervertebral disc between the body of L5 and the base (promontory) of the sacrum, together with the facet joints between the inferior articular processes of L5 and the superior articular processes of the sacrum. Because the L5 body is much deeper in front than behind, the junction forms the lumbosacral angle, and the inferior articular processes of L5 are wider apart and face more anteriorly than at higher levels. The joint passes the weight of the upper body from L5 to the sacrum. It is reinforced by the iliolumbar and lumbosacral ligaments; the iliolumbar ligaments help keep L5 aligned on the sacrum during movement and limit movement at the junction, where only slight rotation occurs.
rows.zh: 腰骶关节是第 5 腰椎与骶骨之间的连结：包括第 5 腰椎椎体与骶骨底（骶骨岬）之间的 L5–S1 椎间盘，以及第 5 腰椎下关节突与骶骨上关节突之间的关节突关节。由于第 5 腰椎椎体前部远高于后部，此处形成腰骶角；第 5 腰椎两下关节突的间距比上位腰椎宽，朝向也更偏前方。腰骶关节把上半身的重量由第 5 腰椎传递至骶骨。它由髂腰韧带和腰骶韧带加强；髂腰韧带有助于在运动中维持第 5 腰椎在骶骨上的对位，并限制腰骶连接处的活动，此处只能发生轻微的旋转。

rows.en: Sacroiliac joint
rows.zh: 骶髂关节

rows.en: The sacroiliac joint is a diarthrodial synovial joint between the ear-shaped (auricular) surfaces of the sacrum and the ilium, whose articular surfaces are C-shaped. It is bound by the anterior sacroiliac ligament (an anterior-inferior thickening of the capsule), the interosseous sacroiliac ligament, which forms the major connection between sacrum and ilium, and the posterior (dorsal) sacroiliac ligament from the posterior superior iliac spine, with the sacrotuberous and sacrospinous ligaments in support. Its nerve supply comes from the ventral rami of L4 and L5, the superior gluteal nerve and the dorsal rami of L5–S2. Its main roles are to provide stability and to transfer the load of the trunk to the lower limbs. Movement is small, in most people limited to about 2 to 4 mm, chiefly nutation (the sacrum moves anteriorly and inferiorly while the coccyx moves posteriorly relative to the ilium) and its reverse, counternutation; the posterior sacroiliac ligament resists counternutation and the sacrotuberous ligament resists nutation.
rows.zh: 骶髂关节是骶骨与髂骨耳状面之间的可动滑膜关节，关节面呈“C”字形。关节由骶髂前韧带（关节囊前下部的增厚）、骶髂骨间韧带（骶骨与髂骨之间最主要的连接）和起自髂后上棘的骶髂后韧带加固，并有骶结节韧带和骶棘韧带辅助。其神经来自 L4、L5 脊神经前支、臀上神经以及 L5–S2 脊神经后支。骶髂关节的主要作用是提供稳定，并把躯干的负荷传递至下肢。其活动幅度很小，大多数人仅约 2 至 4 mm，主要为点头运动（骶骨向前下方运动，同时尾骨相对髂骨向后移动）及其反向的反点头运动；骶髂后韧带限制反点头运动，骶结节韧带限制点头运动。

rows.en: Anterior longitudinal ligament
rows.zh: 前纵韧带

rows.en: The anterior longitudinal ligament is a strong, broad band on the anterior surfaces of the vertebral bodies, covering about the anterior third of each body. It runs the length of the column from the anterosuperior part of the sacrum upward; sources differ on its upper end, either the anterior arch of C1, where it becomes the anterior atlanto-occipital membrane, or the occipital bone in front of the foramen magnum. It is firmly united to the periosteum of the bodies and attaches to the anterior annulus of each disc; its superficial fibres span three to four vertebrae, its intermediate fibres two to three, and its deep fibres pass between individual vertebrae. It is the main ligament that limits extension and prevents hyperextension of the spine, it reinforces the front of the discs, and in the lumbar region it also resists translation and rotation. Its first (superficial) layer is typically affected in diffuse idiopathic skeletal hyperostosis.
rows.zh: 前纵韧带是附着于椎体前面的坚韧宽带，约覆盖每个椎体的前三分之一。它纵贯脊柱全长，下起骶骨前上部；各资料对其上端的描述不一：一说上达寰椎前弓，在此移行为寰枕前膜，一说上达枕骨大孔前方的枕骨。它与椎体骨膜紧密结合，并附着于每个椎间盘纤维环的前部；其浅层纤维跨越 3 至 4 个椎骨，中层纤维跨越 2 至 3 个椎骨，深层纤维只连接相邻椎骨。前纵韧带是限制脊柱伸展、防止过伸的主要韧带，并加强椎间盘的前部；在腰段，它还抵抗平移和旋转。弥漫性特发性骨肥厚症通常累及其第一层（浅层）。

rows.en: Posterior longitudinal ligament
rows.zh: 后纵韧带

rows.en: The posterior longitudinal ligament lies inside the vertebral canal on the posterior surfaces of the vertebral bodies and discs, running from the sacrum up to the axis (C2), where it continues upward as the tectorial membrane; it gradually broadens as it ascends. It is narrower and weaker than the anterior longitudinal ligament and attaches mainly and firmly to the annulus fibrosus of the discs and only loosely to the bodies. It is narrow and thick over the centres of the vertebral bodies, giving a denticulate (toothed) outline over each body, and in the lumbar region its thick central band becomes progressively narrower from L1 to L5. It limits flexion (weakly resisting hyperflexion) and reinforces the back of the discs against posterior herniation. Because it is narrow, especially in the lower lumbar spine, and its lateral part has no firm connection with the annulus, it leaves the posterolateral part of the disc unreinforced, which is where lumbar disc herniations usually occur.
rows.zh: 后纵韧带位于椎管内，附着于椎体和椎间盘的后面，下起骶骨，上达枢椎（第 2 颈椎），向上延续为覆膜；它自下而上逐渐变宽。它比前纵韧带窄而薄弱，主要并牢固地附着于椎间盘纤维环，与椎体则结合疏松。它在椎体中部窄而厚，因而在每个椎体上呈锯齿状轮廓；在腰段，其增厚的中央带由第 1 腰椎至第 5 腰椎逐渐变窄。后纵韧带限制屈曲（较弱地抵抗过屈），并在后方加强椎间盘、防止其向后突出。由于它较窄（下腰段尤甚），且其外侧部与纤维环没有牢固连接，椎间盘的后外侧部缺乏加强，腰椎间盘突出通常就发生在这里。

rows.en: Ligamentum flavum
rows.zh: 黄韧带

rows.en: The ligamenta flava are paired, yellowish elastic ligaments that connect the laminae of adjacent vertebrae, passing from the front of the lamina above to the back and upper margin of the lamina below. They contain about 80% elastin and 20% collagen (another source gives more than 80% elastin), and in the lumbar region they run laterally to cover the anterior aspect of the facet joints, lying in the posterior part of the vertebral canal. They resist separation of the laminae during flexion and help the spine resume its shape after flexion; their pre-tension prevents them from buckling into the canal during extension. When the ligament thickens (hypertrophy, for example with calcification), it can narrow the canal and cause spinal stenosis. A midline lumbar puncture needle perforates it.
rows.zh: 黄韧带是成对、略呈黄色的弹性韧带，连接相邻椎骨的椎板：自上位椎板的前面连至下位椎板的后面及上缘。其成分约 80% 为弹性纤维、20% 为胶原纤维（另有资料记载弹性纤维含量超过 80%）；在腰段，它向外侧延伸，覆盖关节突关节的前面，位于椎管的后部。黄韧带在屈曲时抵抗相邻椎板的分离，并帮助脊柱在屈曲后恢复原有形态；它本身具有预张力，伸展时不会皱褶突入椎管。若韧带增厚（肥厚，例如伴有钙化），可使椎管变窄，导致椎管狭窄。腰椎穿刺正中入路时，穿刺针要穿过黄韧带。

rows.en: Interspinous ligament
rows.zh: 棘间韧带

rows.en: The interspinous ligaments lie deep between consecutive spinous processes, attaching from the base to the apex of each process and connecting adjacent processes. In the lumbar region the ligament is not a continuous fibrous band but consists of loose tissue, and it is bifid, so its fibres can buckle to either side. Posteriorly it merges with the supraspinous ligament, whose deep layer is continuous with it. Together with the supraspinous ligament it resists flexion and limits hyperflexion of the lumbar spine, and a midline lumbar puncture needle passes through it.
rows.zh: 棘间韧带位于相邻两个棘突之间的深部，自每个棘突的根部附着至棘突尖，连接相邻棘突。在腰段，它并非连续的纤维带，而由疏松组织构成，并分为左右两半，因此其纤维可向两侧皱褶。其后方与棘上韧带融合，棘上韧带的深层与棘间韧带相延续。棘间韧带与棘上韧带一起抵抗屈曲，限制腰椎过屈；腰椎穿刺采用正中入路时，穿刺针要穿过棘间韧带。

rows.en: Supraspinous ligament
rows.zh: 棘上韧带

rows.en: The supraspinous ligament is a cord-like fibrous band joining the tips of the spinous processes; above C7 it continues as the nuchal ligament to the external occipital protuberance. In the lumbar region it becomes thicker and broader and merges with the thoracolumbar fascia; it has superficial, intermediate and deep layers, and many of its fibres arise from the tendons of midline muscles. Sources disagree on its lower end: some describe it as usually reaching only about L3–L4, below which latissimus dorsi fibres replace it, while others describe it as continuing to the sacrum, where the median sacral crest gives it attachment. It prevents separation of the spinous processes during flexion, so it helps limit flexion, resist hyperflexion and stabilise the lumbar spine, and a midline lumbar puncture needle passes through it.
rows.zh: 棘上韧带是连接各棘突尖的索状纤维带；在第 7 颈椎以上延续为项韧带，止于枕外隆凸。在腰段，它变厚变宽并与胸腰筋膜融合；它分浅、中、深三层，许多纤维来自附着于中线的肌肉肌腱。各资料对其下端的描述不一：有的认为它通常只到 L3–L4 附近，其下由背阔肌的纤维取代；有的则认为它一直延伸到骶骨，附着于骶正中嵴。棘上韧带在屈曲时防止棘突分离，因而有助于限制屈曲、抵抗过屈并稳定腰椎；腰椎穿刺采用正中入路时，穿刺针要穿过棘上韧带。

rows.en: Intertransverse ligament
rows.zh: 横突间韧带

rows.en: The intertransverse ligaments are thin membranous bands that join the transverse processes of adjacent vertebrae. They are significant mainly in the lumbar spine, where they contribute to its stability, and their main function is to limit lateral flexion (side bending) of the vertebral column.
rows.zh: 横突间韧带是连接相邻椎骨横突的薄膜状韧带。它们主要在腰段具有意义，有助于腰椎的稳定；其主要功能是限制脊柱的侧屈。

rows.en: Iliolumbar ligament
rows.zh: 髂腰韧带

rows.en: The iliolumbar ligament is a strong, fan-like ligament that runs laterally from the tip of the transverse process of L5 (in most people; one source adds sometimes L4) to the posterior part of the iliac crest and the iliac fossa. It inserts deep into the ventral margin of the crest about 6–7 cm from the midline, where the crest shields it from palpation, and it is described as having two bands, called anterior and posterior in one source and upper and lower in another. It stabilises the lumbosacral junction and pelvic girdle, keeping L5 aligned on the sacrum and limiting movement at L5–S1, in particular side flexion and rotation, and it also helps restrain movement at the sacroiliac joint. On imaging it is used as a landmark for identifying L5 when numbering the vertebrae. Inflammation or tearing of the ligament is described as a cause of chronic or recurring one-sided low back pain with a tender point at the posterior iliac crest.
rows.zh: 髂腰韧带是一条坚韧的扇形韧带，自第 5 腰椎横突尖（多数人如此；有资料补充说有时也起自第 4 腰椎）向外侧连至髂嵴后部及髂窝。它深止于距中线约 6–7 cm 处的髂嵴腹侧缘，因被髂嵴遮挡而无法触及；它被描述为由两束构成，一个资料称为前束和后束，另一个资料称为上束和下束。髂腰韧带稳定腰骶连接和骨盆带，维持第 5 腰椎在骶骨上的对位，并限制 L5–S1 节段的活动，尤其是侧屈和旋转；它也有助于限制骶髂关节的活动。在影像学中，它可作为计数椎骨时辨认第 5 腰椎的标志。髂腰韧带的炎症或撕裂被认为可引起慢性或反复发作的单侧下腰痛，并在髂嵴后部有压痛点。

text.en: The midline structures explain the path of a lumbar puncture. Because the spinal cord ends (conus medullaris) at about the L1–L2 vertebrae while the dura mater extends down to S2, the needle is inserted below L2, usually at the L3–L4 or L4–L5 interspace, with the supracristal line as the surface guide. Between the spinous processes it passes through the supraspinous and interspinous ligaments and then perforates the ligamentum flavum.
text.zh: 中线结构说明了腰椎穿刺的路径。由于脊髓末端（脊髓圆锥）约平第 1–2 腰椎，而硬脊膜向下延伸至第 2 骶椎，穿刺针应在第 2 腰椎以下刺入，通常在 L3–L4 或 L4–L5 间隙，并以嵴上线作为体表参照。穿刺针在相邻棘突之间穿过棘上韧带和棘间韧带，然后穿透黄韧带。

text.en: 1.3 Muscle layers of the lower back

The muscles of the lower back are easiest to learn from the surface inward and by their nerve supply. The serratus posterior inferior belongs to the intermediate layer of the extrinsic back muscles: it lies deep to the latissimus dorsi, covers the erector spinae and is supplied by ventral (anterior) rami. Deep to it are the intrinsic (true) back muscles, which are supplied by dorsal (posterior) rami: the erector spinae forms their intermediate layer and the transversospinalis group (multifidus and rotatores) their deep layer, while the short interspinales and intertransversarii join neighbouring vertebrae segment by segment. The lateral intertransversarii are the exception, as they are usually described as supplied by ventral rami. In front of the paraspinal muscles, beside the lumbar vertebrae, the quadratus lumborum and psoas major belong to the posterior abdominal wall and are supplied by ventral rami; the thoracolumbar fascia separates the two groups (section 1.8). Functionally, the erector spinae and multifidus form the lumbar extensor group, while the quadratus lumborum, psoas major, abdominal muscles and multifidus are important in lumbar rotation and lateral flexion.
text.zh: 下背部肌肉最好由浅入深、按神经支配来记。下后锯肌属于背部外来肌的中间层：它位于背阔肌深面，覆盖竖脊肌，由脊神经前支支配。其深面是背固有肌，由脊神经后支支配：竖脊肌构成其中间层，横突棘肌群（多裂肌和回旋肌）构成其深层，短小的棘间肌和横突间肌则逐个节段连接相邻椎骨。腰外侧横突间肌是例外，通常被描述为由前支支配。在椎旁肌前方、腰椎两侧，腰方肌和腰大肌属于腹后壁肌，由前支支配；胸腰筋膜把这两组肌肉分隔开（见 1.8）。从功能上看，竖脊肌和多裂肌组成腰部伸肌群，腰方肌、腰大肌、腹肌和多裂肌则在腰椎旋转和侧屈中起重要作用。

rows.en: Extrinsic back muscles, intermediate layer
rows.zh: 背部外来肌中间层

rows.en: Serratus posterior inferior
rows.zh: 下后锯肌

rows.en: Depresses ribs 9–12; traditionally said to assist forced expiration, without electromyographic evidence
rows.zh: 下拉第 9–12 肋；传统上认为辅助用力呼气，但缺乏肌电图证据

rows.en: Ventral rami of T9–T12 (the T12 branch is the subcostal nerve)
rows.zh: T9–T12 脊神经前支（T12 的分支即肋下神经）

rows.en: Erector spinae (intrinsic muscles, intermediate layer)
rows.zh: 竖脊肌（背固有肌中间层）

rows.en: Iliocostalis lumborum, Longissimus thoracis, Spinalis thoracis
rows.zh: 腰髂肋肌、胸最长肌、胸棘肌

rows.en: Both sides: the primary extensor of the back; one side: lateral flexion to the same side; eccentric control of forward bending
rows.zh: 双侧：背部的主要伸肌；单侧：向同侧侧屈；离心控制躯干前屈

rows.en: Dorsal rami, mainly the lateral branches (intermediate branches to the longissimus in the lumbar region)
rows.zh: 脊神经后支，主要为外侧支（腰段最长肌由中间支支配）

rows.en: Transversospinalis (intrinsic muscles, deep layer)
rows.zh: 横突棘肌（背固有肌深层）

rows.en: Multifidus, Rotatores
rows.zh: 多裂肌、回旋肌

rows.en: Lumbar extension and segmental stabilisation; the rotatores are mainly proprioceptive
rows.zh: 腰椎伸展和节段性稳定；回旋肌以本体感觉为主

rows.en: Medial branches of the dorsal rami
rows.zh: 脊神经后支的内侧支

rows.en: Short segmental muscles
rows.zh: 节段短肌

rows.en: Interspinales, Intertransversarii
rows.zh: 棘间肌、横突间肌

rows.en: Stabilisation and proprioception; the interspinales assist extension and the intertransversarii assist lateral flexion to the same side
rows.zh: 稳定和本体感觉；棘间肌辅助伸展，横突间肌辅助向同侧侧屈

rows.en: Dorsal rami; the lateral intertransversarii usually ventral rami
rows.zh: 脊神经后支；腰外侧横突间肌通常为前支

rows.en: Posterior abdominal wall (in front of the paraspinal muscles)
rows.zh: 腹后壁肌（位于椎旁肌前方）

rows.en: Quadratus lumborum, Psoas major
rows.zh: 腰方肌、腰大肌

rows.en: Quadratus lumborum: lateral flexion to the same side, extension and (classically, debated) fixing the 12th rib; psoas major: hip flexion and lateral flexion of the lumbar spine to the same side
rows.zh: 腰方肌：向同侧侧屈、伸展，经典说法还有固定第 12 肋（有争议）；腰大肌：屈髋和腰椎向同侧侧屈

rows.en: Quadratus lumborum: subcostal nerve (T12) and ventral rami of L1–L4; psoas major: ventral rami of L1–L3 (mainly L2)
rows.zh: 腰方肌：肋下神经（T12）和 L1–L4 脊神经前支；腰大肌：L1–L3 脊神经前支（以 L2 为主）

text.en: In the lumbar region the erector spinae lies between the posterior and middle layers of the thoracolumbar fascia. From lateral to medial its three columns are the iliocostalis, longissimus and spinalis, remembered as "I Like Standing"; in the lower back they are the iliocostalis lumborum, the longissimus thoracis and the spinalis thoracis.
text.zh: 在腰部，竖脊肌位于胸腰筋膜后层与中层之间。它的三个肌柱由外侧向内侧依次为髂肋肌、最长肌和棘肌，英文口诀用三者的首字母 I、L、S 记住这个顺序；在下背部，它们是腰髂肋肌、胸最长肌和胸棘肌。

text.en: The three columns share a broad common tendon, the erector spinae aponeurosis. It attaches to the lower thoracic and lumbar spinous processes, the sacrum, the posterior part of the iliac crest and the sacroiliac and supraspinous ligaments, blends with the thoracolumbar fascia, and also serves the multifidus. Most texts call this attachment the origin; a few call it a common insertion on the back of the sacrum.
text.zh: 三个肌柱共用一条宽阔的总腱，即竖脊肌腱膜。它附着于下位胸椎和腰椎棘突、骶骨、髂嵴后部以及骶髂韧带和棘上韧带，与胸腰筋膜融合，也是多裂肌的共同肌腱。多数教材把这一附着称为起点，少数称为骶骨背面的共同止点。

text.en: The iliocostalis lumborum and the longissimus thoracis each have a lumbar part and a thoracic part. The lumbar part of the iliocostalis lumborum inserts onto the transverse processes of the L1–L4 vertebrae in laminated layers: the fibres to the L1 vertebra are the most superficial and medial, and those to the L4 vertebra the deepest and most lateral. The lumbar part of the longissimus thoracis, usually five fascicles, inserts onto the accessory and transverse processes of the L1–L5 vertebrae.
text.zh: 腰髂肋肌和胸最长肌各分为腰部和胸部。腰髂肋肌的腰部以层状纤维止于第 1–4 腰椎横突：止于第 1 腰椎的纤维最浅、最靠内，止于第 4 腰椎的最深、最靠外。胸最长肌的腰部通常有 5 束，止于第 1–5 腰椎的副突和横突。

text.en: Acting together, the columns are the primary extensor of the back; one side bends the trunk to the same side, and during forward bending they contract eccentrically to control the trunk. With the person prone they are felt as one muscle mass on each side of the midline furrow that marks the spinous processes, running parallel to the spine over the transverse processes. A single column cannot be isolated by palpation.
text.zh: 三个肌柱共同收缩时是背部的主要伸肌；一侧收缩使躯干向同侧侧屈；躯干前屈时它们做离心收缩，控制躯干前倾。受检者俯卧时，可在标示棘突位置的背部正中纵沟两侧，摸到沿横突平行于脊柱走行的一整团肌块。触诊无法单独区分其中某一个肌柱。
1.5 横突棘肌：多裂肌与回旋肌

text.en: The transversospinalis muscles form the deep layer of the intrinsic back muscles. Their fibres run from the transverse processes laterally toward the spinous processes medially, and they are supplied by segmental branches of the dorsal rami.
text.zh: 横突棘肌构成背固有肌的深层。其纤维由外侧的横突斜向内侧的棘突，由脊神经后支的节段性分支支配。

text.en: The multifidus spans the whole vertebral column but is most developed in the lumbar region, where it lies beside the spinous processes, deep to the erector spinae and superficial to the rotatores. The lumbar multifidus climbs from the mammillary processes, the sacrum and the posterior superior iliac spine to the lumbar spinous processes, usually two to five levels higher (some sources say two to four). Dissection studies describe five bands, one for each lumbar vertebra, and four layers with a multipennate fibre arrangement.
text.zh: 多裂肌纵贯整个脊柱，但以腰部最为发达；在腰部，它位于棘突两旁、竖脊肌深面、回旋肌浅面。腰部多裂肌从乳突、骶骨和髂后上棘向上走向腰椎棘突，通常跨越 2–5 个节段（有的资料记为 2–4 个）。解剖研究描述它分成 5 束，每个腰椎各一束；并有 4 层，肌纤维呈多羽状排列。

text.en: Two conventions exist for naming its ends. Textbooks call the lower attachments the origin, whereas the dissection studies describe the same fascicles as arising from the spinous processes and laminae and running down. The figure and the muscle record here follow the textbook convention. Atlases mostly draw the lumbar multifidus as a deep muscle covered by the erector spinae and thoracolumbar fascia, although research papers also describe superficial fibres.
text.zh: 它两端的叫法有两种习惯。教材把下端附着称为起点，而解剖研究把同样的肌束描述为起自棘突和椎弓板、向下走行。本章的图和肌肉记录沿用教材的说法。解剖图谱多把腰部多裂肌画成被竖脊肌和胸腰筋膜覆盖的深层肌，研究文献也描述它有浅层纤维。

text.en: The rotatores are the deepest muscles of the group, running from a transverse process to the lamina and spinous process one level above (rotatores breves) or two levels above (rotatores longi). They are best developed in the thoracic region; in the lumbar region they are often inconsistent and may be replaced by deep fibres of the multifidus.
text.zh: 回旋肌是该肌群中最深的肌肉，从横突走向上一位（短回旋肌）或上两位（长回旋肌）椎骨的椎弓板和棘突。回旋肌以胸段最为发达；在腰部常不恒定，可被多裂肌深层纤维取代。

text.en: 1.6 Interspinales, intertransversarii and serratus posterior inferior
text.zh: 1.6 棘间肌、横突间肌与下后锯肌

text.en: The interspinales and intertransversarii are short muscles that each join two neighbouring lumbar vertebrae. The interspinales lie in pairs, one on each side of the interspinous ligament and medial to the multifidus, running from the superior aspect of one spinous process to the inferior aspect of the spinous process above; there are four pairs in the lumbar region. They are well developed in the lumbar and cervical regions but underdeveloped or absent in the thoracic region.
text.zh: 棘间肌和横突间肌都是连接相邻两个腰椎的短肌。棘间肌成对排列，分居棘间韧带两侧、多裂肌内侧，从一个棘突的上缘连到上一位棘突的下缘；腰部共有 4 对。它们在腰段和颈段发育良好，在胸段则发育不良或缺如。

text.en: The intertransversarii form two groups. The medial intertransversarii lumborum join the accessory process of one vertebra to the mammillary process of the vertebra below, anterior to the multifidus. The lateral intertransversarii lumborum join adjacent transverse processes, posterior to the psoas major and medial to the quadratus lumborum, and are divided further into ventral (anterior) parts, which attach between the transverse processes of neighbouring lumbar vertebrae, and dorsal (posterior) parts, which run from the accessory process of one vertebra to the transverse process of the next. The medial group is usually described as supplied by dorsal rami and the lateral group by ventral rami, although not every source keeps this split.
text.zh: 横突间肌分为两组。腰内侧横突间肌位于多裂肌前方，连接一个椎骨的副突与下一位椎骨的乳突。腰外侧横突间肌位于腰大肌后方、腰方肌内侧，连接相邻横突，又再分为腹侧部（前部）和背侧部（后部）：腹侧部连接相邻腰椎的横突，背侧部从一个椎骨的副突连到下一位椎骨的横突。通常描述内侧组由脊神经后支支配、外侧组由前支支配，但并非所有资料都这样区分。

text.en: Both muscles are rich in muscle spindles, which suggests a proprioceptive role. For the interspinales, stabilising the spine during movement and maintaining posture are thought to matter more than the extension they assist; the function of the intertransversarii is still not completely clear.
text.zh: 两者都富含肌梭，提示具有本体感觉作用。一般认为，棘间肌在运动中稳定脊柱、维持姿势的作用比它们所辅助的伸展更重要；横突间肌的功能目前仍未完全明确。

text.en: The serratus posterior inferior lies more superficially and belongs to the extrinsic back muscles. It is a thin, broad muscle running from the spinous processes of the T11–L2 vertebrae to ribs 9–12, deep to the latissimus dorsi and superficial to the erector spinae, supplied by ventral rami and pierced by the lateral branches of the T7–T12 thoracic spinal nerves. Its aponeurosis joins that of the latissimus dorsi to form the superficial lamina of the posterior layer of the thoracolumbar fascia.
text.zh: 下后锯肌位置更浅，属于背部外来肌。它是一块薄而宽的肌，从第 11 胸椎至第 2 腰椎（T11–L2）棘突连到第 9–12 肋，位于背阔肌深面、竖脊肌浅面，由脊神经前支支配，并有 T7–T12 胸神经的外侧支穿过。它的腱膜与背阔肌腱膜共同构成胸腰筋膜后层的浅层。

text.en: The quadratus lumborum and psoas major lie in the posterior abdominal wall, in front of the paraspinal muscles and beside the lumbar vertebrae, and both are supplied by ventral rami.
text.zh: 腰方肌和腰大肌位于腹后壁，在椎旁肌前方、腰椎两侧，二者都由脊神经前支支配。

text.en: The quadratus lumborum runs from the iliac crest and the iliolumbar ligament up to the 12th rib and the tips of the transverse processes of the L1–L4 vertebrae, lateral to the vertebrae and posterior to the psoas major and the kidney. It has three fibre layers whose arrangement is highly variable: an anterior layer of iliocostal and iliothoracic fibres, a middle layer of lumbocostal fibres and a posterior layer of lateral iliocostal and medial iliolumbar fibres. Most texts give it lateral flexion to the same side, lumbar extension and fixation of the 12th rib during inspiration. These actions are debated: one review reports a force of only 10 N in lateral tilt and in extension, and argues that the mobile 12th rib cannot pass the muscle's force to the diaphragm.
text.zh: 腰方肌从髂嵴和髂腰韧带向上连到第 12 肋和第 1–4 腰椎横突尖，位于腰椎外侧、腰大肌和肾的后方。它有三层纤维，排列变异很大：前层为髂肋纤维和髂胸纤维，中层为腰肋纤维，后层为外侧的髂肋纤维和内侧的髂腰纤维。多数教材认为它使腰椎向同侧侧屈和伸展，并在吸气时固定第 12 肋。这些作用有争议：有综述报告它在躯干侧倾和伸展时都只产生 10 N 的力，并认为活动的第 12 肋使它无法把力传给膈。

text.en: The psoas major arises from the lateral surfaces of the bodies of the T12–L4 vertebrae, the discs between them and the lumbar transverse processes (some sources extend the origin to the L5 vertebra), descends immediately lateral to the lumbar vertebrae and along the pelvic brim, and joins the iliacus to insert on the lesser trochanter of the femur. The roots of the lumbar plexus are embedded in its belly and the plexus branches emerge from the muscle, the genitofemoral nerve from its anterior surface. Its main action is hip flexion. Its effect on the lumbar spine is debated: some sources say it increases or maintains lumbar lordosis, whereas Bogduk held that its small moment arms give it little effect on the spine (see 3.2).
text.zh: 腰大肌起自第 12 胸椎至第 4 腰椎椎体侧面、其间的椎间盘和腰椎横突（有的资料把起点延伸到第 5 腰椎），紧贴腰椎外侧并沿骨盆界线下行，与髂肌汇合后止于股骨小转子。腰丛的根埋在它的肌腹内，腰丛分支从该肌穿出，其中生殖股神经从其前面穿出。它的主要作用是屈髋。它对腰椎的作用有争议：有资料认为它增加或维持腰椎前凸，而 Bogduk 认为它的力臂小，对脊柱作用有限（见 3.2）。

text.en: In the figure the quadratus lumborum is outlined from the 3D model, whereas the psoas major is drawn schematically.
text.zh: 图中腰方肌的轮廓取自 3D 模型，腰大肌是示意画法。

text.en: The thoracolumbar fascia is a girdling structure of several aponeurotic and fascial layers. It separates the paraspinal muscles from the muscles of the posterior abdominal wall and forms an osteofascial compartment for the intrinsic back muscles. In the lumbar region it is now usually described in three layers, posterior, middle and anterior, although older texts use a two-layer model. The figure is a cross-section at a mid-lumbar level seen from above, with anterior at the top, showing the vertebral body, the transverse processes and the spinous process together with the three layers.
text.zh: 胸腰筋膜是由多层腱膜和筋膜构成的环带状结构。它把椎旁肌与腹后壁肌分隔开，并为背固有肌构成骨筋膜鞘。在腰部，现在通常把它描述为三层，即后层、中层和前层，但较早的教材采用两层模型。图为腰椎中段水平的横断面，上面观、前方在上，显示椎体、横突和棘突以及这三层筋膜。

text.en: The posterior layer attaches to the spinous processes and supraspinous ligaments of the lumbar and sacral vertebrae; in the figure it runs from the spinous process over the erector spinae and multifidus to the lateral raphe. Its superficial lamina is formed largely by the aponeuroses of the latissimus dorsi and serratus posterior inferior, and its fibres cross the midline at the L4–L5 vertebral levels and below; the gluteus maximus and latissimus dorsi share an attachment to this layer. Its deep lamina forms the paraspinal retinacular sheath, a compartment around the paraspinal muscles that attaches to the posterior superior iliac spine and, below, to the sacrotuberous ligament. Willard et al. suggest that this sheath may act as a "hydraulic amplifier", assisting the paraspinal muscles in supporting the lumbosacral spine.
text.zh: 后层附着于腰椎和骶椎的棘突及棘上韧带；图中它从棘突越过竖脊肌和多裂肌，到达外侧缝。其浅层主要由背阔肌和下后锯肌的腱膜构成，纤维在第 4–5 腰椎（L4–L5）平面及以下越过中线；臀大肌和背阔肌共同附着于后层。其深层构成椎旁支持带鞘，即包绕椎旁肌的鞘，附着于髂后上棘，向下附着于骶结节韧带。Willard 等认为，这个鞘可能起“液压放大器”的作用，协助椎旁肌支撑腰骶部脊柱。

text.en: The middle layer is a thick, strong aponeurosis that arises from the tips of the lumbar transverse processes and passes laterally between the erector spinae behind and the quadratus lumborum in front; in the figure it reaches the lateral raphe, and vertically it extends from the 12th rib to the iliac crest. The lumbar part of the iliocostalis lumborum also attaches to the adjacent middle layer. The anterior layer is a thin membrane that covers the front of the quadratus lumborum and attaches medially to the lumbar transverse processes.
text.zh: 中层是厚而坚韧的腱膜，起自腰椎横突尖，向外走在后方的竖脊肌与前方的腰方肌之间；图中它到达外侧缝，上下则从第 12 肋延伸到髂嵴。腰髂肋肌的腰部也附着于邻近的中层。前层是覆盖腰方肌前面的薄膜，内侧附着于腰椎横突。

text.en: The lateral raphe lies along the lateral border of the paraspinal compartment and extends from the iliac crest to the 12th rib. There the aponeuroses of the transversus abdominis and internal oblique join the fascia (the abdominal wall muscles are shown cut in the figure), and this region may be important for transmitting force from the abdominal muscles to the lumbosacral spine. The layers therefore divide the cross-section into compartments: between the posterior and middle layers lie the iliocostalis lumborum laterally, the longissimus thoracis in the middle and the multifidus next to the spinous process; between the middle and anterior layers lies the quadratus lumborum, lateral to the transverse process. In the figure the psoas major lies in front of the transverse process against the vertebral body, outside these layers. As a whole, the fascia is thought to help stabilise the trunk and to transfer load between the trunk, pelvis and limbs, and it is described as playing a role in posture, load transfer and respiration.
text.zh: 外侧缝位于椎旁肌鞘的外侧缘，从髂嵴延伸到第 12 肋。腹横肌和腹内斜肌的腱膜在此与胸腰筋膜相连（图中腹壁肌为切断显示），这一区域可能对腹部肌肉向腰骶部脊柱传递力量很重要。于是这几层筋膜把横断面分成几个间隔：后层与中层之间，外侧是腰髂肋肌，中间是胸最长肌，紧靠棘突的是多裂肌；中层与前层之间是腰方肌，位于横突外侧。图中腰大肌位于横突前方、紧贴椎体，在这几层筋膜之外。总体上，一般认为胸腰筋膜有助于稳定躯干，并在躯干、骨盆与四肢之间传递负荷；它在姿势维持、负荷传递和呼吸中都有作用。

overview.en: The lumbar nerves drawn on the spine: where the spinal cord ends, how the lumbar roots of the cauda equina leave through the intervertebral foramina, the dorsal ramus branches that supply the back muscles, facet joints and skin, the sinuvertebral nerve to the back of the disc, the ventral rami that form the lumbar plexus and feed the femoral and sciatic nerves, and the nerve of every muscle in this chapter.
overview.zh: 画在脊柱上的腰神经：脊髓在哪里终止，马尾中的腰神经根如何经椎间孔穿出，后支的分支如何支配背部肌肉、关节突关节和皮肤，窦椎神经如何分布到椎间盘后部，前支如何组成腰丛并汇入股神经和坐骨神经，以及本章每块肌肉由哪条神经支配。

heading.en: T = Thoracic; L = Lumbar; S = Sacral
heading.zh: T = 胸部；L = 腰部；S = 骶部

paragraphs.en: T stands for thoracic, L for lumbar and S for sacral. In an innervation label such as L2–L4, the letters and numbers name the spinal nerves that contribute fibres, not vertebrae. Keep the bone and the nerve apart: the L4 vertebra is a bone, while the L4 spinal nerve (the L4 nerve root) is a nerve.
paragraphs.zh: T 代表胸部，L 代表腰部，S 代表骶部。神经支配里的 L2–L4 指贡献纤维的脊神经节段，不是椎骨。骨和神经要分开：第 4 腰椎是骨，第 4 腰神经（L4 神经根）是神经。

paragraphs.en: There are five pairs of lumbar spinal nerves, L1–L5. Each lumbar spinal nerve leaves the vertebral column below (caudal to) the vertebra of the same number, and at each disc level the exiting root hooks around the pedicle above that disc. At the L4–L5 level, for example, the exiting root is the L4 nerve root, while the L5 root passes the disc and leaves one level lower.
paragraphs.zh: 腰神经共 5 对，即 L1–L5。每条腰神经都在同序数椎骨的下方离开脊柱；在每个椎间盘平面，出口根绕过该椎间盘上方的椎弓根穿出。例如在 L4–L5 平面，出口根是 L4 神经根，而 L5 神经根越过这个椎间盘，在下一节段穿出。

paragraphs.en: Because the adult spinal cord usually ends at about the L1–L2 vertebral level, each lower root must run down inside the vertebral canal before it exits. T levels also appear in this chapter: quadratus lumborum receives T12 through the subcostal nerve, and serratus posterior inferior receives T9–T12.
paragraphs.zh: 由于成人脊髓通常止于约第 1–2 腰椎水平，下位的每条神经根都要先在椎管内下行一段才能穿出。本章也会出现 T 节段：腰方肌经肋下神经接受 T12，下后锯肌接受 T9–T12。

definitions.zh: 第 1 腰椎：骨；成人脊髓圆锥平均止于其椎体中 1/3 处
第 4 腰神经（L4 神经根）：神经，是 L4–L5 平面的出口根
第 1 骶神经：神经，其纤维与腰骶干一起加入骶丛
第 12 胸神经：神经，其前支即肋下神经

text.en: 2.1 From spinal cord to cauda equina

The spinal cord descends in the vertebral canal and tapers into the conus medullaris. In adults it usually ends at the L1–L2 vertebral level, most often opposite the L1/L2 disc; on average the tip lies at the middle third of the L1 vertebra, but it can lie as high as the middle third of T11 or as low as the middle third of L3. Summaries round this to about L1 or to L2. On imaging, a conus ending at or above the L2/L3 disc can be considered normal. A delicate fibrous strand about 20 cm long, the filum terminale, continues from the tip of the conus down to the sacrum and coccyx and anchors the cord and meninges.
text.zh: 脊髓在椎管内下行，逐渐变细，形成脊髓圆锥。成人脊髓圆锥通常终止于第 1–2 腰椎水平，最常见于 L1/L2 椎间盘平面；其尖端平均位于第 1 腰椎椎体中 1/3，但高可达第 11 胸椎椎体中 1/3，低可至第 3 腰椎椎体中 1/3。概括性的资料有的写约第 1 腰椎，有的写第 2 腰椎。影像学上，圆锥末端位于 L2/L3 椎间盘平面或以上可视为正常。一条长约 20 cm 的纤细纤维索，即终丝，自圆锥尖端向下延续到骶骨和尾骨，固定脊髓和脊膜。

text.en: Below the conus, the lumbar, sacral and coccygeal nerve roots continue downward as the cauda equina. Because the cord usually ends around the L1 vertebra, the cauda equina carries roughly the lower three to five lumbar pairs, the five sacral pairs and the coccygeal nerve. The roots lie inside the dural sac (thecal sac) in the lumbar cistern, suspended in cerebrospinal fluid, and the lower sacral and coccygeal roots lie dorsally in the sac. Because the cord ends far above the lower foramina, each root must travel downward before it exits. These roots supply the lower limbs, perineal sensation, the pelvic organs and the internal and external sphincters; parasympathetic fibres from the S2–S4 segments make the detrusor muscle of the bladder contract for micturition.
text.zh: 在脊髓圆锥以下，腰、骶、尾神经根继续下行，构成马尾。由于脊髓通常约在第 1 腰椎附近终止，马尾大约包含下部 3–5 对腰神经根、5 对骶神经根和尾神经。这些神经根位于硬脊膜囊内的终池中，悬浮于脑脊液里；下位骶神经根和尾神经根位于囊内背侧。由于脊髓终止位置远高于下位椎间孔，每条神经根都须先向下走行一段才能穿出。这些神经根支配下肢、会阴感觉、盆腔脏器以及内、外括约肌；来自 S2–S4 节段的副交感纤维使膀胱逼尿肌收缩，完成排尿。

text.en: At its own level, the dorsal (posterior, sensory) root and the ventral (anterior, motor) root of each segment unite at the intervertebral foramen to form one lumbar spinal nerve. Each lumbar spinal nerve leaves the vertebral column below the vertebra of the same number: at each disc level the exiting root hooks around the pedicle above the disc. The next root down, the traversing root, runs past the same disc to exit one level lower; it passes close to the disc and is the root that a disc herniation most often affects, whereas the exiting root is seldom compressed. At L4–L5 the exiting root is L4 and the traversing root is L5, which is why a paracentral or posterolateral L4–L5 herniation usually gives L5 symptoms and a far-lateral one gives L4 symptoms.
text.zh: 到达本节段水平时，该节段的背根（后根，感觉性）与腹根（前根，运动性）在椎间孔处汇合，形成一条腰神经。每条腰神经都在同序数椎骨的下方离开脊柱：在每个椎间盘平面，出口根绕过该椎间盘上方的椎弓根穿出。下一条神经根，即走行根，越过同一椎间盘，在下一节段穿出；它紧贴椎间盘经过，是椎间盘突出最常累及的神经根，而出口根很少受压。在 L4–L5 平面，出口根是 L4，走行根是 L5，因此 L4–L5 旁中央型或后外侧型突出通常表现为 L5 症状，极外侧型突出则表现为 L4 症状。

text.en: The dorsal root ganglion is an oval swelling on each dorsal root that contains the cell bodies of the sensory neurons of that segment; their central processes enter the cord through the dorsal root. The ganglion sits close to where the dorsal and ventral roots join. In the lumbar spine it may lie inside the vertebral canal, within the intervertebral foramen or outside it, and it lies progressively more laterally from L1 to L5, so lower lumbar ganglia are more likely to be found within the foramen. In one anatomic and MRI study its centre lay in the medial zone of the foramen at L1–L4 and in the lateral zone at L5. Because foraminal and extraforaminal disc herniations can compress the ganglion, their pain may be burning or dysaesthetic.
text.zh: 背根神经节是每条背根上的椭圆形膨大，内含本节段感觉神经元的胞体，这些神经元的中枢突经背根进入脊髓。神经节靠近背根与腹根汇合之处。在腰椎，它可位于椎管内、椎间孔内或椎间孔外；自 L1 至 L5，神经节的位置逐渐偏外，因此下腰椎的神经节更可能位于椎间孔内。一项解剖与磁共振研究发现，L1–L4 神经节中心位于椎间孔内侧区，L5 则位于外侧区。椎间孔型和椎间孔外型椎间盘突出可压迫背根神经节，因此其疼痛可呈烧灼样或感觉异常样。

text.en: Near its exit from the intervertebral foramen, each lumbar spinal nerve divides into two rami. The dorsal ramus, usually the smaller, turns backward to the deep back muscles, the facet joints and the skin of the back (2.2). The ventral ramus, the larger, runs forward: the ventral rami of L1–L4 join within psoas major to form the lumbar plexus, and fibres of L4 join L5 as the lumbosacral trunk (2.3). Near its origin the ventral ramus usually gives a small recurrent branch, the sinuvertebral nerve, back into the vertebral canal. The L1 and L2 nerves also send sympathetic axons to the sympathetic chain.
text.zh: 每条腰神经在出椎间孔后不久分为两支。后支通常较细，转向后方，分布于背部深层肌、关节突关节和背部皮肤（见 2.2）。前支较粗，走向前方：L1–L4 前支在腰大肌内汇合组成腰丛，部分 L4 纤维与 L5 合成腰骶干（见 2.3）。前支在起始处附近通常发出一条细小的返支，即窦椎神经，返回椎管。L1 和 L2 神经还向交感干发出交感纤维。

summary.en: Conus medullaris and cauda equina lesions compared
summary.zh: 脊髓圆锥病变与马尾病变的比较

columns.zh: 脊髓圆锥病变（典型表现）

rows.zh: 疼痛

rows.zh: 突发剧烈背痛

rows.zh: 剧烈的单侧根性痛

rows.zh: 感觉

rows.zh: 肛周感觉缺失

rows.en: Saddle anaesthesia (perianal and inner-thigh numbness)
rows.zh: 鞍区感觉缺失（肛周及大腿内侧麻木）

rows.zh: 无力与反射

rows.en: Symmetric lower-limb weakness with hyperreflexia
rows.zh: 双下肢对称性无力伴反射亢进

text.en: Cauda equina syndrome is most often caused by a lumbar disc herniation compressing or irritating the lumbosacral roots. A history of bowel or bladder incontinence, urinary retention or lower-limb weakness suggests an acute neurological deficit and should prompt a more aggressive work-up.
text.zh: 马尾综合征最常见的原因是腰椎间盘突出压迫或刺激腰骶神经根。病史中出现大小便失禁、尿潴留或下肢无力，提示急性神经功能缺损，应进行更积极的检查。

text.en: 2.2 Dorsal ramus, its branches and the sinuvertebral nerve
text.zh: 2.2 后支及其分支与窦椎神经

text.en: The dorsal rami supply the back itself. Their branches give motor supply to the deep paraspinal muscles, sensory supply to the skin of the back and upper buttock, and supply to the synovial zygapophyseal (facet) joints. The sinuvertebral nerve, which usually arises from the ventral ramus and the grey ramus communicans, runs back into the vertebral canal and supplies the back of the disc and the posterior longitudinal ligament. Seen from above at the L4 vertebra, the dorsal ramus turns backward from the spinal nerve and splits into a medial branch to multifidus and the facet joint, an intermediate branch to longissimus and a lateral branch to iliocostalis.
text.zh: 后支支配背部本身。其分支向背部深层的椎旁肌提供运动支配，向背部和臀上部皮肤提供感觉支配，并支配滑膜性的关节突关节。窦椎神经通常由前支和灰交通支发出，返回椎管，分布于椎间盘后部和后纵韧带。在第 4 腰椎平面上面观，后支从脊神经转向后方，分为三支：内侧支到多裂肌和关节突关节，中间支到最长肌，外侧支到髂肋肌。

text.en: Each zygapophyseal joint has two nerves. After the dorsal ramus passes through the intertransverse ligament, the medial branches of L1–L4 cross the top of the transverse process one level below the named nerve, so the L3 medial branch crosses the L4 transverse process and the L4 medial branch crosses the L5 transverse process. Each medial branch sends one articular twig to the joint at its own level and one to the joint below. A facet joint therefore receives two medial branches, usually from the same level and the level above: the L3–L4 zygapophyseal joint receives the L2 and L3 medial branches, and the L4–L5 joint receives the L3 and L4 medial branches. The L5 dorsal ramus typically has no lateral branch, and by the same rule the L5–S1 joint receives the L4 medial branch and the medial branch of the L5 dorsal ramus. The L3 lateral branch, one of the upper three, runs downward and laterally toward the iliac crest, where it continues as a superior cluneal nerve. Some descriptions say only that each medial branch crosses 'its' transverse process, so check which numbering a source uses.
text.zh: 每个关节突关节都有两条神经。后支穿过横突间韧带后，L1–L4 的内侧支越过低于同名神经一个节段的横突上缘，所以 L3 内侧支越过第 4 腰椎横突，L4 内侧支越过第 5 腰椎横突。每条内侧支向本节段的关节和下一节段的关节各发出一支关节支。因此每个关节突关节接受两条内侧支，通常来自同一节段和上一节段：L3–L4 关节突关节接受 L2 和 L3 内侧支，L4–L5 关节接受 L3 和 L4 内侧支。L5 后支通常没有外侧支；按同一规律，L5–S1 关节接受 L4 内侧支和 L5 后支的内侧支。L3 外侧支属于上三条外侧支，向外下方走向髂嵴，并在那里延续为臀上皮神经。有的资料只写每条内侧支越过“各自的”横突，读资料时要看清它用的是哪种编号。

heading.en: Dorsal ramus of a lumbar spinal nerve

paragraphs.en: Each lumbar spinal nerve, L1–L5.
paragraphs.zh: L1–L5 每条腰神经。

paragraphs.en: The dorsal ramus is one of the two terminal branches of each lumbar spinal nerve and is usually the smaller. It branches off near the exit from the intervertebral foramen, turns backward through the intertransverse ligament and muscle, and divides into a medial branch and a lateral branch; a variable intermediate branch is also described.
paragraphs.zh: 后支是每条腰神经的两条终支之一，通常较前支细小。它在腰神经出椎间孔后不久分出，转向后方穿过横突间韧带和横突间肌，分为内侧支和外侧支；资料还描述了一条不恒定的中间支。

items.en: Supplies: Through its branches, the deep paraspinal muscles of the back (motor), the skin of the back and upper buttock (sensory) and the synovial facet joints.
items.zh: 支配：通过其分支，支配背部深层椎旁肌（运动）、背部和臀上部皮肤（感觉）以及滑膜性关节突关节。

heading.en: Medial branch of the dorsal ramus

paragraphs.en: Medial division of each lumbar dorsal ramus, L1–L5.
paragraphs.zh: L1–L5 每条腰神经后支的内侧分支。

paragraphs.en: After the dorsal ramus passes through the intertransverse ligament and the medial intertransverse muscle, the medial branches of L1–L4 cross the top of the transverse process one level below. Each lies in the groove where the root of that transverse process meets the root of the superior articular process of the same vertebra, held tightly there by the mamillo-accessory ligament, which bridges the mamillary and accessory processes; the nerve passes beneath this ligament. It then runs medially and downward across the lamina deep to multifidus and gives an interspinous branch over the lamina toward the interspinous muscle and ligament.
paragraphs.zh: 后支穿过横突间韧带和腰内侧横突间肌后，L1–L4 的内侧支越过下一节段横突的上缘。每条内侧支位于该横突根部与同一椎骨上关节突根部交界处形成的沟内，被连接乳突与副突的乳突副突韧带紧紧压在沟内，神经从该韧带深面通过。随后它向内下方越过椎弓板，位于多裂肌深面，并在椎弓板表面发出棘间支，走向棘间肌和棘间韧带。

items.en: Supplies: Multifidus, the rotatores, interspinales and the interspinous ligament, and the zygapophyseal joints. Each facet joint receives two medial branches, one from its own level and one from the level above.
items.zh: 支配：多裂肌、回旋肌、棘间肌和棘间韧带，以及关节突关节。每个关节突关节接受两条内侧支，一条来自同一节段，一条来自上一节段。

items.en: Clinical relevance: Pain from the facet joint capsule and synovial folds is carried by the medial branches, which are the targets of diagnostic medial branch blocks and radiofrequency denervation. Because of the dual supply, a block or radiofrequency lesion for one joint must cover two adjacent medial branches, and two diagnostic blocks are recommended to confirm facet-joint pain. These branches do not supply sensation or muscles in the limbs.
items.zh: 临床意义：关节突关节囊和滑膜皱襞的痛觉由内侧支传导，内侧支是诊断性内侧支阻滞和射频去神经治疗的靶点。由于存在双重支配，针对一个关节的阻滞或射频毁损必须覆盖两条相邻的内侧支，并建议进行两次诊断性阻滞以确认关节突关节疼痛。这些分支不负责四肢的感觉或肌肉。

heading.en: Intermediate branch of the dorsal ramus

paragraphs.en: A variable branch of the lumbar dorsal ramus, sometimes arising from the lateral branch; its segmental range is not given in the sources.
paragraphs.zh: 腰神经后支的一条不恒定分支，有时由外侧支发出；资料未给出其节段范围。

paragraphs.en: It leaves the dorsal ramus, or its lateral branch, together with the medial and lateral branches and travels to longissimus. Most of the sources used here give it the longissimus (2.4); some instead credit the lateral branches with that muscle.
paragraphs.zh: 它与内侧支、外侧支一同自后支（或其外侧支）发出，走向最长肌。本章所用资料多数把最长肌归于中间支（见 2.4），也有资料把它归于外侧支。

items.en: Supplies: Longissimus; in the lumbar region this is the supply of longissimus thoracis.
items.zh: 支配：最长肌；在腰段即胸最长肌的神经支配。

heading.en: Lateral branch of the dorsal ramus

paragraphs.en: Lateral division of each lumbar dorsal ramus; there is typically no lateral branch at L5.
paragraphs.zh: 每条腰神经后支的外侧分支；L5 通常没有外侧支。

paragraphs.en: It leaves the dorsal ramus immediately after the ramus passes through the intertransverse ligament and runs downward, backward and laterally, deep to the iliocostalis and longissimus parts of the lumbar erector spinae. The upper three lateral branches (L1–L3) emerge from the lateral border of iliocostalis lumborum, pierce the posterior layer of the thoracolumbar fascia and become cutaneous over the buttock as the superior cluneal nerves. The L4 lateral branch stays between the muscles.
paragraphs.zh: 后支穿过横突间韧带后立即发出外侧支，在腰部竖脊肌的髂肋肌和最长肌深面向下、向后、向外走行。上三条外侧支（L1–L3）自腰髂肋肌外侧缘穿出，穿过胸腰筋膜后层，在臀区浅出成为皮神经，即臀上皮神经。L4 外侧支则留在肌间。

items.en: Supplies: Mainly iliocostalis lumborum; some sources add the longissimus part of the lumbar erector spinae. Through the superior cluneal nerves, the upper branches supply the skin of the upper buttock.
items.zh: 支配：主要支配腰髂肋肌；有的资料还列出腰部竖脊肌的最长肌部分。上位外侧支经臀上皮神经分布于臀上部皮肤。

paragraphs.en: Lateral branches of the lumbar dorsal rami, classically L1–L3; anatomical studies report contributions from T11 or T12 down to L5.
paragraphs.zh: 腰神经后支的外侧支，经典描述为 L1–L3；解剖学研究报告其来源可从 T11 或 T12 延伸至 L5。

paragraphs.en: The lateral branches of the upper lumbar dorsal rami run laterally deep to erector spinae, then pierce the posterior layer of the thoracolumbar fascia, running from superomedial to inferolateral. They cross the posterior iliac crest, where the medial branch of the superior cluneal nerves passes through an osteofibrous tunnel formed by the thoracolumbar fascia and the iliac crest, usually about 7 cm from the midline, and become cutaneous over the upper buttock. Reported distances vary: about 6.6 to 7 cm in most accounts, but 3–4 cm for the medial branch and 7–8 cm for the middle branch in the series of Isu et al. (see 4.2).
paragraphs.zh: 上位腰神经后支的外侧支在竖脊肌深面向外走行，随后由内上斜向外下穿过胸腰筋膜后层。它们越过髂嵴后部；在此处，臀上皮神经内侧支穿过由胸腰筋膜和髂嵴围成的骨纤维管，该处通常距后正中线约 7 cm；随后在臀上部浅出成为皮神经。各资料给出的距离不同：多数写约 6.6 至 7 cm，Isu 等的病例系列则给出内侧支 3–4 cm、中支 7–8 cm（见 4.2）。

items.en: Supplies: The skin of the upper buttock and over the posterior iliac crest.
items.zh: 支配：臀上部及髂嵴后部的皮肤。

items.en: Entrapment or injury: Entrapment in the osteofibrous tunnel, or where the nerves pierce the thoracolumbar fascia, is a cause of low back pain. Pain lies over the iliac crest and buttock and may radiate to the posterior thigh or leg; it is aggravated by lumbar extension, bending, rotation, prolonged walking or prolonged sitting. Examination finds a tender trigger point over the posterior iliac crest, and tapping there (a Tinel-like sign) reproduces numbness and radiating pain in the nerve's territory.
items.zh: 卡压或损伤：在骨纤维管内或神经穿出胸腰筋膜处发生的卡压是下背痛的原因之一。疼痛位于髂嵴和臀部，可放射至大腿后面或小腿；腰部后伸、弯腰、旋转、长时间行走或久坐可使疼痛加重。检查可在髂嵴后部发现压痛明显的触发点，在该处叩击（类似蒂内尔征）可在神经分布区诱发麻木和放射痛。

heading.zh: 窦椎神经（脊神经脊膜支）

paragraphs.en: Usually two roots: a somatic root from the ventral ramus and an autonomic root from the grey ramus communicans, so it carries sensory and sympathetic fibres.
paragraphs.zh: 通常有两个根：来自前支的躯体根和来自灰交通支的自主神经根，因此同时含有感觉纤维和交感纤维。

paragraphs.en: It arises in the region of the intervertebral foramen and runs backward, a recurrent course, through the foramen into the vertebral canal; one cadaveric study describes it entering near the inferior vertebral notch. Inside the canal it may split into ascending and descending branches, or run mainly in one direction, to the back of the discs and vertebral bodies. It may be absent at some lumbar levels: that study found no sinuvertebral nerve in 9 of 48 canals and two at the same level in 4 of 48, whereas atlas descriptions show meningeal branches at every lumbar level.
paragraphs.zh: 它在椎间孔区发出，向后返行，经椎间孔进入椎管；一项尸体研究描述它在椎下切迹附近进入。在椎管内它可分为升支和降支，也可主要朝一个方向走行，分布于椎间盘和椎体的后面。它在部分腰椎节段可能缺如：该研究在 48 个椎管中有 9 个未发现窦椎神经，另有 4 个在同一节段发现两条；而图谱式的描述是每个腰椎节段都有脊膜支。

items.en: Supplies: The posterior part of the annulus fibrosus of the intervertebral disc, the posterior longitudinal ligament, the periosteum of the vertebral body, the ventral (anterior) surface of the dura mater and the blood vessels of the epidural space.
items.zh: 支配：椎间盘纤维环后部、后纵韧带、椎体骨膜、硬脊膜腹侧面（前部）以及硬膜外隙的血管。

items.en: Clinical relevance: It is regarded as one of the main structures contributing to lumbar discogenic pain. Provocative discography is used to diagnose degenerative disc disease, and one cadaveric study suggests blocking the nerve at the inferior vertebral notch of two adjacent segments.
items.zh: 临床意义：窦椎神经被视为腰椎间盘源性疼痛的主要相关结构之一。诊断退行性椎间盘疾病可借助激发性椎间盘造影；一项尸体研究建议在相邻两个节段的椎下切迹水平阻滞该神经。

text.en: 2.3 Ventral rami: lumbar plexus, femoral and sciatic nerves
text.zh: 2.3 前支：腰丛、股神经与坐骨神经

text.en: The ventral rami are the larger terminal branches of the L1–L5 spinal nerves and provide the spinal contributions to the plexuses. The ventral rami of L1–L4, usually with a contribution from T12, join within the substance of psoas major, in front of the transverse processes of the lumbar vertebrae, to form the lumbar plexus; the roots of the plexus are embedded in the muscle belly and its branches emerge from the muscle. Fibres of L4 join L5 as the lumbosacral trunk, which runs down into the sacral plexus on the lateral pelvic wall. Because the lumbar and sacral plexuses share roots, they are often described together as the lumbosacral plexus. The roots are given as L1–L4, with or without T12, and variation is common. In the lower back itself, the ventral rami supply psoas major, quadratus lumborum (together with T12) and usually the lateral intertransversarii (2.4).
text.zh: 前支是 L1–L5 脊神经两条终支中较粗大者，是各大神经丛的脊神经来源。L1–L4 前支（通常还有 T12 的纤维参与）在腰大肌实质内、腰椎横突前方汇合，组成腰丛；腰丛的根埋于腰大肌肌腹内，其分支自该肌穿出。部分 L4 纤维与 L5 合成腰骶干，向下加入盆腔侧壁的骶丛。腰丛和骶丛共享部分神经根，因此常合称为腰骶丛。各资料给出的根是 L1–L4，有的加上 T12，变异很常见。在下背部本身，前支支配腰大肌和腰方肌（与 T12 一起），通常还支配腰外侧横突间肌（见 2.4）。

paragraphs.en: Ventral rami of L1–L4, usually with a contribution from T12.
paragraphs.zh: L1–L4 前支，通常有 T12 的纤维参与。

paragraphs.en: The plexus forms within psoas major, in front of the lumbar transverse processes. The iliohypogastric and ilioinguinal nerves arise from L1. The anterior divisions give the genitofemoral nerve (L1–L2), which emerges from the front of psoas major, and the obturator nerve (L2–L4); the posterior divisions give the lateral femoral cutaneous nerve (L2–L3) and the femoral nerve (L2–L4). Fibres from L4 join L5 as the lumbosacral trunk, linking the lumbar plexus with the sacral plexus.
paragraphs.zh: 腰丛在腰大肌内、腰椎横突前方形成。髂腹下神经和髂腹股沟神经来自 L1。前股发出生殖股神经（L1–L2，自腰大肌前面穿出）和闭孔神经（L2–L4）；后股发出股外侧皮神经（L2–L3）和股神经（L2–L4）。部分 L4 纤维与 L5 合成腰骶干，把腰丛与骶丛连接起来。

items.en: Supplies: Through the branches named above, the skin and muscles of the lower abdominal wall, groin and thigh; the femoral nerve continues to the medial leg through the saphenous nerve.
items.zh: 支配：经上述各分支分布于下腹壁、腹股沟区和大腿的皮肤与肌肉；股神经经隐神经延续到小腿内侧。

paragraphs.en: Fibres of the L4 ventral ramus joined by the L5 ventral ramus.
paragraphs.zh: L4 前支的部分纤维与 L5 前支合成。

paragraphs.en: It runs inferiorly, medial to psoas major, in front of iliacus and behind the iliac artery and vein. It combines with fibres of the first sacral nerve to join the sacral plexus, which forms on the lateral pelvic wall.
paragraphs.zh: 它向下走行，位于腰大肌内侧、髂肌前方、髂动脉和髂静脉后方。随后与第 1 骶神经的纤维汇合，加入在盆腔侧壁形成的骶丛。

items.en: Supplies: It carries L4 and L5 fibres into the sacral plexus and so into the sciatic nerve (L4–S3).
items.zh: 支配：它把 L4 和 L5 的纤维送入骶丛，进而进入坐骨神经（L4–S3）。

paragraphs.en: Ventral rami of L2–L4, posterior divisions.
paragraphs.zh: L2–L4 前支的后股。

paragraphs.en: It forms in the lumbar plexus, passes through psoas major and emerges from the lower lateral border of the muscle. It descends between psoas major and iliacus, on the front of iliacus deep to the iliac fascia, and gives a branch to iliacus. It passes beneath the inguinal ligament, lateral to the femoral artery, into the femoral triangle and gives a branch to pectineus. About 4 cm below the ligament it divides into anterior (superficial) and posterior (deep) divisions, which the lateral circumflex femoral artery separates.
paragraphs.zh: 它在腰丛内形成，穿过腰大肌，自该肌下部外侧缘穿出。随后在腰大肌与髂肌之间、髂肌前面的髂筋膜深面下行，并发支支配髂肌。它在股动脉外侧经腹股沟韧带深面进入股三角，并发支支配耻骨肌。在韧带下方约 4 cm 处分为前（浅）股和后（深）股，两股之间隔着旋股外侧动脉。

items.en: Supplies: Motor to iliacus, pectineus, sartorius and quadriceps femoris (knee extension). Sensory to the skin of the anterior and medial thigh through the anterior cutaneous branches and, through the saphenous nerve, to the medial leg, ankle and foot. Articular branches reach the hip and knee joints.
items.zh: 支配：运动支配髂肌、耻骨肌、缝匠肌和股四头肌（伸膝）。感觉方面，经股前皮支分布于大腿前面和内侧皮肤，经隐神经分布于小腿内侧、踝和足内侧。关节支分布于髋关节和膝关节。

items.en: Entrapment or injury: Femoral neuropathy causes quadriceps wasting, loss of knee extension and, to a lesser extent, weak hip flexion, with a reduced or absent patellar reflex and sensory loss over the anterior and medial thigh and the medial leg and foot. Damage to the saphenous nerve during saphenous vein stripping can cause pain, paraesthesia or sensory loss over the medial lower leg.
items.zh: 卡压或损伤：股神经病变可导致股四头肌萎缩、伸膝功能丧失及程度较轻的屈髋无力，伴膝反射减弱或消失，以及大腿前面和内侧、小腿内侧和足内侧的感觉丧失。大隐静脉剥脱术中损伤隐神经，可引起小腿内侧疼痛、感觉异常或感觉丧失。

paragraphs.en: Ventral rami of L4–S3, through the lumbosacral trunk and the sacral plexus.
paragraphs.zh: L4–S3 前支，经腰骶干和骶丛组成。

paragraphs.en: The L4–S3 contributions form the sciatic nerve from the sacral (lumbosacral) plexus. It leaves the pelvis through the greater sciatic foramen, emerging below piriformis. It descends inferolaterally through the gluteal region over the gemelli, obturator internus and quadratus femoris, then enters the posterior thigh deep to the long head of biceps femoris. At the apex of the popliteal fossa it divides into the tibial and common fibular nerves.
paragraphs.zh: L4–S3 的纤维经骶丛（腰骶丛）组成坐骨神经。它经坐骨大孔出盆，从梨状肌下方穿出。随后在臀区经孖肌、闭孔内肌和股方肌后面向外下方下行，在股二头肌长头深面进入大腿后部。在腘窝上角分为胫神经和腓总神经。

items.en: Supplies: Directly, the hamstrings (biceps femoris, semitendinosus, semimembranosus) and the hamstring part of adductor magnus; it supplies no gluteal muscle and has no direct cutaneous branch. Through the tibial and common fibular nerves, the muscles of the leg and foot and the skin of the posterolateral and lateral leg, the lateral foot, the sole and the dorsum of the foot.
items.zh: 支配：直接支配腘绳肌（股二头肌、半腱肌、半膜肌）和大收肌的腘绳部；不支配臀肌，也没有直接的皮支。经胫神经和腓总神经间接支配小腿和足部肌，以及小腿后外侧和外侧、足外侧缘、足底和足背的皮肤。

items.en: Entrapment or injury: Compression by piriformis (piriformis syndrome) causes radicular pain, numbness, muscle weakness and buttock tenderness, and intramuscular injections are given only in the upper lateral quadrant of the buttock to avoid the nerve. A straight leg raise that reproduces pain radiating below the knee at less than 70° suggests an L4, L5 or S1 radiculopathy.
items.zh: 卡压或损伤：梨状肌压迫坐骨神经（梨状肌综合征）可引起根性痛、麻木、肌无力和臀部压痛；肌内注射只在臀部外上象限进行，以避开该神经。直腿抬高试验在小于 70° 时诱发放射至膝以下的疼痛，提示 L4、L5 或 S1 神经根病。

text.en: The intrinsic back muscles are supplied by dorsal rami: the lateral branches reach iliocostalis and spinalis, the intermediate (and lateral) branches longissimus, and the medial branches multifidus, the rotatores and interspinales. Serratus posterior inferior, an extrinsic back muscle of the intermediate layer, is supplied by ventral rami, as are psoas major and quadratus lumborum. The intertransversarii are split: the medial group usually by dorsal rami and the lateral group usually by ventral rami.
text.zh: 背部固有肌由后支支配：外侧支到髂肋肌和棘肌，中间支（及外侧支）到最长肌，内侧支到多裂肌、回旋肌和棘间肌。下后锯肌属于背部外来肌的中间层，由前支支配，腰大肌和腰方肌也由前支支配。横突间肌则分为两组：内侧组通常由后支支配，外侧组通常由前支支配。

rows.en: Iliocostalis lumborum
rows.zh: 腰髂肋肌

rows.en: Lateral branches of the dorsal rami of the thoracic and lumbar spinal nerves; at the lumbar level, the lateral branch of each corresponding segment
rows.zh: 胸神经和腰神经后支的外侧支；在腰段为相应节段后支的外侧支

rows.en: Thoracic and lumbar; one source gives T7–L3
rows.zh: 胸段和腰段；有一处资料写 T7–L3

rows.en: Longissimus thoracis
rows.zh: 胸最长肌

rows.en: Dorsal rami of the thoracic and lumbar spinal nerves: in the lumbar region the intermediate (and lateral) branches, in the thoracic region the medial and lateral branches; some sources name only the lateral branches
rows.zh: 胸神经和腰神经后支：腰段为中间支（及外侧支），胸段为内侧支和外侧支；也有资料只写外侧支

rows.en: Thoracic and lumbar; one source gives T7–L5
rows.zh: 胸段和腰段；有一处资料写 T7–L5

rows.en: Spinalis thoracis
rows.zh: 胸棘肌

rows.en: Lateral branches of the dorsal rami of the adjacent thoracic and upper lumbar spinal nerves
rows.zh: 邻近胸神经和上位腰神经后支的外侧支

rows.en: Thoracic and upper lumbar; exact segments not given
rows.zh: 胸段和上位腰段；未给出具体节段

rows.en: Multifidus
rows.zh: 多裂肌

rows.en: Medial branches of the dorsal rami of the lumbar spinal nerves
rows.zh: 腰神经后支内侧支

rows.en: Segmental: Bogduk et al. described each medial branch supplying the fascicles that arise from the spinous process and lamina of the vertebra with the same number, whereas Wu et al. concluded the supply is polysegmental
rows.zh: 节段性：Bogduk 等描述为每条内侧支支配起自同序数椎骨棘突和椎弓板的肌束，Wu 等则认为是多节段支配

rows.en: Rotatores
rows.zh: 回旋肌

rows.en: Medial branches of the dorsal rami of the corresponding spinal nerves
rows.zh: 相应脊神经后支内侧支

rows.en: Corresponding segment; no specific levels given
rows.zh: 相应节段；未给出具体节段

rows.en: Interspinales
rows.zh: 棘间肌

rows.en: Dorsal rami of the respective lumbar spinal nerves, through the interspinous branch of the medial branch
rows.zh: 相应腰神经后支，经内侧支的棘间支

rows.en: The respective lumbar segments
rows.zh: 相应腰段

rows.en: Intertransversarii, medial group (medial intertransversarii lumborum)
rows.zh: 横突间肌内侧组（腰内侧横突间肌）

rows.en: Usually the dorsal rami of the adjacent lumbar spinal nerves; some sources list both rami, or ventral rami only
rows.zh: 通常为相邻腰神经后支；有的资料列前支和后支，或只列前支

rows.en: Adjacent lumbar segments
rows.zh: 相邻腰段

rows.en: Intertransversarii, lateral group (lateral intertransversarii lumborum)
rows.zh: 横突间肌外侧组（腰外侧横突间肌）

rows.en: Usually the ventral rami of the lumbar spinal nerves; some sources list both rami
rows.zh: 通常为腰神经前支；有的资料列前支和后支

rows.en: Lumbar; no specific levels given
rows.zh: 腰段；未给出具体节段

rows.en: Quadratus lumborum
rows.zh: 腰方肌

rows.en: Usually the subcostal nerve and the ventral rami of L1–L4. Other lists name the subcostal, iliohypogastric and ilioinguinal nerves, with branches of the L2 and L3 ventral rami
rows.zh: 通常为肋下神经和 L1–L4 前支。也有资料列为肋下神经、髂腹下神经、髂腹股沟神经以及 L2、L3 前支的分支

rows.en: Usually T12–L4
rows.zh: 通常为 T12–L4

rows.en: Psoas major
rows.zh: 腰大肌

rows.en: Branches of the lumbar ventral rami, reaching the muscle through the lumbar plexus; small branches of the femoral nerve are also described
rows.zh: 腰神经前支的分支，经腰丛到达该肌；也有资料提到来自股神经的细小分支

rows.en: Usually L1–L3, mainly L2; some sources give L1–L4
rows.zh: 通常为 L1–L3，以 L2 为主；有的资料写 L1–L4

rows.en: Serratus posterior inferior
rows.zh: 下后锯肌

rows.en: Ventral rami of the lower thoracic spinal nerves; the T12 branch is the subcostal nerve
rows.zh: 下位胸神经前支；T12 的分支即肋下神经
T9–T12 节段

overview.en: From attachments and lines of pull to the four lumbar movements; the facet joints, disc and ligaments in motion; pelvic tilt and lumbar lordosis; lumbopelvic rhythm, flexion-relaxation and feedforward trunk muscle activation.
overview.zh: 从起止点和拉力线讲到腰椎的四种运动；运动中的关节突关节、椎间盘和韧带；骨盆倾斜与腰椎前凸；腰椎-骨盆节律、屈曲-放松现象和躯干肌的前馈激活。

text.en: 3.1 Lumbar movements and the muscles that produce them
text.zh: 3.1 腰椎的运动与产生运动的肌肉

text.en: The lumbar spine moves mainly in the sagittal plane: flexion and extension are its dominant movements, lateral flexion is moderate, and axial rotation is very small. Each movement is produced by muscles whose line of pull passes on the side of the movement axis that turns the segment in that direction, so the table links every movement to the course of the muscles that make it. The ranges are for the lumbar spine as a whole.
text.zh: 腰椎主要在矢状面上运动：前屈和后伸是主要运动，侧屈幅度中等，轴向旋转很小。每种运动都由拉力线经过运动轴相应一侧、能使节段朝该方向转动的肌肉产生，因此下表把每种运动与产生它的肌肉的走行对应起来。活动度指腰椎整体。

columns.en: How the line of pull produces it
columns.zh: 拉力线如何产生该运动

rows.en: Flexion (forward bending). Range: about 55–60°.

In standing, gravity flexes the trunk, and the erector spinae (iliocostalis lumborum and longissimus thoracis) control the movement eccentrically. Psoas major is described as contributing to lumbar flexion, but its lumbar role is debated (3.2).
rows.zh: 站立时由重力使躯干前屈，竖脊肌（腰髂肋肌和胸最长肌）以离心收缩控制这一运动。腰大肌被描述为参与腰椎前屈，但它对腰椎的作用存在争议（见 3.2）。

rows.en: The erector spinae lie behind the axis, so as gravity flexes the trunk they contract while lengthening and pay out length to control the descent and the anterior pelvic tilt. Psoas major runs downward from the lateral surfaces of the bodies of the T12 to L4 vertebrae, the discs between them and the lumbar transverse processes to the lesser trochanter of the femur; with the femur fixed it acts on the lumbar spine. Flexion is limited by tension in the posterior longitudinal ligament and the ligamenta flava, among other structures.
rows.zh: 竖脊肌位于运动轴后方，重力使躯干前屈时，它们在被拉长的同时收缩，逐渐放长，以控制躯干下降和骨盆前倾。腰大肌由第 12 胸椎至第 4 腰椎椎体侧面、其间的椎间盘和腰椎横突向下走向股骨小转子；股骨固定时，它作用于腰椎。前屈受后纵韧带和黄韧带等结构的张力限制。

rows.en: Extension (backward bending). Range: about 25–30°.

The erector spinae (iliocostalis lumborum and longissimus thoracis) and multifidus acting on both sides; together they form the lumbar extensor group. The interspinales are thought to assist, and the rotatores contribute little. Quadratus lumborum is listed as a bilateral extensor, but its force is small.
rows.zh: 两侧同时收缩的竖脊肌（腰髂肋肌和胸最长肌）和多裂肌；二者合称腰部伸肌群。棘间肌被认为起辅助作用，回旋肌的贡献很小。腰方肌被列为双侧收缩时的伸肌，但其力量很小。

rows.en: These muscles lie behind the axis. Acting on both sides, iliocostalis lumborum pulls the lower ribs and the lumbar transverse processes toward the sacrum and ilium, and longissimus thoracis draws the thoracic transverse processes and ribs toward the sacrum and pelvis. Multifidus fascicles pull the spinous process of the vertebra above down toward the mammillary processes and the sacrum below, drawing that vertebra into extension. Each pair of interspinales draws two adjacent spinous processes together. Extension is limited by tension in the anterior longitudinal ligament.
rows.zh: 这些肌肉位于运动轴后方。两侧同时收缩时，腰髂肋肌把下位肋和腰椎横突拉向骶骨和髂骨，胸最长肌把胸椎横突和肋骨拉向骶骨和骨盆。多裂肌肌束把上位椎骨的棘突向下拉向下方的乳突和骶骨，使该椎骨后伸。每对棘间肌使相邻两个棘突靠拢。后伸受前纵韧带的张力限制。

rows.en: Lateral flexion (side bending). Range: 20–30°.
Quadratus lumborum, the intertransversarii and the erector spinae acting on one side; psoas major bends the trunk to the same side. Some sources add multifidus and the external oblique.
rows.zh: 单侧收缩的腰方肌、横突间肌和竖脊肌；腰大肌使躯干向同侧侧屈。有的资料还列出多裂肌和腹外斜肌。

rows.en: These muscles pull on one side of the axis. With the pelvis fixed, one quadratus lumborum pulls the 12th rib and the lumbar transverse processes down toward the iliac crest of the same side. The lateral intertransversarii span adjacent transverse processes, and the medial intertransversarii run from an accessory process to the mammillary process of the vertebra below, so one side draws these processes together. The erector spinae of one side pull the column toward that side. The intertransverse ligaments limit lateral flexion.
rows.zh: 这些肌肉在运动轴的一侧牵拉。骨盆固定时，一侧腰方肌把第 12 肋和腰椎横突向下拉向同侧髂嵴。腰外侧横突间肌跨越相邻横突，腰内侧横突间肌由副突连至下一位椎骨的乳突，因此单侧收缩使这些突起靠拢。一侧竖脊肌把脊柱拉向该侧。横突间韧带限制侧屈。

rows.en: Rotation (axial rotation). Range: very small, given as 1–2° or 1–5°.
rows.zh: 旋转（轴向旋转）。活动度：很小，资料写 1°–2° 或 1°–5°。

rows.en: Multifidus acting on one side turns the column to the opposite side; the rotatores are described as doing the same but contribute minimally; some sources add same-side rotation by the erector spinae. Quadratus lumborum, psoas major and the abdominal muscles are also named as important in lumbar rotation and lateral flexion.
rows.zh: 单侧多裂肌使脊柱转向对侧；回旋肌被描述为有相同作用，但贡献极小；有资料还认为竖脊肌可使脊柱向同侧旋转。腰方肌、腰大肌和腹肌也被列为在腰椎旋转和侧屈中起重要作用。
