rows.en: Multifidus and the rotatores run from lateral attachments (mammillary or transverse processes) superomedially to the spinous processes and laminae above, so the muscles of one side turn the vertebra above toward the opposite side. The rotatores sit at very poor mechanical leverage. During trunk rotation, multifidus opposes the flexion produced by the oblique abdominal muscles, which helps keep the rotation purely axial. The near-sagittal facet joints block most rotation at the upper four lumbar levels (3.3).
rows.zh: 多裂肌和回旋肌由外侧的附着点（乳突或横突）向内上方走向上位椎骨的棘突和椎板，因此一侧的这些肌肉使上位椎骨转向对侧。回旋肌所处位置的力学杠杆作用极差。躯干旋转时，多裂肌对抗腹斜肌产生的屈曲，有助于使旋转保持为单纯的轴向旋转。接近矢状面的关节突关节在上 4 个腰椎节段挡住了大部分旋转（见 3.3）。

text.en: These ranges describe the whole lumbar spine, with all its intervertebral discs and zygapophyseal joints moving together. The two reference sites used give slightly different numbers, and neither says whether the rotation figure is for one side or for both sides together. The lumbar spine has the greatest extension of the whole vertebral column, because its intervertebral discs are large relative to the vertebral bodies and its spinous processes are large and horizontal.
text.zh: 这些活动度指腰椎整体，即全部腰椎椎间盘和关节突关节共同运动时的范围。本章所用的两个参考网站数值略有不同，且都没有说明旋转数值是单侧还是两侧合计。腰椎是整个脊柱中后伸幅度最大的部位，因为其椎间盘相对于椎体较大，棘突宽大且呈水平方向。

text.en: Where along the lumbar spine the motion happens
text.zh: 运动在腰椎各节段的分布

text.en: Motion is not shared equally between the lumbar motion segments. In an in vitro study of 42 cadaveric lumbar spines (L1–S1) loaded with pure moments up to ±7.5 N·m (Cook, Yeager and Cheng 2015), flexion-extension range tended to increase down the lumbar spine, and the L4–L5 and L5–S1 segments (between the L4 and L5 vertebrae, and between the L5 vertebra and the sacrum) moved significantly more in flexion-extension than every other level. Lateral bending was greatest in the middle segments: L2–L3, L3–L4 and L4–L5 were each significantly greater than L1–L2 and L5–S1. In axial rotation only L1–L2 was significantly smaller than the other levels. These are passive cadaveric segments, not living movement; the L5–S1 data come from 36 of the 42 specimens, and the paper gives per-level degrees only in its figures.
text.zh: 运动并不是在各腰椎运动节段之间平均分配的。Cook、Yeager 与 Cheng 2015 年的体外研究使用 42 具尸体腰椎标本（L1–S1），以最大 ±7.5 N·m 的纯力矩加载，发现屈伸活动度沿腰椎自上而下趋于增大，L4–L5 节段（第 4 与第 5 腰椎之间）和 L5–S1 节段（第 5 腰椎与骶骨之间）的屈伸活动度显著大于其他所有节段。侧屈以中间节段最大：L2–L3、L3–L4 和 L4–L5 均显著大于 L1–L2 和 L5–S1。轴向旋转方面，只有 L1–L2 显著小于其他节段。这些是尸体的被动节段，并非活体运动；L5–S1 的数据只来自 42 具标本中的 36 具，各节段的具体度数只出现在论文的图中。

text.en: One reference site states that, before puberty, the lumbosacral joint accounts for about 75% of total lumbar flexion-extension (about 18°), with about 7° of lateral flexion, and that these ranges fall markedly with age, especially after 35 years. Do not rely on this figure: the cadaveric study did not single out L5–S1, and about 18° cannot be 75% of the roughly 85° of total flexion-extension given above.
text.zh: 有一个参考网站写道：青春期前，腰骶关节约占腰椎屈伸总范围的 75%（约 18°），侧屈约 7°，这些范围随年龄明显减小，35 岁以后尤其如此。这个数字不宜采用：上面的尸体研究并没有显示 L5–S1 特别突出，而约 18° 也不可能是上文约 85° 屈伸总范围的 75%。

text.en: 3.2 Line of pull decides the action

A muscle's action on the lumbar spine depends on where its line of pull passes relative to the movement axis of the motion segment, which Figure 12 marks schematically near the disc. A line behind the axis extends the spine, a line beside it bends the trunk to the same side, and a line in front of it can flex the spine. Fibres that run obliquely from a lateral attachment up to a more medial one also rotate the vertebra above. Figure 12 shows these positions in a lateral view (A), a posterior view (B) and a view from above of the joints between the L3 and L4 vertebrae (C).
text.zh: 肌肉对腰椎的作用取决于其拉力线相对运动节段运动轴的位置；图 12 把运动轴示意性地标在椎间盘附近。拉力线在运动轴后方则使脊柱后伸，在其一侧则使躯干向同侧侧屈，在其前方则可使脊柱前屈。由外侧附着点斜向上走向较内侧附着点的肌纤维，还能使上位椎骨旋转。图 12 用侧面观（A）、后面观（B）以及第 3、第 4 腰椎之间关节的上面观（C）展示这些位置。

text.en: Behind the axis: erector spinae, multifidus and interspinales
text.zh: 运动轴后方：竖脊肌、多裂肌和棘间肌

text.en: The erector spinae lie behind the axis in columns. Iliocostalis lumborum, the most lateral column, runs up from the lateral sacral crest, the medial end of the iliac crest and the thoracolumbar fascia to the transverse processes of the L1–L4 vertebrae and the angles of the lower ribs. Longissimus thoracis, the intermediate column, runs up from the lumbar intermuscular aponeurosis, the lumbar vertebrae, the sacrum and the posterior iliac crest to the lumbar accessory and transverse processes, the thoracic transverse processes and the lower ribs. Acting on both sides, the erector spinae extend the spine and are the primary extensor of the back; acting on one side, they bend the trunk to the same side, and some sources add same-side rotation.
text.zh: 竖脊肌分柱排列于运动轴后方。腰髂肋肌是最外侧的一柱，由骶外侧嵴、髂嵴内侧端和胸腰筋膜向上走向第 1–4 腰椎横突和下位肋的肋角。胸最长肌是中间一柱，由腰肌间腱膜、腰椎、骶骨和髂嵴后部向上走向腰椎副突和横突、胸椎横突及下位肋。两侧同时收缩时，竖脊肌使脊柱后伸，是背部的主要伸肌；单侧收缩时使躯干向同侧侧屈，有资料还认为可使脊柱向同侧旋转。

text.en: Multifidus lies deep to the erector spinae. Its fascicles run superomedially from the mammillary processes, the back of the sacrum and the posterior superior iliac spine, usually across two to five segments, to the spinous processes and laminae of the lumbar vertebrae above. Pulling down on the spinous process above, both sides together extend the lumbar spine; Macintosh and colleagues suggested that its primary action is posterior sagittal rotation, and its main function is described as stabilising the vertebrae as the spine moves.
text.zh: 多裂肌位于竖脊肌深面。其肌束由乳突、骶骨背面和髂后上棘向内上方走行，通常跨越 2～5 个节段，止于上位腰椎的棘突和椎板。它向下牵拉上位椎骨的棘突，两侧同时收缩使腰椎后伸；Macintosh 等认为其主要作用是矢状面上的后向旋转，其主要功能被描述为在脊柱运动时稳定各椎骨。

text.en: The interspinales lumborum, four pairs, join the spinous processes of adjacent lumbar vertebrae (each of L2–L5 to the one above), lateral to the interspinous ligament. Drawing the processes together, they are thought to assist extension, but their more important role is to stabilise the spine during movement and maintain posture, and their dense muscle spindles point to a proprioceptive role.
text.zh: 腰棘间肌共 4 对，连接相邻腰椎的棘突（第 2–5 腰椎各自连至上一位椎骨），位于棘间韧带两侧。它们使棘突靠拢，被认为可辅助后伸；但其更重要的作用是在运动中稳定脊柱、维持姿势，密集的肌梭提示其具有本体感觉作用。

text.en: Beside the axis: quadratus lumborum and intertransversarii
text.zh: 运动轴一侧：腰方肌和横突间肌

text.en: Quadratus lumborum runs superomedially from the iliolumbar ligament and the inner lip of the posterior iliac crest, lateral to the lumbar vertebrae and posterior to psoas major, to the lower border of the 12th rib and the tips of the transverse processes of the L1–L4 vertebrae. With the pelvis fixed, one side pulls the 12th rib and the transverse processes down toward the iliac crest and bends the lumbar spine to the same side. With the trunk fixed, it pulls the iliac crest up toward the 12th rib, which is the classic textbook description of lateral pelvic tilt (hip hiking is not described in the sources used). It is also classically said to fix the 12th rib during inspiration, although this role is debated (see 1.7); with the opposite tensor fasciae latae and gluteus medius it forms a lateral myofascial sling that helps keep the pelvis stable in the frontal plane.
text.zh: 腰方肌由髂腰韧带和髂嵴后部内唇，在腰椎外侧、腰大肌后方，向内上方走行，止于第 12 肋下缘和第 1–4 腰椎横突尖。骨盆固定时，一侧腰方肌把第 12 肋和横突向下拉向髂嵴，使腰椎向同侧侧屈。躯干固定时，它把髂嵴向上拉向第 12 肋，这是经典教科书所说的骨盆侧倾（本章所用资料没有描述“提髋”）。按经典说法，它还在吸气时固定第 12 肋，但这一作用存在争议（见 1.7）；它与对侧阔筋膜张肌和臀中肌组成外侧肌筋膜吊带，帮助在冠状面上保持骨盆稳定。

text.en: How much quadratus lumborum contributes is debated. It is often named as the lateral flexor of the lumbar spine, yet during a lateral tilt of the trunk it is reported to supply less than 10% of the force required, and psoas major and the external oblique are also lateral flexors. Likewise, it is listed as a bilateral extensor, yet its extension force of about 10 N, compared with about 100 N for the erector spinae and 150 N for multifidus, seems too small to extend the lumbar spine in the sagittal plane.
text.zh: 腰方肌的贡献有多大存在争议。它常被称为腰椎的侧屈肌，但有报告称躯干侧倾时它提供的力不到所需力的 10%，腰大肌和腹外斜肌也是侧屈肌。同样，它被列为双侧收缩时的伸肌，但它的伸展力约 10 N，而竖脊肌约 100 N、多裂肌约 150 N，似乎不足以在矢状面上伸展腰椎。

text.en: The intertransversarii lie beside the axis between adjacent vertebrae: the lateral group between adjacent transverse processes, posterior to psoas major and medial to quadratus lumborum, and the medial group from an accessory process to the mammillary process of the vertebra below, anterior to multifidus. Acting on one side they assist bending to the same side, and acting on both sides they help stabilise the lumbar spine; they are rich in muscle spindles, probably have a proprioceptive role, and their function is still not completely clear.
text.zh: 横突间肌位于运动轴一侧、相邻椎骨之间：外侧组在相邻横突之间，位于腰大肌后方、腰方肌内侧；内侧组由副突连至下一位椎骨的乳突，位于多裂肌前方。单侧收缩时协助向同侧侧屈，双侧收缩时帮助稳定腰椎；它们富含肌梭，可能具有本体感觉作用，其功能目前仍未完全明确。

text.en: In front of the axis: psoas major and its debated lumbar role
text.zh: 运动轴前方：腰大肌及其有争议的腰椎作用

text.en: Psoas major runs downward from the lateral surfaces of the bodies of the T12 to L4 vertebrae, the discs between them and the lumbar transverse processes, immediately lateral to the lumbar vertebrae and along the pelvic brim; it joins iliacus and passes deep to the inguinal ligament to the lesser trochanter of the femur. With the spine fixed it flexes the hip, in both supine and standing; with the femur fixed it acts on the lumbar spine.
text.zh: 腰大肌由第 12 胸椎至第 4 腰椎椎体侧面、其间的椎间盘和腰椎横突，紧贴腰椎外侧并沿骨盆界线向下走行，与髂肌汇合后经腹股沟韧带深面，止于股骨小转子。脊柱固定时，它在仰卧和站立时都能屈髋；股骨固定时，它作用于腰椎。

text.en: Its action on the lumbar spine is described inconsistently. Three roles are proposed: flexing the lumbar spine when the femur is fixed, bending the trunk to the same side (with rotation to the opposite side in some accounts), and stabilising the lumbar spine in static sitting.
text.zh: 它对腰椎的作用，各资料说法不一。提出的作用有三种：股骨固定时使腰椎前屈；使躯干向同侧侧屈（有的说法还伴向对侧旋转）；静坐时稳定腰椎。

text.en: Its effect on the lumbar curve is also unsettled. Some sources say it increases lumbar lordosis or maintains the normal lordosis in standing, and Penning's (2000) hypothesis is that it can arch the lumbar spine back, as in lumbar hyperlordosis. Bogduk, by contrast, held that its small moment arms give it little effect on the spine, and an electromyographic study concluded that psoas major is probably active on both sides to stabilise the lumbar spine in the frontal plane. Figure 12 therefore draws psoas major close to the axis and as mainly a hip flexor.
text.zh: 它对腰曲的影响同样没有定论。有资料认为它增加腰椎前凸，或在站立时维持正常前凸；Penning（2000）的假说是它能使腰椎向后弓，如腰椎过度前凸。Bogduk 则认为它的力臂小，对脊柱作用有限；一项肌电研究的结论是，腰大肌很可能两侧同时活动，在冠状面上稳定腰椎。因此图 12 把腰大肌画在靠近运动轴的位置，并把它主要当作屈髋肌。

text.en: Acting on one side, multifidus rotates the vertebral column to the opposite side, and some accounts add lateral flexion to the same side. Its deepest layer spans only two vertebral segments (the other layers span up to four) and appears to contribute more to strength and stability than the superficial layers. A review by MacDonald, Moseley and Hodges (2006) supported the contribution of multifidus to intervertebral control but concluded that several clinical beliefs about its deep fibres have little or no support.
text.zh: 单侧多裂肌收缩使脊柱转向对侧，有的说法还加上向同侧侧屈。它最深的一层只跨越两个椎骨节段（其余各层最多跨越四个），对力量和稳定的贡献似乎大于浅层。MacDonald、Moseley 和 Hodges（2006）的综述支持多裂肌对椎间控制的贡献，但认为关于其深层纤维的几种临床观点缺乏证据或证据很少。

text.en: The rotatores, the deepest layer beneath multifidus, run superomedially from a transverse process to the lamina and base of the spinous process one level above (rotatores breves) or two levels above (rotatores longi). On paper they extend the column when both sides contract and rotate the trunk to the opposite side when one side contracts. In practice they sit at very poor mechanical leverage and contribute minimally to movement; they act as stabilisers that behave like extensible ligaments. Muscle spindle volumes in the rotatores breves are 4.58 to 7.30 times higher than in multifidus and semispinalis (Nitz and Peck 1986), which points to a mainly proprioceptive role. In the lumbar region the rotatores are often inconsistent and can be replaced by deep fibres of multifidus.
text.zh: 回旋肌是多裂肌深面最深的一层，从横突向内上方走向上一位（短回旋肌）或上两位（长回旋肌）椎骨的椎弓板和棘突根部。按走行推断，两侧收缩时伸展脊柱，一侧收缩时使躯干转向对侧。实际上它们的力学杠杆很差，对运动的贡献极小，起的是类似可伸展韧带的稳定作用。短回旋肌的肌梭体积是多裂肌和半棘肌的 4.58 至 7.30 倍（Nitz 和 Peck 1986），提示它主要起本体感觉作用。在腰部，回旋肌常不恒定，可被多裂肌深层纤维取代。

text.en: 3.3 Facet joints, disc and ligaments in motion
text.zh: 3.3 运动中的关节突关节、椎间盘和韧带

text.en: Facet orientation guides flexion-extension and blocks rotation
text.zh: 关节面方向引导屈伸、阻挡旋转

text.en: Each zygapophyseal (facet) joint is a plane synovial joint between the inferior articular process of one vertebra and the superior articular process of the vertebra below. In the lumbar spine the joint surfaces lie close to the sagittal plane: the superior articular facets face medially (posteromedially) and the inferior facets face laterally (anterolaterally), so the articular processes of adjacent vertebrae interlock. This shape guides flexion and extension and allows lateral flexion, but the near-vertical, sagittally sloped facets block rotation, so very little axial rotation takes place at the four upper lumbar levels. In effect, when a lumbar vertebra tries to rotate, its inferior articular process on one side is driven against the medially facing superior articular process of the vertebra below, which stops the movement after a small range. Figure 12C shows this at the joints between the L3 and L4 vertebrae: the inferior articular process of L3 (dashed) sits against the superior articular process of L4. The total range of lumbar rotation is therefore very small, though not zero.
text.zh: 每个关节突关节都是上位椎骨下关节突与下位椎骨上关节突之间的平面滑膜关节。在腰椎，关节面接近矢状面：上关节面朝向内侧（后内侧），下关节面朝向外侧（前外侧），因此相邻椎骨的关节突相互嵌锁。这种形态引导前屈和后伸，也允许侧屈；但接近垂直、呈矢状倾斜的关节面会阻挡旋转，因此上 4 个腰椎节段的轴向旋转都很少。可以这样理解：腰椎试图旋转时，其一侧的下关节突被推向下位椎骨朝内的上关节突，在很小的范围后运动即被阻止。图 12C 以第 3、第 4 腰椎之间的关节为例：L3 下关节突（虚线）与 L4 上关节突相贴。因此，腰椎的总旋转范围很小，但并非为零。

text.en: At the lumbosacral (L5–S1) junction the joint line turns toward the coronal (frontal) plane. This makes some rotation possible there, but the iliolumbar ligaments limit it, and the more frontal facets also help stop the L5 vertebra from sliding forward on the sacrum. The exact facet angle is given differently from source to source (for example at right angles to the transverse plane and 45° to the frontal plane), but all agree that the lumbar articular surfaces are essentially sagittal. The facets also stabilise the motion segment against translation and excessive rotation and flexion, and they are reported to carry about 33% of the dynamic compressive load and 35% of the static load on the spine.
text.zh: 在腰骶（L5–S1）交界处，关节线转向冠状面（额状面），使该处可以有少量旋转，但受髂腰韧带限制；这种更偏冠状的关节面还有助于防止第 5 腰椎在骶骨上向前滑移。关节面的具体角度各资料写法不同（例如与水平面成直角、与额状面成 45°），但都认为腰椎关节面基本呈矢状方向。关节突关节还使运动节段稳定，抵抗平移以及过度的旋转和屈曲；据报道，它们约承担脊柱动态压缩负荷的 33% 和静态负荷的 35%。

text.en: Coupled motion means that a primary movement in one plane is accompanied by a secondary movement in another plane; in the lumbar spine it usually refers to lateral flexion combined with axial rotation. Teaching texts give conflicting directions: some say lateral bending is coupled with rotation to the opposite side, others with rotation to the same side, and the answer may depend on which movement is started first.
text.zh: 耦合运动指一个平面内的主运动伴随另一平面内的次运动；在腰椎通常指侧屈与轴向旋转的组合。教学资料给出的方向互相矛盾：有的说侧屈伴向对侧旋转，有的说伴向同侧旋转，而且答案可能取决于先做哪一个运动。

text.en: Research does not settle the direction either. Cook's 2003 literature review found that different manual therapy approaches use conflicting coupling models, concluded that a single, dogmatic side-bend-first coupling model may not be appropriate, and noted that coupling may be more consistent when rotation is initiated first, although the evidence for this is insufficient. A 2025 systematic review and meta-analysis of standardised in vitro studies (Liebsch and Wilke) found that coupling between lateral bending and axial rotation was low at L1–L4 and moderate at L4–S1, with only a tendency toward reproducibility in the mid-lumbar segments (L2–L5); during primary axial rotation it reported dominant same-side lateral bending in the lower lumbar spine (L4–S1). Learn the coupling direction as variable, not as a fixed rule.
text.zh: 研究同样没有确定耦合方向。Cook 2003 年的文献综述发现，不同手法治疗流派采用相互矛盾的耦合模型，认为单一、教条式地以侧屈起始的耦合模型可能并不恰当，并指出以旋转起始时耦合可能更为一致，但支持这一点的证据不足。Liebsch 与 Wilke 2025 年对标准化体外研究所作的系统综述与荟萃分析发现，侧屈与轴向旋转之间的耦合在 L1–L4 为低度、在 L4–S1 为中度，仅中腰段（L2–L5）呈现可重复的趋势；在主运动为轴向旋转时，下腰段（L4–S1）以同侧侧屈为主。因此，应把耦合方向作为可变现象来学习，而不是固定规律。

text.en: The disc and ligaments in flexion and extension
text.zh: 前屈与后伸时的椎间盘和韧带

text.en: Between adjacent vertebral bodies, the intervertebral disc acts as the shock-absorbing system of the spine and allows only slight movement at each level; its soft, deformable structure lets the vertebrae translate, tilt, rock and compress on one another. Lumbar discs are thicker than cervical or thoracic discs, about 7–10 mm thick, and wedge-shaped (taller in front), which contributes most to the lumbar lordosis. Each lumbar vertebral body is large and kidney-shaped, and together with the discs the vertebral bodies carry the main weight of the body.
text.zh: 椎间盘位于相邻椎体之间，是脊柱的减震系统，每个节段只允许轻微活动；其柔软、可变形的结构使相邻椎骨可以相互平移、倾斜、摇动和压缩。腰椎间盘比颈椎和胸椎的椎间盘厚，厚约 7–10 mm，呈前高后低的楔形，是形成腰椎前凸的主要因素。每个腰椎椎体都大而呈肾形，椎体与椎间盘一起承受身体的主要重量。

text.en: Lumbar flexion is limited by tension in the posterior longitudinal ligament and the ligamenta flava, among other structures, and extension is limited by tension in the anterior longitudinal ligament. In other words, flexion tightens the ligaments behind the axis and extension tightens the ligament in front. As flexion progresses, tension rises in the posterior ligaments and zygapophyseal joints, and the posterior disc-ligament structures increasingly carry the load (3.5).
text.zh: 腰椎前屈受后纵韧带、黄韧带等结构的张力限制，后伸受前纵韧带的张力限制。也就是说，前屈拉紧运动轴后方的韧带，后伸拉紧前方的韧带。随着前屈加深，后方韧带和关节突关节的张力增大，越来越多的负荷由后方椎间盘-韧带结构承担（见 3.5）。

rows.en: Anterior longitudinal ligament
rows.zh: 前纵韧带

rows.en: On the anterior surfaces of the vertebral bodies, from the sacrum up to the C1 vertebra (other sources take it to the occipital bone); firmly united to the bodies and attached to the front of each disc.
rows.zh: 附着于椎体前面，下自骶骨，上至第 1 颈椎（另有资料认为上至枕骨）；与椎体紧密结合，并附着于每个椎间盘的前部。

rows.en: The main ligament that limits extension and prevents hyperextension. It reinforces the front of the discs, and in the lumbar region it also resists translation and rotation.
rows.zh: 限制后伸、防止过伸的主要韧带。它在前方加强椎间盘，在腰段还抵抗平移和旋转。

rows.en: Posterior longitudinal ligament
rows.zh: 后纵韧带

rows.en: Inside the vertebral canal on the backs of the vertebral bodies and discs, from the sacrum up to the C2 vertebra; narrower and weaker than the anterior ligament, firmly attached to the annulus fibrosus, and in the lumbar region narrowing from L1 to L5.
rows.zh: 位于椎管内，附着于椎体和椎间盘的后面，下自骶骨，上至第 2 颈椎；比前纵韧带窄而薄弱，牢固附着于纤维环，在腰段由第 1 腰椎至第 5 腰椎逐渐变窄。

rows.en: Limits flexion, weakly resisting hyperflexion, and reinforces the back of the discs. Because it is narrow in the lower lumbar spine, the posterolateral part of the disc is left unreinforced.
rows.zh: 限制前屈（较弱地抵抗过屈），并在后方加强椎间盘。由于它在下腰段较窄，椎间盘后外侧部缺乏加强。

rows.en: Ligamentum flavum
rows.zh: 黄韧带

rows.en: Paired elastic ligaments (about 80% elastin) joining the laminae of adjacent vertebrae; in the lumbar region they run laterally to cover the front of the facet joints.
rows.zh: 成对的弹性韧带（约 80% 为弹性纤维），连接相邻椎骨的椎板；在腰段向外侧延伸，覆盖关节突关节的前面。

rows.en: Resists separation of the laminae during flexion and helps the spine resume its shape afterwards. Its pre-tension stops it buckling into the vertebral canal during extension.
rows.zh: 前屈时抵抗椎板分离，并帮助脊柱在屈曲后恢复原形。其预张力使它在后伸时不会皱褶突入椎管。

rows.en: Interspinous ligament
rows.zh: 棘间韧带

rows.en: Deep between consecutive spinous processes, from the base to the apex of each. In the lumbar region it is loose, bifid tissue rather than a continuous band, so its fibres can buckle to either side; posteriorly it merges with the supraspinous ligament.
rows.zh: 位于相邻棘突之间的深部，自棘突根部连至尖部。在腰段，它不是连续的纤维带，而是疏松、分叉的组织，因此其纤维可向两侧皱褶；后方与棘上韧带融合。

rows.en: With the supraspinous ligament, it resists flexion and limits hyperflexion of the lumbar spine.
rows.zh: 与棘上韧带一起抵抗前屈，限制腰椎过屈。

rows.en: Supraspinous ligament
rows.zh: 棘上韧带

rows.en: A cord-like band joining the tips of the spinous processes, thicker and broader in the lumbar region, where it merges with the thoracolumbar fascia. Sources disagree on its lower end: some say it reaches only about the L3–L4 level and is replaced below by fibres of latissimus dorsi, others that it continues to the sacrum.
rows.zh: 连接各棘突尖的索状纤维带，在腰段变厚变宽并与胸腰筋膜融合。各资料对其下端说法不一：有的认为它只到第 3–4 腰椎平面附近，其下由背阔肌纤维取代；有的认为它一直延续到骶骨。

rows.en: Prevents separation of the spinous processes during flexion, so it helps limit flexion and resist hyperflexion.
rows.zh: 前屈时防止棘突分离，因而有助于限制前屈、抵抗过屈。

text.en: Panjabi (1992) described the neutral zone as a region of intervertebral motion around the neutral posture where little resistance is offered by the passive spinal column. It has been found to increase with injury, and possibly with degeneration, and to decrease with increased muscle force across the spanned level; osteophyte formation, surgical fixation or fusion, and muscle strengthening may also decrease it and bring it back within physiological limits. In this instability hypothesis, the spinal stabilising system adjusts so that the neutral zone stays within certain physiological thresholds to avoid clinical instability. This links the passive structures above with the muscles in 3.2: muscle force across a level makes the neutral zone of that level smaller.
text.zh: Panjabi（1992）把中性区描述为中立姿势周围的一段椎间运动范围，在这一范围内被动脊柱结构几乎不提供阻力。研究发现，中性区会因损伤而增大，也可能因退变而增大；跨越该节段的肌力增加时，中性区会减小；骨赘形成、手术固定或融合以及肌力训练也可使中性区减小，并使其回到生理范围以内。按照这一不稳定假说，脊柱稳定系统会进行调节，使中性区保持在一定的生理阈值以内，以避免临床不稳定。这把上面的被动结构与 3.2 中的肌肉联系起来：跨越某一节段的肌力会使该节段的中性区减小。

text.en: Lumbar lordosis is the normal curve of the lumbar spine that is convex anteriorly (concave posteriorly) when viewed from the side. It is a secondary curvature that develops after birth, when the child learns to stand upright; it is produced mainly by the wedge-shaped lumbar discs, which are thinner posteriorly, and it transfers the mass of the upper body over the pelvis. Because the lumbar spine sits on the sacrum, tilting the pelvis changes the curve: anterior pelvic tilting increases lumbar lordosis, and posterior pelvic tilting has the opposite effect. An exaggerated lumbar lordosis is accompanied by anterior tilting of the pelvis.
text.zh: 腰椎前凸是从侧面观察时腰段脊柱向前凸（向后凹）的正常弯曲。它是出生后儿童学会直立时形成的继发弯曲，主要由后部较薄的楔形腰椎间盘形成，并把上半身的重量转移到骨盆上方。由于腰椎坐落在骶骨上，骨盆倾斜会改变这一弯曲：骨盆前倾使腰椎前凸增大，骨盆后倾作用相反。腰椎前凸过度时伴有骨盆前倾。

paragraphs.en: Tight hip flexors, weak gluteal muscles and poor postural habits are the causes usually listed for anterior pelvic tilt.
paragraphs.zh: 骨盆前倾通常列出的原因是屈髋肌紧张、臀肌无力和不良姿势习惯。

paragraphs.en: Janda's lower crossed syndrome describes the pattern: the hip flexors (particularly iliopsoas and tensor fasciae latae) and the lumbar extensors (erector spinae and quadratus lumborum) show increased activity and perceived tightness, while their antagonists, the deep abdominal muscles (including transversus abdominis) and the gluteal muscles (particularly gluteus maximus and gluteus medius), show reduced activity and apparent weakness. The imbalance is theorised to produce anterior pelvic tilt and increased lumbar lordosis.
paragraphs.zh: Janda 的下交叉综合征描述了这种模式：屈髋肌（尤其是髂腰肌和阔筋膜张肌）和腰部伸肌（竖脊肌和腰方肌）活动增强、被认为“紧张”，而它们的拮抗肌，即深层腹肌（包括腹横肌）和臀肌（尤其是臀大肌和臀中肌），活动减弱、表现为“无力”。这种失衡在理论上会导致骨盆前倾和腰椎前凸增大。

paragraphs.en: Lower crossed syndrome is a theoretical construct based mainly on clinical observation, not a validated diagnosis.
paragraphs.zh: 下交叉综合征是主要基于临床观察的理论构想，不是经过验证的诊断。

paragraphs.en: Rectus abdominis works on posterior pelvic tilt together with the other abdominal muscles (Hislop and Montgomery's muscle testing text).
paragraphs.zh: 腹直肌与其他腹肌共同作用，使骨盆后倾（Hislop 与 Montgomery 的肌肉测试教材）。

paragraphs.en: When the trunk returns from forward bending, the hip extensors initiate posterior rotation of the pelvis (3.5).
paragraphs.zh: 躯干由前屈位回位时，伸髋肌群启动骨盆向后旋转（见 3.5）。

paragraphs.en: Research suggests that contraction of the deep abdominal muscles may assist gluteus maximus in controlling anterior pelvic rotation.
paragraphs.zh: 有研究提示，深层腹肌收缩可能协助臀大肌控制骨盆向前旋转。

paragraphs.en: With the trunk fixed, quadratus lumborum pulls the iliac crest up toward the 12th rib, the classic textbook description of lateral pelvic tilt. With the opposite tensor fasciae latae and gluteus medius, it forms a lateral myofascial sling for frontal-plane stability of the pelvis (3.2).
paragraphs.zh: 躯干固定时，腰方肌把髂嵴向上拉向第 12 肋，这是经典教科书所说的骨盆侧倾。它与对侧阔筋膜张肌和臀中肌组成外侧肌筋膜吊带，维持骨盆在冠状面上的稳定（见 3.2）。

paragraphs.en: Figure 13 draws the commonly taught force-couple model, in which the erector spinae and the hip flexors (iliopsoas) tip the pelvis forward about the hip joints and rectus abdominis with gluteus maximus and the hamstrings tips it back. The sources opened for this chapter do not describe it as a force couple, and the hamstrings' part in particular was not confirmed, so treat it as a teaching model.
paragraphs.zh: 图 13 画的是常见教学中的力偶模型：竖脊肌与屈髋肌（髂腰肌）使骨盆绕髋关节向前倾，腹直肌与臀大肌和腘绳肌使其向后倾。本章打开过的资料都没有把它写成力偶，腘绳肌的作用尤其没有得到确认，因此应视为教学模型。

text.zh: 3.5 腰椎-骨盆节律与前馈激活

text.en: Lumbopelvic rhythm, also called hip-spine coordination, is the kinematic relationship between the lumbar spine and the hip joints during sagittal-plane movement such as bending forward. The stages below follow the classic textbook description (Cailliet, and Norkin and Levangie, as summarised by Physiopedia), and the muscle work in each stage follows from the courses in 3.2: the erector spinae behind the axis lengthen while contracting to lower the trunk and shorten to lift it.
text.zh: 腰椎-骨盆节律又称髋-脊柱协调，是指在前屈等矢状面运动中腰椎与髋关节之间的运动学关系。下面的分阶段描述采用经典教科书的说法（Physiopedia 依据 Cailliet 以及 Norkin 与 Levangie 等的著作整理），各阶段的肌肉工作方式可由 3.2 中的走行推出：位于运动轴后方的竖脊肌在收缩中被拉长以放低躯干，缩短以抬起躯干。

paragraphs.en: In the classic description, forward bending begins with lumbosacral flexion. Gravity flexes the trunk, and the erector spinae (iliocostalis lumborum and longissimus thoracis) contract eccentrically, lengthening while they contract, to control trunk flexion.
paragraphs.zh: 按经典描述，前屈从腰骶部屈曲开始。重力使躯干屈曲，竖脊肌（腰髂肋肌和胸最长肌）离心收缩，即在被拉长的同时收缩，以控制躯干屈曲。

heading.en: The pelvis tilts forward at the hips

paragraphs.en: The pelvis then tilts anteriorly at the hips, which is hip flexion. The erector spinae keep working eccentrically to control the anterior pelvic tilt, the hip flexors contract concentrically, and the hip extensors contract eccentrically to balance the hip flexion.
paragraphs.zh: 随后骨盆在髋关节处前倾，也就是屈髋。竖脊肌继续离心收缩以控制骨盆前倾，屈髋肌群向心收缩，伸髋肌群离心收缩以平衡髋关节屈曲。

heading.zh: 接近完全前屈：屈曲-放松

paragraphs.en: In healthy people the electrical activity of the lumbar erector spinae falls to low levels or silence near full trunk flexion. Tension in the posterior ligaments and zygapophyseal joints has risen, so the posterior disc-ligament structures and the passive stretch of the erector spinae carry the load.
paragraphs.zh: 健康人接近完全前屈时，腰部竖脊肌的电活动降至很低或静息。此时后方韧带和关节突关节的张力已增大，由后方椎间盘-韧带结构和竖脊肌自身的被动牵张承担负荷。

paragraphs.en: The return to standing is initiated by posterior tilting of the pelvis at the hip: the hip extensors start the posterior rotation of the pelvis. Descarreaux and colleagues likewise describe re-extension as starting mainly at the hip.
paragraphs.zh: 回到站立时，先由骨盆在髋关节处后倾启动：伸髋肌群开始使骨盆向后旋转。Descarreaux 等同样描述，回伸主要先在髋部开始。

paragraphs.en: The lumbar contribution increases in the later stages, when the erector spinae contract concentrically to extend the lumbar spine while the hip flexors work eccentrically to help control the movement. If the hip flexors are tight, or the hip extensors too weak to start the pelvic rotation, the lumbar extensors can be overloaded.
paragraphs.zh: 腰椎的贡献在后期增加，此时竖脊肌向心收缩使腰椎后伸，屈髋肌群离心工作以协助控制运动。如果屈髋肌紧张，或伸髋肌过弱而无法启动骨盆旋转，腰部伸肌就可能负荷过重。

text.en: Treat this order as the classic description, not a measured rule. A review by Vazirian, Van Dillen and Bazrgari (2016) examined how the rhythm varies with participant characteristics such as age, sex and low back pain, and with task conditions such as pace of motion, external load and muscle fatigue, and it reports that the magnitude of the lumbar contribution is smaller in people with low back pain. That review deals with the size of the lumbar and pelvic contributions, not their order, so it does not establish a strict lumbar-then-pelvis sequence, and the sources used here give no numerical lumbar-to-hip ratio.
text.zh: 应把这一顺序看作经典描述，而不是实测得出的规律。Vazirian、Van Dillen 与 Bazrgari（2016）的综述探讨了这一节律如何随年龄、性别和是否有腰痛等个体特征，以及运动速度、外加负荷和肌肉疲劳等任务条件而变化，并指出腰痛者的腰椎贡献幅度较小。该综述讨论的是腰椎与骨盆贡献的大小，而不是先后顺序，因此并不能确立严格的“先腰椎、后骨盆”顺序；本节所用资料也没有给出腰椎与髋部贡献的具体比值。

text.en: The flexion-relaxation phenomenon is the reduced or silent myoelectric activity of the lumbar erector spinae when a healthy person reaches full trunk flexion: the muscles first increase their activity to control the trunk eccentrically and then become suddenly quiet near the end of the range. The extension moment needed to hold the bent trunk is then increasingly carried by passive tissues, and other muscles, such as quadratus lumborum and the deep erector spinae, are also proposed to share the load. Studies have found differences in the phenomenon between people with chronic low back pain and healthy individuals, and it is not shown by some people with non-specific spine pain; the persistent erector spinae activity seen in back pain has been interpreted as a possible protective response to injured or diseased spinal structures. The studies used here report the trunk angle of the silence only for specific load and fatigue conditions, so no general angle is given.
text.zh: 屈曲-放松现象是指健康人躯干完全前屈时，腰部竖脊肌的肌电活动减弱或消失：这些肌肉先增加活动，以离心方式控制躯干，接近活动范围末端时突然安静下来。此时维持前屈躯干所需的伸展力矩越来越多地由被动组织承担；也有观点认为，腰方肌和深层竖脊肌等其他肌肉参与分担负荷。研究发现，慢性腰痛患者与健康人在这一现象上存在差异，部分非特异性脊柱疼痛者不出现这一现象；腰痛者竖脊肌持续活动的现象被解释为对受损或病变脊柱结构的一种可能的保护性反应。本节所用研究只报告了特定负荷和疲劳条件下肌电静息时的躯干角度，因此这里不给出通用角度。

text.en: Feedforward activation of the deep trunk muscles
text.zh: 深层躯干肌的前馈激活

text.en: In healthy people, transversus abdominis is activated in a feedforward (anticipatory) way, before the limb movement that disturbs the trunk. Transversus abdominis is the deepest abdominal muscle and its fibres run horizontally: it originates from the thoracolumbar fascia, the lateral third of the inguinal ligament, the anterior two-thirds of the iliac crest and the inner surfaces of the lower six costal cartilages, passes horizontally forward around the abdominal wall, and inserts onto the linea alba, the aponeurosis of internal oblique, the pubic crest and the pectineal line. In the hip-task study below, trunk activity that started before, or less than 50 ms after, the onset of the limb prime mover was classed as feedforward.
text.zh: 在健康人中，腹横肌以前馈（预期性）方式激活，即在扰动躯干的肢体运动开始之前就已收缩。腹横肌是腹壁最深层的肌肉，纤维呈水平走行：它起自胸腰筋膜、腹股沟韧带外侧 1/3、髂嵴前 2/3 和下 6 个肋软骨的内面，呈水平方向绕腹壁向前走行，止于白线、腹内斜肌腱膜、耻骨嵴和耻骨梳线。在下表的髋部任务研究中，躯干肌在肢体主动肌激活之前或之后不足 50 毫秒内开始活动的，被归为前馈活动。

rows.en: Hodges and Richardson 1997 (arm task)
rows.zh: Hodges 与 Richardson 1997（上肢任务）

rows.en: 15 subjects; fine-wire electromyography; rapid shoulder movements in response to a visual stimulus.
rows.zh: 15 名受试者；细丝电极肌电记录；对视觉刺激作快速肩部运动。

rows.en: Transversus abdominis became active before the deltoid whatever the movement direction, whereas the onsets of internal oblique, external oblique, rectus abdominis and multifidus varied with direction. The authors suggested that this non-direction-specific contraction may relate to the control of trunk stability.
rows.zh: 无论运动方向如何，腹横肌都先于三角肌激活，而腹内斜肌、腹外斜肌、腹直肌和多裂肌的激活时间随运动方向而变化。作者认为，这种不依赖方向的收缩可能与躯干稳定的控制有关。

rows.en: Hodges and Richardson 1997 (hip task)
rows.zh: Hodges 与 Richardson 1997（髋部任务）

rows.en: 15 healthy subjects with no history of low back pain, standing with their weight shifted onto the left leg and moving the right hip rapidly into flexion, abduction and extension.
rows.zh: 15 名无腰痛史的健康受试者站立，把体重移到左腿，用右髋快速做屈曲、外展和后伸。

rows.en: Transversus abdominis was invariably the first muscle active. In flexion it preceded each other trunk muscle 'by 42 to 104 milliseconds'; in abduction it was active before all other trunk muscles except internal oblique 'by 40 to 72 milliseconds'; in extension it preceded internal oblique, external oblique and multifidus 'by 35 to 96 milliseconds'. These intervals compare transversus abdominis with the other trunk muscles, not with the limb muscle, and multifidus onset varied with the direction of hip movement.
rows.zh: 腹横肌总是最先激活的肌肉。屈髋时，它比其他各躯干肌提前“42 至 104 毫秒”；外展时，除腹内斜肌外，它比其他所有躯干肌提前“40 至 72 毫秒”；后伸时，它比腹内斜肌、腹外斜肌和多裂肌提前“35 至 96 毫秒”。这些间隔是腹横肌与其他躯干肌之间的比较，而不是与下肢肌肉的比较；多裂肌的激活时间随髋关节运动方向而变化。

rows.en: Hodges and Richardson 1996
rows.zh: Hodges 与 Richardson 1996

rows.en: 15 people with low back pain and 15 matched controls; rapid shoulder flexion, abduction and extension.
rows.zh: 15 名腰痛者和 15 名配对对照者；快速做肩关节前屈、外展和后伸。

rows.en: Contraction of transversus abdominis was significantly delayed for all movements. The authors interpreted this as a motor control deficit hypothesised to cause inefficient muscular stabilisation of the spine. The abstract gives no millisecond values.
rows.zh: 所有运动中腹横肌的收缩都明显延迟。作者将其解释为一种运动控制缺陷，并推测它会导致脊柱的肌肉稳定效率降低。该摘要没有给出毫秒数值。

rows.en: Hodges and Richardson 1999
rows.zh: Hodges 与 Richardson 1999

rows.en: 14 people with recurrent low back pain and age- and sex-matched controls; arm movements at different speeds.
rows.zh: 14 名复发性腰痛者及年龄、性别配对的对照者；以不同速度做上肢运动。

rows.en: With fast arm movements, the people with low back pain failed to recruit transversus abdominis or internal oblique before the limb moved; with slow movements there was no group difference.
rows.zh: 快速上肢运动时，腰痛者未能在肢体运动之前募集腹横肌或腹内斜肌；慢速运动时两组无差异。

rows.en: MacDonald, Moseley and Hodges
rows.zh: MacDonald、Moseley 与 Hodges

rows.en: Healthy participants and people in remission from recurrent one-sided low back pain; postural perturbation from a rapid arm movement.
rows.zh: 健康受试者和复发性单侧腰痛缓解期患者；快速上肢运动引起的姿势扰动。

rows.en: In healthy participants the short fibres of lumbar multifidus became active earlier than the long fibres on both sides; people in remission showed a later short-fibre onset than healthy participants.
rows.zh: 健康受试者两侧腰部多裂肌的短纤维激活均早于长纤维；缓解期患者的短纤维激活晚于健康受试者。

rows.en: Morris and colleagues 2012
rows.zh: Morris 等 2012

rows.en: Rapid arm movements.
rows.zh: 快速上肢运动。

rows.en: Feedforward transversus abdominis activity was not symmetrical on the two sides and was related to the rotational forces produced by the arm movement, so training bilateral pre-activation before rapid movement was judged not justified.
rows.zh: 腹横肌的前馈活动两侧并不对称，并与上肢运动产生的旋转力有关，因此研究者认为在快速运动前训练双侧预激活缺乏依据。

rows.en: Morris, Lay and Allison 2013
rows.zh: Morris、Lay 与 Allison 2013

rows.en: Arm movement.
rows.zh: 上肢运动。

rows.en: Transversus abdominis behaved as part of a global, not local, muscle synergy, and the delayed onset reported in chronic low back pain may reflect a different movement strategy rather than a problem of local muscle control.
rows.zh: 腹横肌表现为整体而非局部肌肉协同的一部分；慢性腰痛中报告的激活延迟，可能反映的是运动策略的不同，而不是局部肌肉控制的问题。

text.en: Figure 14B shows only the order of onsets in the rapid arm task, without times: transversus abdominis before the deltoid in healthy people, the other trunk muscles at direction-dependent times, and a delayed transversus abdominis onset in low back pain. Multifidus is often described as activating ahead of loading in the same way as transversus abdominis, but in these studies its onset varied with the direction of movement.
text.zh: 图 14B 只表示快速上肢运动任务中的激活先后，不表示具体时间：健康人腹横肌先于三角肌激活，其他躯干肌的激活时间随方向而变，腰痛者腹横肌激活延迟。常有资料把多裂肌和腹横肌一样描述为在负荷前激活，但在这些研究中，多裂肌的激活时间随运动方向而变。

text.en: Posteriorly, the aponeuroses of transversus abdominis and internal oblique join to become the middle layer of the thoracolumbar fascia. At the lateral raphe, tension from the surrounding trunk and limb muscles is distributed into the layers of the fascia, and the middle layer has been suggested as the primary link between the tension generated in the abdominal muscle band and the lumbar spine (Willard and colleagues, citing Barker and colleagues). The posterior layers form a retinacular sheath around the paraspinal muscles, which can act as a 'hydraulic amplifier' that helps those muscles support the lumbosacral spine. Transversus abdominis also raises intra-abdominal pressure, as in forceful expiration, coughing and defecation. When the diaphragm, pelvic floor and abdominal muscles contract together they form a rigid cylinder that is described as decreasing the load on the spine, and transversus abdominis itself is described as increasing spinal stiffness during functional postures and movements.
text.zh: 在后方，腹横肌与腹内斜肌的腱膜汇合，形成胸腰筋膜中层。在外侧缝处，周围躯干肌和四肢肌的张力被分散到筋膜各层；有观点认为，胸腰筋膜中层是腹肌带所产生的张力与腰椎之间的主要联系（Willard 等引用 Barker 等的研究）。后方各层在椎旁肌周围形成支持带鞘，可起“液压放大器”的作用，协助椎旁肌支撑腰骶部脊柱。腹横肌还能升高腹内压，如用力呼气、咳嗽和排便时。膈肌、盆底肌和腹肌共同收缩时形成一个坚固的圆筒，被描述为可以减轻脊柱负荷；腹横肌本身则被描述为在功能性姿势和运动中增加脊柱刚度。

overview.en: Special tests, common problems and the structures involved, nerve root findings, acupoints over the regional anatomy, and dry-needling safety with a palpation sequence.
overview.zh: 特殊检查、常见问题与累及结构、神经根检查表现、穴位与局部解剖叠加，以及干针安全要点与触诊顺序。

text.en: The first four are nerve tension tests: the straight leg raise and the slump test tension the sciatic nerve and its roots, the femoral nerve tension test loads the femoral nerve and the L2–L4 nerve roots, and a positive crossed straight leg raise is linked to a central disc herniation with severe root irritation. The last three load other structures: the prone instability test a painful lumbar segment, the stork test the pars interarticularis, and the Laslett cluster the sacroiliac joint. Accuracy figures are copied as each source reports them, with the reference standard where the source names one.
text.zh: 前四项是神经张力检查：直腿抬高试验和坍塌试验牵拉坐骨神经及其神经根，股神经牵拉试验加载股神经和 L2–L4 神经根，交叉直腿抬高试验阳性则与中央型椎间盘突出伴严重神经根刺激有关。后三项加载其他结构：俯卧不稳定试验加载疼痛的腰椎节段，单腿过伸试验加载椎弓峡部，Laslett 组合加载骶髂关节。准确度数据按各来源原文照录，来源给出参照标准时一并注明。

columns.en: What a positive result means and which structure it loads

rows.en: Straight leg raise (Lasègue test)
rows.zh: 直腿抬高试验（Lasègue 试验）

rows.en: The person lies supine without a pillow under the head, and each leg is tested separately, the unaffected leg first. The examiner lifts the leg by the posterior ankle, slowly flexing the hip while keeping the knee fully extended. Ankle dorsiflexion (Bragard's test) is the most commonly cited sensitising manoeuvre, and neck flexion can also be added.
rows.zh: 受试者仰卧，头下不垫枕；两侧分别检查，先查健侧。检查者托住踝关节后方抬起下肢，在膝关节完全伸直的状态下缓慢屈髋。最常用的加强动作是踝背屈（Bragard 试验），也可再加颈前屈。

rows.en: The test is positive when it reproduces the person's pain shooting down the lower limb in the territory of the sciatic nerve. Physiopedia places this at a hip angle of roughly 30° to 70°, whereas StatPearls describes a positive test as pain at a hip flexion angle below 45°; the StatPearls chapter on sciatica adds that pain radiating below the knee at less than 70° suggests radiculopathy and that the test is most helpful for the L4, L5 and S1 roots. Raising the straight leg stretches the sciatic nerve, and the pain follows the lower nerve roots, usually the L5 or S1 root. The intervertebral foramen normally allows about 4 mm of nerve root excursion; a positive test may reflect root irritation from inflammation as well as from mechanical compression, with decreased excursion, and lumbar disc herniation is the most common cause. Adding ankle dorsiflexion increases the pain.
rows.zh: 若诱发患者沿坐骨神经分布区向下肢放射的疼痛即为阳性。Physiopedia 给出的角度约为屈髋 30° 至 70°，StatPearls 则把屈髋小于 45° 即诱发疼痛定为阳性；StatPearls 的坐骨神经痛章节另指出，小于 70° 时诱发放射至膝以下的疼痛提示神经根病，本试验对 L4、L5、S1 神经根最有价值。伸膝抬腿牵拉坐骨神经，疼痛沿下位神经根分布，通常是 L5 或 S1 神经根。椎间孔正常允许神经根约 4 mm 的滑移；阳性既可能反映炎症刺激，也可能反映机械压迫，伴神经根滑移减少，最常见的原因是腰椎间盘突出。加上踝背屈会使疼痛加重。

rows.en: For disc herniation, Physiopedia reports high sensitivity (about 0.9) but low specificity (about 0.4). A diagnostic validity study of neurodynamic and orthopaedic tension tests that used MRI as the reference standard reported a sensitivity of 83.33% and a specificity of 74.24%.
rows.zh: 诊断椎间盘突出时，Physiopedia 报告其敏感度高（约 0.9）而特异度低（约 0.4）。一项以 MRI 为参照标准的神经动力学与骨科张力试验诊断效度研究，报告敏感度 83.33%、特异度 74.24%。

rows.en: Crossed straight leg raise (Fajersztajn's test)
rows.zh: 交叉直腿抬高试验（Fajersztajn 试验）

rows.en: With the person supine, the examiner passively raises the uninvolved (contralateral) leg while keeping the knee extended.
rows.zh: 受试者仰卧，检查者保持膝关节伸直，被动抬起未受累的（对侧）下肢。

rows.en: The test is positive when raising the uninvolved leg reproduces pain in the involved limb; StatPearls defines a positive test as pain in the involved limb at 40° of hip flexion of the uninvolved limb. The sources consulted do not explain the mechanics in detail. They link a positive crossed test to a central disc herniation with severe irritation of the nerve root on the symptomatic side.
rows.zh: 抬起健侧下肢时诱发患侧下肢疼痛即为阳性；StatPearls 把健侧屈髋 40° 时患侧下肢出现疼痛定为阳性。所查资料没有详细解释其力学机制，只把交叉试验阳性与中央型椎间盘突出、症状侧神经根受到严重刺激联系起来。

rows.en: Physiopedia reports high specificity (0.90 or more) for disc herniation but low sensitivity, and gives no sensitivity figure.
rows.zh: Physiopedia 报告其诊断椎间盘突出的特异度高（0.90 或以上）而敏感度低，未给出敏感度数值。

rows.en: Slump test
rows.zh: 坍塌试验

rows.en: The person sits on the examining table with the hips in neutral (no rotation, abduction or adduction), folds the hands behind the back and slumps into lumbar and thoracic flexion while keeping the head upright. The examiner applies gentle overpressure over the shoulders while the person brings the chin to the chest, then adds passive knee extension and passive ankle dorsiflexion. If symptoms increase at any stage, the sequence is not continued. In a modified protocol (Tucker et al.), the neck is then returned to neutral and the knee is extended further if possible.
rows.zh: 受试者坐于检查床上，髋关节保持中立位（无旋转、外展或内收），双手交叠置于背后，做腰椎和胸椎屈曲（弓背），头部保持直立。检查者经双肩轻轻加压，同时让受试者下颌贴胸，再依次加被动伸膝和被动踝背屈。任何一步症状加重，即不再继续。在一种改良方案（Tucker 等）中，随后让颈椎回到中立位，并尽可能进一步伸膝。

rows.en: Physiotutors counts the test as positive when familiar neurological symptoms are reproduced; a stricter definition (Phillips et al., as reported by Tucker et al.) requires symptom reproduction that then decreases with cervical extension. Tension over the hamstrings with restricted knee extension, or tension at the T8–T9 thoracic levels, is a non-pathological response. Maitland proposed the test to assess the mechanosensitivity of the neuromeningeal structures within the vertebral canal: it provides traction to the lumbar nerve roots and places the sciatic nerve roots under increasing tension. Because the same movements also stress joints and muscles, most notably hamstring length, the order of the loading components must be controlled to tell neural from non-neural sources apart; restriction of knee extension in the slump position decreases when the neck is extended.
rows.zh: Physiotutors 以复现患者熟悉的神经症状为阳性；更严格的定义（Phillips 等，Tucker 等转述）要求症状复现后在颈椎伸展时减轻。腘绳肌紧张伴伸膝受限，或 T8–T9 胸椎节段的紧张感，属于非病理性反应。Maitland 提出本试验，用于评估椎管内神经脊膜结构的机械敏感性：它牵引腰神经根，并使坐骨神经根的张力逐步增加。由于同一组动作也牵拉关节和肌肉（最主要的是腘绳肌长度），必须控制各加载动作的顺序，才能区分神经性与非神经性来源；在坍塌体位下，颈部伸展时伸膝受限会减轻。

rows.en: The MRI-referenced diagnostic validity study reported a sensitivity of 80.17% and a specificity of 77.78%. Physiotutors, citing the Cochrane review by van der Windt et al. (2010), reports sensitivities of 44–87% and specificities of 23–63% for symptomatic lumbar nerve root compression.
rows.zh: 上述以 MRI 为参照标准的诊断效度研究报告敏感度 80.17%、特异度 77.78%。Physiotutors 引用 van der Windt 等（2010）的 Cochrane 系统综述，报告其对有症状的腰神经根受压的敏感度为 44%–87%，特异度为 23%–63%。

rows.en: Femoral nerve tension test (prone knee bend, reversed Lasègue test)
rows.zh: 股神经牵拉试验（俯卧屈膝试验，反 Lasègue 试验）

rows.en: The person lies prone. The examiner stands on the affected side, stabilises the pelvis to prevent anterior rotation and passively flexes the knee to end range. If no symptoms appear, the examiner extends the hip while keeping the knee flexed.
rows.zh: 受试者俯卧。检查者站在患侧，固定骨盆以防其向前旋转，被动屈膝至最大范围。若未诱发症状，再在保持屈膝的同时伸髋。

rows.en: Physiotutors counts shooting pain down the leg or into the anterior thigh as positive. Physiopedia instead describes unilateral pain in the lumbar region, buttock or posterior thigh between 80° and 100° of knee flexion, and its research summary accepts pain in the groin, anterior or posterior thigh, buttock or lumbar region. The test stresses the femoral nerve and the mid-lumbar (L2–L4) nerve roots, and adding hip extension stretches the femoral nerve further. The femoral nerve forms in the lumbar plexus from the posterior divisions of the L2–L4 ventral rami and passes through psoas major. A positive result in the 80°–100° range could indicate a disc herniation affecting the L2, L3 or L4 nerve root. Pain before 80° may come from quadriceps tightness or injury, and a tight rectus femoris can also cause anterior thigh pain, so both sides are tested and compared.
rows.zh: Physiotutors 以诱发向下肢放射或至大腿前侧的疼痛为阳性。Physiopedia 则把屈膝 80° 至 100° 之间出现的单侧腰部、臀部或大腿后侧疼痛定为阳性，其研究摘要也接受腹股沟、大腿前侧或后侧、臀部或腰部的疼痛。本试验牵拉股神经和腰中段（L2–L4）神经根，加上伸髋可进一步牵拉股神经。股神经在腰丛内由 L2–L4 前支的后股组成，穿过腰大肌。屈膝 80°–100° 范围内阳性，可能提示累及 L2、L3 或 L4 神经根的椎间盘突出。屈膝不足 80° 即出现疼痛，可能来自股四头肌紧张或损伤；股直肌紧张也会引起大腿前侧疼痛，因此应双侧检查并对比。

rows.en: Physiotutors, citing Suri et al. (2011), gives a sensitivity of 50% and a specificity of 100% for disc herniation with L2–L4 root compression, and 70% and 88% for the L3 root alone.
rows.zh: Physiotutors 引用 Suri 等（2011）的研究：诊断伴 L2–L4 神经根受压的椎间盘突出，敏感度 50%、特异度 100%；单看 L3 神经根，敏感度 70%、特异度 88%。

rows.en: Prone instability test
rows.zh: 俯卧不稳定试验

rows.en: The person lies prone with the trunk on the examining table, the legs over the edge and the feet resting on the floor. The examiner applies posteroanterior pressure to each lumbar spinous process, and the person reports any pain. The person then lifts the legs off the floor, holding the table if needed, and the painful level is pressed again while the trunk muscles are contracted.
rows.zh: 受试者俯卧，躯干伏于检查床上，双腿垂于床沿外，双足着地。检查者依次对各腰椎棘突施加后前向按压，受试者报告是否疼痛。随后受试者把双腿抬离地面（必要时抓握床沿），检查者在躯干肌收缩状态下再次按压疼痛节段。

rows.en: The test is positive if pain is present in the resting position but subsides in the second, legs-lifted position. The pressure loads one lumbar segment through its spinous process, first with the trunk muscles relaxed and then with them contracted. Because muscle activation can stabilise the segment, pain that subsides points to a painful segment that muscle activity can stabilise, and a positive test suggests lumbar segmental (lumbopelvic) instability. The test belongs to the clinical prediction rule of Hicks et al. (2005) for people likely to respond to stabilisation exercise and is used together with other tests.
rows.zh: 若静息体位下按压疼痛、而在第二体位（抬腿）下疼痛消失即为阳性。按压经棘突加载单个腰椎节段，先在躯干肌放松时，再在躯干肌收缩时进行。肌肉激活能够稳定该节段，因此疼痛消失提示存在可被肌肉活动稳定的疼痛节段，阳性提示腰椎节段（腰椎-骨盆）不稳。本试验属于 Hicks 等（2005）制定的临床预测规则，用于识别可能对稳定性训练反应良好的患者，应与其他试验结合使用。

rows.en: Hicks et al. (2005), as reported by Physiopedia, with success in a stabilisation exercise programme as the reference standard: sensitivity 0.72 (negative likelihood ratio 0.48) and specificity 0.58 (positive likelihood ratio 1.7).
rows.zh: Physiopedia 转引 Hicks 等（2005）的数据，以稳定性训练方案成功为参照标准：敏感度 0.72（阴性似然比 0.48），特异度 0.58（阳性似然比 1.7）。

rows.en: Single-leg hyperextension test (stork test)
rows.zh: 单腿过伸试验（单腿站立腰椎后伸试验）

rows.en: Standing with the back to the examiner, the person stands on one leg and raises the other (hip slightly flexed, knee bent to about 80°), then actively extends the lumbar spine. The test is repeated standing on the other leg.
rows.zh: 受试者背对检查者站立，单腿支撑，抬起另一侧下肢（髋关节轻度屈曲，膝关节屈曲约 80°），然后主动后伸腰椎。随后换另一侧单腿支撑重复。

rows.en: The test is positive if it reproduces the person's pain; the study does not specify whether the pain must be on the stance side. It is used to screen for spondylolysis, a defect of the pars interarticularis. The study authors expected the test to transfer a significant extension force to the lower lumbar spine and to place significant pressure on the pars interarticularis, and suggested that it may preferentially load the L5 vertebra, so bone stress in the upper lumbar spine may not test positive. These are proposed explanations for the test's poor accuracy, not measured findings.
rows.zh: 若诱发患者原有的疼痛即为阳性；所查研究没有规定疼痛是否必须出现在支撑侧。本试验用于筛查椎弓峡部裂，即椎弓峡部的缺损。研究者预期本试验会把较大的后伸力传到下腰椎、对椎弓峡部施加较大压力，并推测它可能优先加载第 5 腰椎，因此腰椎上段的骨应力损伤可能不呈阳性。这些是对其准确度差的推测性解释，而非测量结果。

rows.en: StatPearls, in a chapter marked for historical reference only, treats a positive stork test as diagnostic of spondylolysis until proven otherwise. A study that compared the test with MRI found it neither sensitive nor specific for active spondylolysis (left-sided test: sensitivity 50%, specificity 67.6%; right-sided test: sensitivity 55.2%, specificity 45.5%) and concluded that it should not be relied on to exclude the diagnosis.
rows.zh: StatPearls 的相关章节（标注为仅供历史参考）认为单腿过伸试验阳性在被排除之前即可诊断椎弓峡部裂。一项与 MRI 对照的研究发现，该试验对活动性椎弓峡部裂既不敏感也不特异（左侧试验敏感度 50%、特异度 67.6%；右侧试验敏感度 55.2%、特异度 45.5%），并认为不能依靠它排除诊断。

rows.en: Sacroiliac provocation cluster (Laslett)
rows.zh: 骶髂关节激发试验组合（Laslett 组合）

rows.en: Five provocation tests are used: distraction (supine; posterolaterally directed pressure on both anterior superior iliac spines), compression (side-lying; pressure over the iliac crest directed toward the opposite iliac crest), thigh thrust (supine; hip in 90° of flexion and adduction, posteriorly directed force through the femur), sacral thrust (prone; anteriorly directed thrust over the sacrum) and Gaenslen's test (supine with both legs extended; the test leg is passively brought into full knee flexion while the opposite hip stays extended, and overpressure is applied to the flexed limb). The 2005 rule performs distraction, compression, thigh thrust and sacral thrust, and stops once two tests are positive.
rows.zh: 共五项激发试验：骨盆分离试验（仰卧，向双侧髂前上棘施加向后外方向的压力）、骨盆挤压试验（侧卧，在髂嵴上施压，力指向对侧髂嵴）、大腿推挤试验（仰卧，髋关节屈曲 90° 并内收，经股骨向后施力）、骶骨推压试验（俯卧，在骶骨上向前推压）和 Gaenslen 试验（仰卧，双下肢伸直；被检侧下肢被动充分屈膝，对侧髋保持伸展，再对屈曲侧下肢加压）。2005 年的规则只做骨盆分离、骨盆挤压、大腿推挤和骶骨推压四项，出现两项阳性即可停止。

rows.en: Each test is positive if it reproduces the person's pain (buttock pain for thigh thrust; the person's symptoms for compression). The cluster is positive when 3 of the 5 tests are positive (2003 rule) or 2 of the 4 tests are positive (2005 rule), and Gaenslen's test may be omitted without compromising diagnostic confidence. A positive cluster points to sacroiliac joint dysfunction as the pain source; in the original study it was applied after a McKenzie evaluation had ruled out discogenic pain. The forces pass through the anterior superior iliac spines, the iliac crest, the femur and the sacrum, so the sacroiliac joint is stressed from several directions; the source does not describe the joint mechanics of each test.
rows.zh: 每项试验以复现患者疼痛为阳性（大腿推挤试验为臀部疼痛，骨盆挤压试验为患者症状）。五项中三项阳性（2003 年规则）或四项中两项阳性（2005 年规则）即判定组合阳性；省略 Gaenslen 试验不会降低诊断把握。组合阳性提示骶髂关节功能障碍为疼痛来源；原始研究是在 McKenzie 评估排除椎间盘源性疼痛之后才使用该组合。各项试验分别经髂前上棘、髂嵴、股骨和骶骨施力，从多个方向对骶髂关节施加应力；资料没有逐项说明关节的力学变化。

rows.en: Laslett et al. (2003, 2005), as reported by Physiopedia: with 3 of 5 positive, sensitivity 0.91 and specificity 0.78; with 2 of 4 positive, sensitivity 0.88 and specificity 0.78. Among single tests, thigh thrust had the highest sensitivity (0.88; specificity 0.69) and distraction the highest specificity (0.81; sensitivity 0.60).
rows.zh: Physiopedia 转引 Laslett 等（2003、2005）的数据：五项中三项阳性时，敏感度 0.91、特异度 0.78；四项中两项阳性时，敏感度 0.88、特异度 0.78。单项试验中，大腿推挤试验敏感度最高（0.88，特异度 0.69），骨盆分离试验特异度最高（0.81，敏感度 0.60）。

text.en: 4.2 Common problems and the structures involved

The L4–L5 intervertebral disc, a nucleus pulposus held inside the annulus fibrosus, lies in front of the dural sac. The exiting L4 root leaves through the L4–L5 intervertebral foramen, because each lumbar nerve leaves the vertebral column below the vertebra of the same number, while the traversing L5 root crosses the L4–L5 disc and exits one level lower. A paracentral L4–L5 herniation therefore usually compresses the traversing L5 root, and a far-lateral herniation the exiting L4 root.
text.zh: L4–L5 椎间盘由纤维环包裹髓核构成，位于硬脊膜囊前方。L4 出口根从 L4–L5 椎间孔穿出，因为每条腰神经都在同序数椎骨的下方离开脊柱；L5 走行根则越过 L4–L5 椎间盘，在下一节段穿出。因此 L4–L5 旁中央型突出通常压迫 L5 走行根，极外侧型突出则压迫 L4 出口根。

items.en: Structures: Part or all of the nucleus pulposus protrudes through a tear in the annulus fibrosus, usually in a posterolateral direction into the vertebral canal, and most lumbar herniations involve the L4–L5 and L5–S1 intervertebral discs. The posterior longitudinal ligament is much narrower and relatively weaker than the anterior longitudinal ligament, although it helps prevent posterior herniation of the nucleus pulposus. The sinuvertebral nerve supplies the posterior annulus fibrosus and the posterior longitudinal ligament and is regarded as one of the main structures contributing to lumbar discogenic pain.
items.zh: 结构：部分或全部髓核经纤维环的裂口突出，通常向后外侧进入椎管；腰椎间盘突出大多发生在 L4–L5 和 L5–S1 椎间盘。后纵韧带比前纵韧带窄得多，也相对薄弱，但它有助于防止髓核向后突出。窦椎神经支配纤维环后部和后纵韧带，被视为腰椎间盘源性疼痛的主要相关结构之一。

items.en: Stages: Physiopedia defines protrusion (the nucleus pulposus presses on the annulus fibrosus and the posterior longitudinal ligament is intact), extrusion (nuclear material emerges through the annular fibres while the ligament is still intact) and sequestration (the ligament is disrupted and a portion of the nucleus pulposus has entered the epidural space). The AO Surgery Reference defines the same terms by the size of the displaced material relative to its base, with sequestration meaning material that is no longer continuous with the disc.
items.zh: 分期：Physiopedia 的定义为突出（髓核压迫纤维环，后纵韧带完整）、脱出（髓核物质穿出纤维环，后纵韧带仍完整）和游离（后纵韧带破裂，部分髓核进入硬膜外隙）。AO 外科参考资料则按移位物质与其基底的大小关系定义这些术语，游离指移位物质已与椎间盘不相连。

items.en: Which root: A posterolateral herniation, also called a paracentral, subarticular or lateral recess herniation, usually compresses the traversing nerve root as it enters the lateral recess. The traversing root passes close to the disc and exits through the intervertebral foramen one level lower, so an L4–L5 herniation usually affects the L5 nerve root and an L5–S1 herniation the S1 nerve root. The exiting root hooks around the pedicle above its same-level disc and is seldom affected, except by a far-lateral (foraminal or extraforaminal) herniation, which compresses the exiting root at the index level and most often involves the L4 nerve root, or by a very large posterolateral herniation that extends into the foraminal zone.
items.zh: 累及哪条神经根：后外侧突出（又称旁中央型、关节下区型或侧隐窝型突出）通常在走行神经根进入侧隐窝时压迫它。走行神经根贴近椎间盘下行，从下一节段的椎间孔穿出，因此 L4–L5 椎间盘突出通常累及 L5 神经根，L5–S1 椎间盘突出通常累及 S1 神经根。出口神经根绕过同节段椎间盘上方的椎弓根穿出，很少受累；例外是极外侧型（椎间孔型或椎间孔外型）突出，它在本节段压迫出口神经根，最常累及 L4 神经根；或是延伸到椎间孔区的巨大后外侧突出。

items.en: Dorsal root ganglion: The lumbar dorsal root ganglia lie progressively more laterally from L1 to L5, so in the lower lumbar spine a ganglion is more likely to sit within the intervertebral foramen. Foraminal and extraforaminal herniations can compress the dorsal root ganglion, so their pain may have a burning or dysaesthetic quality that differs from central or posterolateral herniations.
items.zh: 背根神经节：腰神经背根神经节自 L1 至 L5 位置逐渐偏外，因此在下腰椎更可能位于椎间孔内。椎间孔型和椎间孔外型突出可压迫背根神经节，因此其疼痛可呈烧灼样或感觉异常样，与中央型或后外侧型突出不同。

items.en: Key findings: Radicular pain comes with the sensory, motor and reflex pattern of the compressed root (see 4.3). The straight leg raise is most helpful for the L4, L5 and S1 roots, and the femoral nerve tension test screens the L2–L4 roots (see 4.1). A large central herniation can produce cauda equina syndrome.
items.zh: 主要表现：根性痛伴受压神经根对应的感觉、运动和反射改变（见 4.3）。直腿抬高试验对 L4、L5、S1 神经根最有价值，股神经牵拉试验用于筛查 L2–L4 神经根（见 4.1）。巨大的中央型突出可引起马尾综合征。

heading.en: Lumbar spinal stenosis and neurogenic claudication
heading.zh: 腰椎管狭窄症与神经源性间歇性跛行

items.en: Structures: Narrowing of the central canal, the lateral recess or the neural foramen compresses neural and vascular elements. The narrowing comes from disc protrusion or bulging, facet joint arthropathy with osteophyte formation and ligamentum flavum hypertrophy, and spondylolisthesis may make it worse. In central stenosis the thecal sac is narrowed; on MRI a thecal sac area below 100 mm² is used.
items.zh: 结构：中央椎管、侧隐窝或椎间孔狭窄会压迫神经和血管结构。狭窄来自椎间盘突出或膨出、关节突关节退变与骨赘形成以及黄韧带肥厚，腰椎滑脱可使其加重。中央型狭窄时硬膜囊变窄；MRI 上以硬膜囊面积小于 100 mm² 为标准。

items.en: Zones and roots: In the lateral recess the traversing nerve root is at risk, because disc herniations compress it as it enters the recess. The foraminal zone lies between the medial and lateral borders of the pedicle, and foraminal stenosis compresses the exiting nerve root against the pedicle above (vertical stenosis) or between the superior articular facet and the posterior vertebral body (transverse stenosis).
items.zh: 分区与神经根：侧隐窝处受威胁的是走行神经根，因为椎间盘突出正是在它进入侧隐窝时压迫它。椎间孔区位于椎弓根内、外侧缘之间，椎间孔狭窄会把出口神经根压向上方的椎弓根（垂直型狭窄），或夹在上关节突与椎体后缘之间（横向型狭窄）。

items.en: Mechanism: In lumbar extension the laminar edges of adjacent vertebrae overlap and the ligamentum flavum buckles inward, so extension increases the pain and flexion decreases it. Flexion exercises help increase the cross-sectional area of the spinal canal and the lateral recesses.
items.zh: 机制：腰椎后伸时相邻椎板边缘重叠、黄韧带向内皱褶，因此后伸使疼痛加重、前屈使疼痛减轻。前屈训练有助于增大椎管和侧隐窝的横截面积。

items.en: Key findings: Neurogenic claudication is the characteristic symptom: pain, numbness, paraesthesia or weakness in the buttocks, thighs or legs that worsens with walking, standing or upright exercise and is relieved by sitting or bending forward. People often find relief by leaning forward on a shopping cart while walking.
items.zh: 主要表现：特征性症状是神经源性间歇性跛行，即臀部、大腿或小腿的疼痛、麻木、感觉异常或无力，在行走、站立或直立运动时加重，坐下或身体前屈时缓解。患者常在行走时扶着购物车前倾以减轻症状。

heading.zh: 椎弓峡部裂与腰椎滑脱（Meyerding 分级）

items.en: Structures: The pars interarticularis is the isthmus, or bony bridge, between the inferior and superior articular surfaces of a single vertebra. Spondylolysis is a unilateral or bilateral defect of the pars, and most cases occur at the L5 vertebra.
items.zh: 结构：椎弓峡部是同一椎骨上、下关节面之间的狭窄部分（骨桥）。椎弓峡部裂是椎弓峡部的单侧或双侧缺损，大多发生在第 5 腰椎。

items.en: Mechanism: It results mainly from repetitive microtrauma in activities with repeated lumbar hyperextension and rotation, such as gymnastics, dance, football and wrestling. Unhealed pars defects may progress to lytic (isthmic) spondylolisthesis, whereas unilateral lesions do not typically progress.
items.zh: 机制：主要由反复的微小损伤引起，常见于需要反复腰椎过伸并旋转的运动，如体操、舞蹈、橄榄球和摔跤。未愈合的椎弓峡部缺损可进展为溶骨性（峡部裂型）腰椎滑脱，而单侧病变一般不会进展。

items.en: Key findings: Examination may show tight hamstrings, reduced trunk range of motion (particularly extension) and a positive stork test, although the test's accuracy is poor (see 4.1). On plain radiographs the defect is most typically seen in the oblique view, as a collar on the Scotty dog; MRI is usually chosen next if plain films are negative, and SPECT is a suitable alternative for detecting acute stress fractures.
items.zh: 主要表现：查体可见腘绳肌紧张、躯干活动度下降（尤其是后伸）以及单腿过伸试验阳性，但该试验准确度差（见 4.1）。X 线平片上缺损最常在斜位片中显示，表现为“苏格兰犬戴项圈”征；平片阴性时通常再做 MRI，SPECT 是检出急性应力性骨折的合适替代方法。

items.en: Spondylolisthesis and Meyerding grading: Spondylolisthesis is the forward slippage of one vertebra over another. To grade it, lines are drawn along the posterior cortex of the upper and lower vertebrae, and the distance between them (A) is divided by the length of the inferior vertebral body (B): grade I 0–25%, grade II 26–50%, grade III 51–75%, grade IV 76–100% and grade V (spondyloptosis) more than 100%. The system was developed for anterolisthesis but can be adapted for retrolisthesis. For spondylolysis, the StatPearls chapter (marked for historical reference only) states that surgery is warranted if spondylolisthesis of grade 3 or higher develops.
items.zh: 腰椎滑脱与 Meyerding 分级：腰椎滑脱是指一个椎骨相对于另一个椎骨向前滑移。分级时沿上、下位椎体后缘皮质各画一条线，以两线间距（A）除以下位椎体的长度（B）：一度 0–25%，二度 26–50%，三度 51–75%，四度 76–100%，五度（椎体完全滑脱）大于 100%。该分级原为前滑脱设计，也可用于后滑脱。StatPearls 的相关章节（标注为仅供历史参考）指出，椎弓峡部裂患者若进展为三度或以上滑脱，即有手术指征。

heading.en: Facet joint pain and medial branch blocks
heading.zh: 关节突关节痛与内侧支阻滞

items.en: Structures: The zygapophyseal (facet) joints are plane synovial joints between the superior and inferior articular processes of adjoining vertebrae. Each lumbar facet joint receives medial branches of the dorsal rami from at least two levels, usually the same level and the level above; for example, the L3–L4 joint receives the L2 and L3 medial branches. Pain from the joint capsule and synovial folds is carried by these medial branches, and one source adds a supply from the sinuvertebral nerve.
items.zh: 结构：关节突关节是相邻椎骨上、下关节突之间的平面型滑膜关节。每个腰椎关节突关节至少接受两个节段的脊神经后支内侧支支配，通常来自同一节段和上一节段；例如 L3–L4 关节突关节接受 L2 和 L3 内侧支。关节囊和滑膜皱襞的痛觉由这些内侧支传导；有一处资料还提到该关节也接受窦椎神经支配。

items.en: Course of the medial branch: Each of the L1–L4 medial branches runs across the top of the transverse process one level below its named spinal nerve, in the groove between the root of that transverse process and the root of the superior articular process, where the mamillo-accessory ligament holds it tightly. It then runs down across the lamina deep to multifidus, which it also supplies. The medial branches do not control sensation or muscles in the limbs.
items.zh: 内侧支走行：L1–L4 每条内侧支越过低于同名脊神经一个节段的横突上缘，位于该横突根部与上关节突根部之间的沟内，被乳突副突韧带紧紧固定。随后它向下越过椎板，位于多裂肌深面，并支配多裂肌。内侧支不负责四肢的感觉或肌肉。

items.en: Presentation: Facet joint pain presents as lumbosacral pain with or without sciatica, typically radiating unilaterally or bilaterally to the buttock and trochanteric region without neurological deficit. It may increase with extension (more than with flexion) and with rotation. History, physical examination and imaging may suggest but cannot confirm the diagnosis.
items.zh: 表现：关节突关节痛表现为腰骶部疼痛，可伴或不伴坐骨神经痛，典型者向单侧或双侧臀部及大转子区放射，但无神经功能缺损。后伸（比前屈更明显）和旋转时疼痛可能加重。病史、体格检查和影像学只能提示而不能确诊。

items.en: Medial branch blocks: Diagnostic medial branch blocks are the most accepted and reliable diagnostic tool; because of the dual supply they are performed at a minimum of two levels, and two diagnostic blocks are recommended. In the research cited by Du et al. (2022), patients were selected by comparative blocks with lidocaine and bupivacaine, and a positive set of blocks was defined as an 80% reduction in pain. People who respond may go on to medial branch radiofrequency ablation, with the probes placed at two adjacent levels, although its short-term and long-term efficacy is debated.
items.zh: 内侧支阻滞：诊断性内侧支阻滞是最被认可、最可靠的诊断方法；由于存在双重支配，至少应在两个节段进行，并建议做两次诊断性阻滞。Du 等（2022）引用的研究中，患者经利多卡因与布比卡因比较性阻滞筛选，以疼痛减轻 80% 作为一组阻滞阳性的标准。阻滞有效者可进一步接受内侧支射频消融，电极放置在两个相邻节段，但其短期和远期疗效均有争议。

items.en: Structures: The spinal cord ends as the conus medullaris, usually at about the L1–L2 vertebral level in adults (see 2.1); the level varies between people from the middle third of the T11 vertebra to the middle third of the L3 vertebra. The roots below form the cauda equina, which provides motor and sensory innervation to the legs, bladder, anus and perineum, including sensation of the saddle area and voluntary control of the external anal and urinary sphincters.
items.zh: 结构：脊髓以脊髓圆锥终止，成人通常约在第 1–2 腰椎平面（见 2.1）；个体差异可从第 11 胸椎椎体中 1/3 至第 3 腰椎椎体中 1/3。其下方的神经根组成马尾，为下肢、膀胱、肛门和会阴提供运动和感觉神经支配，包括鞍区感觉以及肛门外括约肌和尿道括约肌的随意控制。

items.en: Mechanism: The most common cause of compression is a herniated lumbar disc, and a large central herniation can produce the syndrome.
items.zh: 机制：最常见的压迫原因是腰椎间盘突出，巨大的中央型突出即可引起本病。

items.en: Red flags: saddle (perineal) anaesthesia; bladder dysfunction, from early changes such as loss of the desire to void, a poor stream and straining to empty the bladder to painless retention with overflow incontinence; bowel dysfunction; sexual dysfunction; back pain with unilateral or bilateral leg symptoms; and absent or reduced anal tone on examination. A full neurological assessment looks for dermatomal sensory loss, myotomal weakness and reflex change.
items.zh: 危险信号：鞍区（会阴）麻木；膀胱功能障碍，从早期改变（如排尿意识消失、尿流变细、需用力才能排空膀胱）到无痛性尿潴留伴充溢性尿失禁；排便功能障碍；性功能障碍；腰痛伴单侧或双侧下肢症状；查体时肛门括约肌张力消失或减弱。完整的神经系统检查应查找皮节性感觉减退、肌节性无力和反射改变。

items.en: Why it is an emergency: Suspected cauda equina syndrome needs an urgent MRI and an urgent surgical opinion. It is a neurosurgical emergency because delayed decompression can leave irreversible bladder, bowel and sexual dysfunction. StatPearls links better outcomes to early surgery, particularly within 48 hours of presentation, whereas Physiopedia gives no fixed window and says surgery should be carried out as soon as is practically possible. There is no way of predicting who will progress from the incomplete form to retention, or how quickly.
items.zh: 为何是急症：怀疑马尾综合征时必须紧急做 MRI，并紧急请外科会诊。它属于神经外科急症，因为减压延迟可能遗留不可逆的膀胱、直肠和性功能障碍。StatPearls 指出早期手术预后较好，尤其是在就诊后 48 小时内；Physiopedia 则不给固定时限，只说应在实际可行时尽快手术。无法预测哪些患者会由不完全型进展为尿潴留型，也无法预测进展速度。

items.en: Conus or cauda: Conus medullaris lesions tend to give symmetric weakness with hyperreflexia and early bowel and bladder dysfunction, whereas cauda equina lesions tend to give severe unilateral radicular pain, asymmetric weakness with hyporeflexia and later bowel and bladder dysfunction.
items.zh: 圆锥还是马尾：脊髓圆锥病变多表现为对称性无力伴反射亢进及较早出现的大小便功能障碍；马尾病变多表现为剧烈的单侧根性痛、不对称无力伴反射减弱及较晚出现的大小便功能障碍。

items.en: Structures: The superior cluneal nerves are usually described as the terminal lateral branches of the dorsal rami of L1–L3 (Elsevier), but a cadaver study (Konno et al.) traced branches from T12 to L5, and StatPearls gives contributions from T11 to L5. They pierce the thoracolumbar fascia (its superficial layer in Konno et al., its dorsal layer in Elsevier) and cross the posterior iliac crest to supply the skin over the posterior iliac crest and upper buttock. Some branches pass through an osteofibrous tunnel formed by the thoracolumbar fascia and the iliac crest, where they can be entrapped.
items.zh: 结构：臀上皮神经通常被描述为 L1–L3 脊神经后支外侧支的终末支（Elsevier），但一项尸体研究（Konno 等）追踪到其分支可来自 T12 至 L5，StatPearls 则给出 T11 至 L5。它们穿过胸腰筋膜（Konno 等称为浅层，Elsevier 称为后层），越过髂嵴后部，分布于髂嵴后部和臀上部的皮肤。部分分支穿过由胸腰筋膜与髂嵴围成的骨纤维管，可在此受卡压。

items.en: Distance from the midline: Isu et al. place the medial branch about 3–4 cm and the middle branch about 7–8 cm from the midline where they pierce the fascia at the iliac crest. In Konno et al. the tunnel-passing branches lay a mean of 66.1 mm (range 42.4–87.2 mm) from the midline; StatPearls gives about 6.6 cm for the medial branch at the tunnel, and an ASRA article approximately 7 cm.
items.zh: 距中线的距离：Isu 等指出，在髂嵴处内侧支约在距中线 3–4 cm、中间支约在 7–8 cm 处穿出筋膜。Konno 等测得穿经骨纤维管的分支距中线平均 66.1 mm（范围 42.4–87.2 mm）；StatPearls 给出内侧支在骨纤维管处约 6.6 cm，ASRA 的一篇文章给出约 7 cm。

items.en: Presentation: Entrapment causes low back pain involving the iliac crest and buttock, often with leg pain or tingling that mimics sciatica; the cadaver study describes referred pain radiating into the posterior thigh, calf and occasionally the foot (pseudo-sciatica). Symptoms are aggravated by lumbar extension, bending and rotation and by prolonged standing, sitting, walking and rolling over, and worsening during walking can look like intermittent claudication.
items.zh: 表现：卡压可引起累及髂嵴和臀部的腰痛，常伴酷似坐骨神经痛的下肢疼痛或刺麻感；该尸体研究描述其牵涉痛可放射至大腿后侧、小腿，偶达足部（假性坐骨神经痛）。腰椎后伸、弯腰、旋转，以及久站、久坐、行走和翻身时症状加重，行走中加重时可类似间歇性跛行。

items.en: Diagnostic criteria (Isu et al.): a trigger point over the posterior iliac crest at the compression zone, numbness and radiating pain in the nerve's territory when that point is pressed (Tinel sign), and relief after a superior cluneal nerve block at the trigger point.
items.zh: 诊断标准（Isu 等）：髂嵴后部卡压区有触发点；按压该点时神经分布区出现麻木和放射痛（蒂内尔征）；在触发点行臀上皮神经阻滞后症状缓解。

text.en: 4.3 Nerve root findings: sensation, strength and reflexes
text.zh: 4.3 神经根检查：感觉、肌力与反射

text.en: A dermatome is the area of skin supplied by nerves arising from a single spinal root, and a myotome is the group of skeletal muscles that a single spinal nerve innervates. The rows below are nerve roots, not vertebrae: the L5 nerve root leaves the vertebral column below the L5 vertebra, but it is usually compressed higher up, by an L4–L5 disc herniation, as it crosses that disc. The figure marks, for each root, its key sensory point in the International Standards for Neurological Classification of Spinal Cord Injury (ISNCSCI), and the three tendon reflexes. Sources describe the sensory areas and key muscles differently, as the last column shows.
text.zh: 皮节是由单一脊神经根发出的神经所分布的皮肤区域；肌节是单一脊神经所支配的一组骨骼肌。下表各行是神经根而不是椎骨：L5 神经根在第 5 腰椎下方离开脊柱，但它通常在更高处、越过 L4–L5 椎间盘时被该椎间盘突出压迫。图中标出每条神经根在《脊髓损伤神经学分类国际标准》（ISNCSCI）中的关键感觉点和三个腱反射。各资料对感觉区和关键肌的描述不尽相同，见最后一列。

columns.en: Sensory area and key sensory point

rows.en: L2 nerve root
rows.zh: L2 神经根

rows.en: The front of the thigh, from just below the inguinal canal to the knee. ISNCSCI key sensory point: the anteromedial thigh, halfway along a line from the midpoint of the inguinal ligament to the medial femoral condyle.
rows.zh: 大腿前面，自腹股沟管稍下方至膝部。ISNCSCI 关键感觉点：大腿前内侧，位于腹股沟韧带中点与股骨内侧髁连线的中点。

rows.en: Hip flexion; key muscle iliopsoas (ISNCSCI key muscles: hip flexors).
rows.zh: 屈髋；关键肌为髂腰肌（ISNCSCI 关键肌：屈髋肌群）。

rows.en: No reflex is specific to L2; the patellar reflex tests mainly L4 but can include L2 and L3.
rows.zh: 没有 L2 专属的反射；膝反射主要检测 L4，但也可包含 L2 和 L3。

rows.en: Physiopedia (Disc Herniation) groups L2–L4 together and gives the anterior thigh, sometimes with the medial lower leg.
rows.zh: Physiopedia（椎间盘突出页）把 L2–L4 合并描述，给出大腿前侧，有时包括小腿内侧。

rows.en: L3 nerve root
rows.zh: L3 神经根

rows.en: The anterior thigh and knee, extending down the medial thigh and lower leg between the L2 and L4 bands; L3 pain is felt in the anteromedial thigh. ISNCSCI key sensory point: the medial femoral condyle, just above the knee.
rows.zh: 大腿前面和膝部，并沿大腿内侧和小腿内侧向下延伸（位于 L2 与 L4 皮节之间）；L3 神经根痛位于大腿前内侧。ISNCSCI 关键感觉点：膝上方的股骨内侧髁。

rows.en: Knee extension; key muscle quadriceps (ISNCSCI key muscles: knee extensors). Hip adduction is also listed for L3.
rows.zh: 伸膝；关键肌为股四头肌（ISNCSCI 关键肌：伸膝肌群）。髋内收也列为 L3 对应动作。

rows.en: Patellar (knee) reflex, often given as L3–L4 (see L4).
rows.zh: 膝反射（髌腱反射），常归于 L3–L4（见 L4）。

rows.en: Knee extension: ISNCSCI assigns the knee extensors to L3, StatPearls (Lumbosacral Radiculopathy) assigns the quadriceps to L4, and Physiopedia (Myotomes) lists knee extension under both L3 and L4.
rows.zh: 伸膝：ISNCSCI 把伸膝肌群归于 L3，StatPearls（腰骶神经根病章节）把股四头肌归于 L4，Physiopedia（肌节页）则在 L3 和 L4 下都列出伸膝。

rows.en: L4 nerve root
rows.zh: L4 神经根

rows.en: Usually the medial malleolus and medial foot (StatPearls). Physiopedia (Dermatomes) describes a band from the lateral thigh curving to the medial leg, covering the knee, medial leg, dorsum of the foot, medial side of the big toe and medial malleolus. ISNCSCI key sensory point: the medial malleolus.
rows.zh: 通常为内踝及足内侧（StatPearls）。Physiopedia（皮节页）描述为自大腿外侧弯向小腿内侧的一条带，包括膝部、小腿内侧、足背、拇趾内侧和内踝。ISNCSCI 关键感觉点：内踝。

rows.en: Ankle dorsiflexion; key muscle tibialis anterior (ISNCSCI key muscles: ankle dorsiflexors). Knee extension (quadriceps) is also listed for L4.
rows.zh: 踝背屈；关键肌为胫骨前肌（ISNCSCI 关键肌：踝背屈肌群）。伸膝（股四头肌）也列为 L4 对应动作。

rows.en: Patellar reflex (knee jerk), tested mainly at L4 and often given as L3–L4; it is reduced or absent in L4 radiculopathy.
rows.zh: 膝反射，主要检测 L4，常写作 L3–L4；L4 神经根病时减弱或消失。

rows.en: Key muscle: ISNCSCI and Physiopedia (ASIA page) use the ankle dorsiflexors, and StatPearls (Sciatica) links ankle dorsiflexion weakness to L4, whereas StatPearls (Lumbosacral Radiculopathy) gives the quadriceps for L4 and tibialis anterior for L5. Sensory area: Physiopedia includes the dorsum of the foot in L4, whereas StatPearls gives the dorsum of the foot to L5. Patellar reflex: Lees and Hurwitz give L3/L4, a Toronto Metropolitan University nursing text says primarily L4 with possible L2 and L3, and StatPearls links it to L4.
rows.zh: 关键肌：ISNCSCI 和 Physiopedia（ASIA 页）采用踝背屈肌群，StatPearls（坐骨神经痛章节）也把踝背屈无力与 L4 联系；StatPearls（腰骶神经根病章节）则把 L4 定为股四头肌、把胫骨前肌归于 L5。感觉区：Physiopedia 把足背归入 L4，StatPearls 则把足背归于 L5。膝反射：Lees 与 Hurwitz 给出 L3/L4，多伦多都会大学的护理教材认为主要为 L4、可有 L2 和 L3 参与，StatPearls 把它与 L4 联系。

rows.en: L5 nerve root
rows.zh: L5 神经根

rows.en: Usually the dorsum of the foot (StatPearls). Physiopedia (Dermatomes) describes the posterolateral thigh wrapping forward at the knee to the anterolateral leg, then the dorsum and sole of the foot, the lateral side of the big toe and toes 2–4. ISNCSCI key sensory point: the dorsum of the foot at the third metatarsophalangeal joint.
rows.zh: 通常为足背（StatPearls）。Physiopedia（皮节页）描述为大腿后外侧，在膝部绕向前方至小腿前外侧，再至足背和足底、拇趾外侧及第 2–4 趾。ISNCSCI 关键感觉点：足背第 3 跖趾关节处。

rows.en: Great toe extension; key muscle extensor hallucis longus (ISNCSCI key muscles: long toe extensors). Ankle dorsiflexion (tibialis anterior) and hip abduction are also listed for L5.
rows.zh: 伸拇趾；关键肌为拇长伸肌（ISNCSCI 关键肌：趾长伸肌群）。踝背屈（胫骨前肌）和髋外展也列为 L5 对应动作。

rows.en: Medial hamstring (semitendinosus and semimembranosus) reflex.
rows.zh: 内侧腘绳肌（半腱肌和半膜肌）反射。

rows.en: Sensory area: Physiopedia (Disc Herniation) adds the lateral calf and the web space between the first and second toes. Movements: StatPearls (Lumbosacral Radiculopathy) names tibialis anterior and extensor hallucis longus (dorsiflexion), and StatPearls (Sciatica) hip abduction and big toe extension. Achilles reflex: mainly S1 but can include L5, according to the Toronto Metropolitan University nursing text.
rows.zh: 感觉区：Physiopedia（椎间盘突出页）还包括小腿外侧以及第 1、2 趾之间的趾蹼。动作：StatPearls（腰骶神经根病章节）列出胫骨前肌和拇长伸肌（背屈），StatPearls（坐骨神经痛章节）列出髋外展和伸拇趾。跟腱反射：多伦多都会大学护理教材认为主要为 S1，但也可包含 L5。

rows.en: S1 nerve root
rows.zh: S1 神经根

rows.en: Usually the lateral malleolus and lateral foot (StatPearls). Physiopedia (Dermatomes) gives the sole and plantar surface of the toes, spreading up the posterior leg, plus the lateral heel and lateral foot. ISNCSCI key sensory point: the lateral heel (calcaneus).
rows.zh: 通常为外踝及足外侧（StatPearls）。Physiopedia（皮节页）给出足底和趾的跖面，并向上延伸至小腿后面，另包括足跟外侧和足外侧缘。ISNCSCI 关键感觉点：足跟外侧（跟骨）。

rows.en: Ankle plantarflexion; key muscles gastrocnemius and soleus (ISNCSCI key muscles: ankle plantar flexors). Ankle eversion is also listed for S1.
rows.zh: 踝跖屈；关键肌为腓肠肌和比目鱼肌（ISNCSCI 关键肌：踝跖屈肌群）。足外翻也列为 S1 对应动作。

rows.en: Achilles (ankle) reflex, usually S1; it is reduced or absent when the S1 root is compressed.
rows.zh: 跟腱反射，通常归于 S1；S1 神经根受压时减弱或消失。

rows.en: Sensory area: Physiopedia (Disc Herniation) gives the posterior calf and the lateral or plantar foot. Reflex level: Lees and Hurwitz give S1/S2, and the Toronto Metropolitan University nursing text says primarily S1 but can include S2 and L5.
rows.zh: 感觉区：Physiopedia（椎间盘突出页）给出小腿后侧以及足外侧或足底。反射节段：Lees 与 Hurwitz 给出 S1/S2，多伦多都会大学护理教材认为主要为 S1，但也可包含 S2 和 L5。

text.en: Linking the disc level to the root: a posterolateral L4–L5 herniation usually gives L5 findings and a posterolateral L5–S1 herniation S1 findings, while a far-lateral L4–L5 herniation gives L4 findings. By the same traversing-root rule, a posterolateral L3–L4 herniation usually affects the L4 root.
text.zh: 椎间盘平面与神经根的对应：L4–L5 后外侧突出通常表现为 L5 的体征，L5–S1 后外侧突出表现为 S1 的体征，而 L4–L5 极外侧型突出表现为 L4 的体征。按同一走行神经根规律，L3–L4 后外侧突出通常累及 L4 神经根。

text.en: In the lumbar region the acupoints of this section lie on the posterior median line and on three lines on each side of it. The Governor Vessel runs on the posterior median line: Mingmen (GV4) lies in the depression below the L2 spinous process, and Yaoyangguan (GV3) in the depression below the L4 spinous process. The Bladder meridian has two lines on each side. Shenshu (BL23), Qihaishu (BL24), Dachangshu (BL25) and Guanyuanshu (BL26) lie 1.5 cun lateral to the posterior median line, below the L2, L3, L4 and L5 spinous processes in turn, and Zhishi (BL52) lies 3 cun lateral, below the L2 spinous process, on the same level as BL23 and GV4. Closest to the midline are the Jiaji points (EX-B2), conventionally 0.5 cun beside the lower border of each spinous process from T1 to L5; a 2012 dissection study proposes a range of 0.3 to 1 cun for the lumbar points instead. Jiaji is an extra point, not a meridian point: GB/T 12346-2021 removed the 46 extra points of its 2006 edition and leaves them to a separate national standard. For lateral distances, GB/T 12346-2021 sets the medial border of the scapula 3 cun from the posterior median line, and WHO 2008 gives 6 B-cun between the two medial borders, which agrees; the 1.5-cun line therefore lies halfway between the midline and the medial border of the scapula.
text.zh: 在腰部，本节的穴位分布在后正中线及其两侧各三条纵线上。督脉行于后正中线：命门（GV4）在第 2 腰椎棘突下凹陷中，腰阳关（GV3）在第 4 腰椎棘突下凹陷中。膀胱经在每侧有两条线。肾俞（BL23）、气海俞（BL24）、大肠俞（BL25）和关元俞（BL26）依次位于第 2、第 3、第 4、第 5 腰椎棘突下，后正中线旁开 1.5 寸；志室（BL52）位于第 2 腰椎棘突下、旁开 3 寸，与肾俞和命门同一水平。最靠近正中线的是夹脊（EX-B2），常规定位在第 1 胸椎至第 5 腰椎各棘突下缘两侧旁开 0.5 寸；2012 年一项解剖研究则建议腰段夹脊取旁开 0.3 至 1 寸的范围。夹脊属于经外奇穴，不属于经穴：GB/T 12346-2021 删除了 2006 年版中的 46 个经外奇穴，留待单独制定的国家标准规定。横向距离方面，GB/T 12346-2021 规定肩胛骨内侧缘至后正中线为 3 寸，世界卫生组织 2008 年标准规定两肩胛骨内侧缘之间为 6 个骨度寸，两者一致；因此旁开 1.5 寸线位于后正中线与肩胛骨内侧缘的正中。

text.en: To count levels, GB/T 12346-2021 uses bony landmarks on the posterior median line. The line joining the highest points of the two iliac crests crosses it at the L4 spinous process, and WHO 2008 uses the same landmark. The line joining the free ends of the two 12th ribs crosses it at the L2 spinous process, a landmark added in the 2021 edition. The line joining the two posterior superior iliac spines (PSIS) crosses it at the second sacral vertebra (S2). With the person standing and the arms hanging down, the T12 spinous process lies midway between the line joining the inferior angles of the two scapulae and the iliac crest line, and the standard's note for BL23 counts down two spinous processes from T12 to reach L2. Lumbar spinous processes are short, broad and hatchet-shaped; count them one by one, up from L4 or down from T12. These are vertebral levels, that is bones, not spinal nerve levels. The figure also outlines the kidneys, which typically extend from T12 to L3 and lie ventral to quadratus lumborum, deep to the L2 level of BL23 and BL52.
text.zh: 确定节段时，GB/T 12346-2021 以后正中线上的骨性标志为准。两髂嵴最高点连线与后正中线的交点为第 4 腰椎棘突，世界卫生组织 2008 年标准采用同一标志。两侧第 12 肋游离端连线与后正中线的交点为第 2 腰椎棘突，这是 2021 年版新增的标志。两髂后上棘连线与后正中线的交点为第 2 骶椎（S2）。直立、两手下垂时，第 12 胸椎棘突位于两肩胛骨下角连线与两髂嵴最高点连线之间的后正中线中点；标准在肾俞条下注明，从第 12 胸椎棘突向下数第 2 个棘突即第 2 腰椎棘突。腰椎棘突短而宽，呈斧形；可从第 4 腰椎向上或从第 12 胸椎向下逐个数。这些都是椎骨节段（骨），不是脊神经节段。配图还画出了肾的轮廓：肾通常位于第 12 胸椎至第 3 腰椎之间，在腰方肌腹侧，位于肾俞和志室所在的第 2 腰椎平面深面。

text.en: The layer descriptions and the figure are learning references only. They are not clinically calibrated and do not indicate needle depth, direction or path. Model gap: the 3D model has no markers for these acupoints.
text.zh: 层次描述和配图只作学习参照，没有临床校准，不表示进针深度、方向或路径。模型缺项：3D 模型没有这些穴位的标记。

columns.en: Trigger-point or dry-needling target in the sources
columns.zh: 资料中的触发点或干针目标

rows.en: GV4 Mingmen
rows.zh: GV4 命门

rows.en: Supraspinous and interspinous ligaments between the L2 and L3 spinous processes; no muscle belly.
rows.zh: 第 2、第 3 腰椎棘突之间的棘上韧带和棘间韧带；无肌腹。

rows.en: None named in the sources used here.
rows.zh: 本章所用资料未给出。

rows.en: GV3 Yaoyangguan
rows.zh: GV3 腰阳关

rows.en: Interspinous ligament between the L4 and L5 spinous processes, and the supraspinous ligament where it reaches this level (sources differ); no muscle belly.
rows.zh: 第 4、第 5 腰椎棘突之间的棘间韧带，以及延伸到此平面时的棘上韧带（各资料说法不一）；无肌腹。

rows.en: None named in the sources used here.
rows.zh: 本章所用资料未给出。

rows.en: BL23 Shenshu
rows.zh: BL23 肾俞

rows.en: Erector spinae, with multifidus deeper and more medial; quadratus lumborum deeper still, with the kidney ventral to it.
rows.zh: 竖脊肌，多裂肌位于更深、更内侧；再深为腰方肌，其腹侧为肾。

rows.en: Multifidus trigger points, which Physiopedia describes as a dry-needling target; none is assigned to BL23 itself.
rows.zh: 多裂肌触发点，有物理治疗参考资料记载对其干针治疗；资料没有对应到肾俞本身。

rows.en: BL24 Qihaishu
rows.zh: BL24 气海俞

rows.en: Erector spinae, with multifidus deeper and more medial; quadratus lumborum deeper still.
rows.zh: 竖脊肌，多裂肌位于更深、更内侧；再深为腰方肌。

rows.en: Multifidus trigger points, which Physiopedia describes as a dry-needling target; none is assigned to BL24 itself.
rows.zh: 多裂肌触发点，有物理治疗参考资料记载对其干针治疗；资料没有对应到气海俞本身。

rows.en: BL25 Dachangshu
rows.zh: BL25 大肠俞

rows.en: Erector spinae and multifidus; quadratus lumborum deeper.
rows.zh: 竖脊肌和多裂肌；深部为腰方肌。

rows.en: Multifidus trigger points (dry needling described) and quadratus lumborum trigger points, which can mimic a painful syndrome of the lumbar area; none is assigned to BL25 itself.
rows.zh: 多裂肌触发点（记载有干针治疗）和腰方肌触发点，后者可类似腰部疼痛综合征；资料没有对应到大肠俞本身。

rows.en: BL26 Guanyuanshu
rows.zh: BL26 关元俞

rows.en: Lower erector spinae and multifidus; deeper, the origin of quadratus lumborum from the iliolumbar ligament and iliac crest.
